sanskrit: prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāṃtaye vidveṣivargavijaye harinīlavarṇāmaṃbāṃ trilokajananīmajaniṃ prapadme jaya sarvagate devi bhadrakāli namostute nigamāgamataṃtrāṇāṃ purāṇavacasāmapi maṃtrajyotiṣaśilpānāṃ sāraṃ saṃgṛhya tattvataḥ || 2 || || svarūpāyudhavarṇānāṃ bhūṣāvāhanalakṣmaṇām viṣṇvīśa brahmaśakrādi devānāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca etat prasaṃgādanyeṣāṃ vaktavyānāṃ kramā api graṃthe śrītattvanidhyākhye navanidhyātmake śubhe vakṣyāmāṇeṣu vidhiṣu jñātavyoyaṃ tvanukramaḥ || 7 || || viṣṇumūrtiprabhedānāṃ lakṣmaproktaṃ dvitīyake turīye brahmaśakrādidevarūpanirūpaṇam ṣaṣṭhe proktaṃ harikṣetraśāligrāmādilakṣaṇam nigamāgamataṃtrādilakṣaṇaṃ proktamaṣṭame etannavanidhi jñānātsulabhānidhayonava triṇotrāyauvanasthā ca kruddhā cordhva sthitāmatā ekavaktrā tu sugrīvā bāhuviṃśati saṃyutā abhayaṃ ḍamaruṃ caivacchurikāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ nāgaṃpāśaṃ tathā kheṭaṃ kuṭhārāṃkuśa kārmukān tadadhomahiṣaśchinnamūrdhā patitamastakaḥ śūlabhinnovamadraktorakta bhrūśmaśrulocanaḥ vāmāṃghryākrāṃta siṃhā ca savyāṃghryālīḍhagāsurā caṃḍīcodyata śastreyamaśeṣaripunāśinī || svarṇavarṇaḥ ekakāloditāneka caṃdrakoṭyarkakoṭibhām japākusumasaṃkāśāma japāma japātmikām

bālārkakoṭibhāṃ tryakṣāṃ bāleṃdumakuṭojjvalām acaṃcalataṭitkoṭiprabhā piṃgalavāsasam koṭarikoṭī ghaṭitasudhākara sudhāplutām kaṭākṣasaraṇī niryatkaruṇā pūrṇalocanām śukratārāsamākāranāsābharaṇaśobhinīm vīṇāravaghṛṇādāyinijavāṇīguṇodayām maṇidarpaṇadarpaghnakapolaphalakaprabhām maṇimaṃgalasūtreṇa vilasatkaṃbukaṃdharām ratnāṃgulīya nivahairlasadaṃguli pallavām kucabhāra namanmadhyatrivalī lalitodarām suvṛttajaṃghorukāṃḍāṃgūḍhagulphāṃ guḍālakām ratnagraiveya valayamakuṭāṃgadakaṃkaṇām sarvaśṛṃgāra veṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām kāraṇe śaśiroratnanighṛṣṭa caraṇāṃbujām paṃcapretāsanāsīnāṃ paṃcapraṇavarūpiṇīm || siṃdūravarṇaḥ nīlāśmadyutimāsya pādadaśakāṃseve mahākālikāṃ yāmastautsvapiteharaukamalajohaṃtuṃ madhuṃkaiṭabham || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ śūlaṃpāśasudarśane ca dadhatīṃ hastaiḥ pravālaprabhāṃ sevesairibhamardinīmiha mahālakṣmīṃ sarojasthitām || 1 || pravālavarṇaḥ gaurīdeha samudbhavāṃ trijagatāmādhārabhūtāṃ mahā pūrvāmatrasarasvatīmanubhaje śuṃbhādidaityārdinīm || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ prāptiḥ prākāmyāmīśatvaṃ va śitvaṃcāṣṭabhūtayaḥ etādevyaścaturvāhāḥ japākusumasaṃnibhāḥ dadhānādayayā pūrṇāyogibhiśca niṣevitāḥ || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ vārāhī caiva māheṃdrīcāmuṃḍā caiva saptamī kapālamutpalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇāraktavāsasaḥ brahmādisadṛśākārā brahmādisadṛśāyudhāḥ brahmādīnāṃ paraṃ cihnaṃdhārayaṃtyaḥprakīrtitāḥ || raktavarṇaḥ

dāḍimī puṣpasaṃkāśāḥ pītāṃbaramanoharāḥ madaraktabilolākṣyastāsāṃ nāmāmisaṃ śṛṇu sarvākarṣiṇimudrā ca tathā sarvavaśaṃkarī sarvakhecari mudrā ca sarvabījā tathā parā ityetāḥ kathitā vipradaśamudrādhidevatāḥ || 5 || raktavarṇaḥ ahaṃkārā karṣiṇī ca sarvākarṣiṇikākalā rasākarṣiṇikā caiva gaṃdhākarṣiṇikākalā smṛtyākarṣiṇikā nityānāmā karṣiṇikākalā amṛtākarṣiṇī nityāśarīrākarṣiṇī parā vidrumadruma saṃkāśāmaṃda prahasitānanāḥ cāpabāṇau carmakhaḍgaudadhānādivyakāṃtayaḥ || 6 || raktavarṇaḥ anaṃgamadanānaṃgamadanāturayā saha anaṃgamālinya parācaitā devyojapātviṣaḥ bibhratyodabhravikrāṃti śālinyolalitājñayā || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ veṇī kṛtakacasmotāḥ siṃdūratilakojjvalāḥ vahnicāpaṃ vahnibāṇaṃ vahnirūpamasiṃ tathā asureṃdraṃ pratikruddhāḥ kāmabhasma samudbhavam sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā sarvasaṃmohinī śaktissarvastaṃbhinikā tathā sarvaraṃjinikā śaktiḥ sarvonmādinikā tathā sarvamaṃtramayī śaktissarvadvaṃdvakṣayaṃkarī ityevaṃ saṃpradāyānāṃ nāmāni kathitāni vai || raktavarṇaḥ gadāṃghaṃṭāmaṇiṃ caiva dadhānādīpta vigrahāḥ etāsāmapi nāmāni samākarṇayakuṃbhaja sarvapriyaṃkarīdevī sarvamaṃgalakāriṇī

sarvamṛtyupraśamanī sarvavighnanivāriṇī daśaitāḥ kathitādevyodayayā pūritāśayāḥ || 5 || śvetavarṇaḥ sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī sarvādhāra svarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathā sarvepsita pradādevīmuktā gaurasamatviṣaḥ cakraṃ caiva ca bibhrāṇā bhaṃḍāsuravadhodyatāḥ || 4 || śvetavarṇaḥ raktāśokaprasūnābhā bāṇakārmukapāṇayaḥ vaśinī caiva kāmeśīmodinīvimalā tathā aṣṭāvetāssmṛtā devyodaityasaṃhārahetavaḥ || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ cāpabāṇaupānapātraṃ mātuliṃgaṃ kṛpāṇakam bibhrāṇāmahironmattā atipūrvarahasyakāḥ tisra etāssmṛtā daityebhaṃḍekopasamanvitāḥ etāstu nityaṃ śrīdevyā aṃtaraṃgā prakīrtitāḥ || 4 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ jagatāmupakārāya varttamānā yuge yuge karairdadhānāmaruṇāṃ triṇetrāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ nityamahaṃbhajāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ baṃdhūkapuṣparucirāmati suṃdarāṃgīmaṃbāṃbhajāmi hṛdaye bhagamālinīṃ tām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dorbhiḥpāśaṃ sṛṇivaramabhayaṃ pānapātraṃ dadhānāṃ nityaklinnāmahamanudivasaṃmānase bhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ guṃjāmālā virājatkucabharanamanonmadhyamāmabjasaṃsthāṃ nānā laṃkāra yuktāṃsuramakuṭamaṇidyotita svarṇapīṭhām bhaktābhīṣṭādhidevīṃ paramasukhakarīṃ svākṛtiṃ sundarāsyāṃ bheruṃḍāṃ muktakeśīṃ tribhuvanajananīṃ cetasā ciṃtayāmi || śvetavarṇaḥ taptodyat kāṃcanābhāṃ maṇimayamakuṭāmaṣṭahastāṃ triṇetrāṃ nityāṃ cittāraviṃde pratidivasamahaṃ vahnivāsībhajāmi || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇāṃ raktavarṇāṃ tribhirapinayanaiḥ sādaraṃ vīkṣatīṃ tāṃ vajreśīṃ bhāvayehaṃ suragaṇamunibhiḥ stūyamānāṃ bhavā**? || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ madhyāhnārka prabhābhāṃ navamaṇivilasadbhūṣaṇāmaṣṭahastāṃ dūtīṃ nityāṃ triṇetrāṃ suragaṇamunibhiḥ stūyamānāṃbhajeham || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ pītāṃpallavavāsinīṃ śikhiśikhā cūḍāvataṃsojjvalāṃ dhyāyāmyanvahamṛkṣasiṃhanivahaiḥ pīṭhasthi tāṃ sundarīm || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ mālāṃpustakamapyabhīṣṭamabhayaṃ saṃbibhratīṃ bāhubhirbālāṃ tāmakhilāṃgabhūṣaṇadharāṃ dhyāyāmi saṃsiddhidām || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥ dakṣairaṃkuśapustakeṣu kusumaṃ khaḍgaṃ kapālābhayaṃ māṇikyābhara ṇojjvalāṃ triṇayanāṃ nityāṃbhavānīṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ

dakṣecāṃkuśa khaḍgaśaktisu mahābāṇābhayānbāhubhiḥ padmasthāṃ maṇimauktikā vṛtakucāṃnīladhvajāmāśraye || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ udyadbālārkavarṇāṃ tribhuvanavijayāṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trinetrāṃ devīṃ pītāṃbarāḍhyāṃku ca bharanamitāṃ saṃtataṃ bhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ bhaktānāṃ dhanadāṃvaraṃ ca radhatīṃvāmenahastena taddakṣeṇābhayamātulaṃgasuphalaṃ śrīmaṃgalāṃ bhāvaye || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ dakṣetvaṃkuśakhaḍgaśaktisuśarāñcāpābhaye bibhratīṃ jvalāmālinisaṃjñitāṃ maṇimayībhūṣānvitāmāśraye || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ citrāṃśukāṃ ca navaratnavibhūṣitāṃgīṃ citrāṃbikāṃtriṇayanāṃ hṛdibhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ rājarājeśvarīvatpāśāṃkuśekṣucāpapuṣpabāṇahastā siṃdūravarṇākāryā varmadevī dṛṣṭidevī hyastradevīṣaḍīratāḥ paritobindupīṭhaṃ ca bhrāmyaṃtyodīptamūrtayaḥ || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ pāśapātradharāceyaṃ dvibhujāśyāmalā smṛtā || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ ālīḍhasthāna saṃsthānācatussiṃharathe sthitā bāṇacāpau ca kartavye śaṃkhapadme tathaiva ca daṃḍaśaktī ca kartavye kṛṣṇājinahutāśanau ekatraiva mahābhāgāratnapātradharā bhavet || 4 || nīlavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇāṃ bāhudaṃḍaissulalitavaradādyābhivītāṃmanojñāṃ mudgānnāsaktacittāṃ madhumadamuditāṃ śākinīṃbhāvayet tām || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ medodhātu pratiṣṭhāmalimadamuditāṃbaṃdhinīṃpūgaśaktyāvītāṃdadhya nnasaktāmabhimataphaladāṃkinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ ḍāmaryādyaiḥparītāṃ paśujanabhayadāṃmāṃsadhātvāsanasthāṃgauḍā nne saktacittāṃsakalasukhakarīṃsaṃsmarellākinīṃ tām || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ raktasthāṃ kālarātriprabhṛtiparivṛtāṃ śuddharaktepravṛttāṃ śrīmadvīreṃdravaṃdyāmabhimataphaladāṃ rākinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ vaktreṇaikenayuktāṃ paśujanabhayadāṃpāyasānna prasaktāṃtvaksthāṃ vaṃdemṛtoghaiḥ parivṛtavapuṣaṃḍākinīṃ vīracaṃḍām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ ṣaḍvaktrāmabjasaṃsthāṃ trinayanalalitāṃhaṃsagatyādiyuktāṃhāridrānne prasaktāṃ sakalasuranutāṃhākinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ rādīnāṃ sarvavaktrāṃ sakalasukhakarīṃ sarvadhātu svarūpāṃ sarvānnesaktacittāṃparaśivarasikāṃ bhāvayed yākinīṃ tām || 1 || citravarṇaḥ piṃgābhābhūṣaṇopetāmṛgacarmottarīyakā vāme tu pustakaṃkuṃḍīṃbibhratīcābhayaṃkaram || 2 || pītavarṇaḥ śvetavarṇā daśabhujācaṃdrarekhā vibhūṣitā pāśaṃghaṃṭāṃ tathā nāgamaṃkuśaṃ bibhratīkaraiḥ || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥ ravibāhurmayūrasthāvaradā śaktidhariṇī

paraśuṃ bibhratī caiva tadadhastvabhayānvitā || 2 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakrābhayānvāme sā ceyaṃvilasadbhujā || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ varadādaṃḍinī khaḍgaṃbibhratī dakṣiṇekare kheṭapātrābhayānvāme sūkarāsyālasadbhujā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ varadāsūtriṇī vajraṃ bibhratyūrdhvaṃ tu dakṣiṇe vāme tu kamalaṃpātraṃ hyabhayaṃtadadhaḥkare || kanakavarṇaḥ daṃṣṭrālākṣīṇadehā ca gartākṣīkāmarūpiṇī aṃkuśaṃ bibhratīkhaḍgaṃdakṣiṇe cāthavāmake kheṭaṃpāśaṃdhanurdaṃḍaṃ kuṭhāraṃcāpibibhratī || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ jaṭilāvartulā tryakṣāvaradā śūladhāriṇī kartrikāṃ bibhratīdakṣe pāśapātrābhayānvitā || śvetavarṇaḥ vṛṣārūḍhāṃ śūladharāṃ śailaputrīṃyaśasvinīm || 1 devīprasīda tu mayibrahmacāriṇyanuttamā || 1 prasādaṃ tanutāṃmahyaṃ caṃḍakhaṃḍeti viśrutā || 1 śubhadāstu sadā devīskaṃdamātāyaśasvinī || 1 dadhānāhastapadmābhyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍāśubhadāstume || 1 kātyāyanīśubhaṃ dadyād devīdānavaghātinī || 1 kālarātriḥśubhaṃ dadyād devīcaṃḍāṭṭahāsinī || 1 mahāgaurīśubhaṃ dadyānmahādeva pramodadā || 1 sevyamānā sadābhūyāt siddhidāsiddhidāyinī || 1 tatra padmānvite sthāne pūjyādurgāstumūrtitaḥ | aṣṭādaśabhujācaikāpīnavakṣobhujorukā mūrdhajaṃ kheṭakaṃghaṃṭāmādarśaṃtarjanīṃ dhanuḥ śaktimudgaraśūlānivajraṃ śaṃkhamathāṃbujam śeṣāṣṣoḍaśahastāssyuśśaraṃḍamarukaṃvinā navamīcogra caṃḍā ca navadurgāḥprakīrtitāḥ || 1 || (tāsāṃvarṇā) ||

pītā ca pāṃḍarā jñeyāhyālīḍhāstāharidvṛtāḥ || 1 pannagavalayavibhūṣāṃ nīlagrīvāṃdigaṃbarāṃ vaṃde || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ saśūlakhaḍgāṃdhṛtaśaṃkhacakrāṃ mṛgeṃdrayānāṃ ravicaṃdrabhūṣām iṣṭārthadātrīṃsuravaṃdyapādāṃ rudrāṃśadurgāṃ manasāsmarāmi || śyāmavarṇaḥ vajraṃkare bibhratī sā mahākālīmudestunaḥ || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ || mama sā mahiṣottamāṃgasaṃsthā navadūrvāsadṛśīśriyestudurgā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ śyāmābhāṃ ca triṇetrāṃ tāṃ siṃhavaktrāṃ caturbhujām || ūrdhvakeśīṃ ca siṃhasthāṃcaṃ*??kitaśiroruhām pratyaṅgirā??nityaṃ sarvaśatruvināśinīm || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ siṃhaskaṃdhādhirūḍhā catasṛbhirasikheṭānvitābhiḥ parītākanyābhirbhinna daityābhavatu bhavabhayadhvaṃsinīśūlinīnaḥ || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ ghorāṃghorāṭṭahāsāṃkarakalitakapālāsiraudrāṃ triṇetrāṃ śatrūṇāṃ prāṇahaṃtrīṃ śaśiśiśumakuṭāṃ bhāvayeddhūmrakālām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ jagajjaitrīṃ japāraktāṃdevīṃvaśyamukhīṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ kharvānīlaviśālapiṃgalajaṭājūṭogranāgairvṛtā jāḍyaṃ nyasyakapālake trijagatāṃhaṃtyugratārāsvayam || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ tamālaśyāmalākārāśyāmakaṃcukadhāriṇī paritobhrāmyati munemaṇinaukādhirohiṇī || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥ yāṃsuvāmālinīmāhuryāmāhuramṛteśvarīm īṣadālokamātreṇa trailokyamadadāyinī pārijātaprasūnāsṛk parivītakacoccayā vāruṇītaraṇī śreṇīnāyikā tatra rājate || 4 || raktavarṇaḥ nīlakuṃcita keśāgrāṃnimnanābhīvalitrayām pītāṃbaravaropetāṃ bhūṣaṇasragvibhūṣitām śaṃkhacakragadābhīti ramyahastāṃtrilocanām sarvakāmapradāṃdevīṃ dhyāyet tāmaparājitām || nīlavarṇaḥ agnijvālāraudramukhī ghoradaṃṣṭrātrilocanā etai raviṣkṛtairghoraiśśīghramuccāṭayed dviṣaḥ || 2 || nīla?? ḍhakkāśūladharāṃ mahābalaripudhvaṃsāṃ kṛśāṃgīṃmahīṃ bhīmāṃgīṃ trijaṭāṃdavānalamayīṃ dhyāyetpinākistutām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ

kārtasvaramayāṃbhoja karṇikāmadhyasaṃsthitam cakraṃvirājate tatra taptakāṃcanasannibhā śaṃkhacakrābhayavarān halaṃ ca musalaṃ tathā vārāhavaktrasaṃyuktādaṃḍinī tatra vartate || 4 || kanakavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇāṃ svakarāṃbujairasilatāṃ carmāpipāśaṃsṛṇiṃ vārāhīmanu ciṃtayeddhayavarārūḍhāṃśubhālaṃkṛtim || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ śūlaṃkapālaṃmusalaṃnāgaṃ hastaistubibhratīm iṃdurekhālasanmauliṃ vārāhīṃtāmahaṃbhaje || nīlavarṇaḥ karasphuritavallakīṃ vimalaśaṃkhatāṭaṃkinīṃgha?nastanabharālasāṃgalita cūlikāṃśyāmalām || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ abjanyastaikacaraṇāṃ cārucaṃdrāvataṃsakām saugaṃdhikasrakkalikācūlikāṃ raktavāsasam vibhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ ca mātaṃgīṃ praṇamāmyaham || śyāmavarṇaḥ akṣasrakpustakābhītivarastātubālikā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ hāragraiveyakāṃcīgaṇigaṇavalayainsaṃyutāmaṃbarāḍhyāmādyāṃ pāśāṃkuśābhyāmabhayavarakarāṃ bhāvayedbhauvaneśīm || || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ pāśāhīṃdrāṃkuśagadākhaḍgaśūlavarābhayān raktāmaṣṭabhujāṃvaṃde phullapadmāsanāṃśubhām || raktavarṇaḥ triśūlaṃpānapātraṃ ca gadāṃ jihvāṃ ca vibhratīm pītāṃbarāṃmadāghūrṇāṃ dhyāyedbrahmāstradevatām || 2 || pītavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇāsṛkkapālaṃ trinayanalasitāpīnavakṣoruhāḍhyā devībālārkavarṇā bhavatu sukhakarīprāṇaśaktiḥ parānaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ cinmudrā'bhīti hastā ca śuddhavidyā sadāvatu || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ nānāvarṇamayenarāsthilulitesu vyaktamālādhare śrīvidyetvarite mahārtha mahite śrīśāṃkaritvāṃbhaje || 1 || citravarṇaḥ satatābhayavarahastāṃkalaye kāmapi kalādharāmaṃbām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇāṃśaśikhaṃḍaśobhimakuṭāṃ ratnāṃbarālaṃkṛtāṃvaṃdetāṃ vanaśaṃkarīṃtrinayanāṃ vāgīśaviṣṇustutām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ varṣābhāvavaśāddhatānmunigaṇāñśākena yā rakṣatātrailokyā jananīṃ maheśadayitāṃtāṃstaumiśākaṃbharīm || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ tatrotpannāṃsurāṃ devīṃ kanyakārūpadhāriṇīm śaṃkhaṃ khaḍgaṃdhanuścaiva kapālaṃmusalaṃ tathā

cakraṃmuṣṭiṃśaraṃ śūlaṃlohaṃ kheṭaṃ ca tomaram triṇetrāṃdīrghatanvaṃgīṃ kālāgnisadṛśīṃ bhajet gomūtrakṣīravarṇābhāṃ kṛṣṇarūpāṃparāṃsurām yā surāsāhyumādevī yomohassamaheśvaraḥ || 1 ||) citravarṇaḥ muktāvidyutpayodasphaṭikanavajapābaṃdhuraiḥ paṃcavaktrairūpakṣairvakṣojana mrāṃsakalaśaśinibhāṃ śāradāṃtāṃ namāmi || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ ardhendumaulimaruṇāmaraviṃdavāsāṃ varṇeśvarīṃ praṇamatastanabhāra namrām || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥ raktakaṃjaśiromālāṃ caṃdrarekhāvataṃsakām pāśekṣucāpamabhayaṃ kapālaṃpustakaṃ tathā dhārayaṃtīṃ dvādaśārddhadevīṃ tāṃ praṇamāmyaham || raktavarṇaḥ nidrānimīladbhuvanātiraskariṇikāvatu || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ devī nityaṃprasannāśaśadharavilasatkeśapāśātriṇetrā dadyādadyānavadyā sakalasukhakulaprāpti hṛdyāṃśriyaṃnaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ vāmahaste vajradharāṃ dakṣiṇenavarapradām prasannavadanāṃbhojāmapsarogaṇasevitām || 2 || pītavarṇaḥ devīṃ divyarasānnapūrṇakalaśāmaṃbhojadarvīkarāṃ dhyāyecchaṃkaravallabhāṃ trinayanāmabhrālakāṃsundarīm || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥ nikhilavibudhavṛṃdāvaṃdyapādāraviṃdāhyati śayitamaraṃdāmodamādyanmi lindā vikacakamalamālā yogisaṃgītaśīlāvasaturuciralīlācaṃdrikānaṃdabālā dhyāyecca varadāṃdevīṃ caṃdirāṃparameśvarīm || 3 || svarṇavarṇaḥ prasannāṃ padmakalhāravarābhayacaturbhujām dhvalāṃśukasaṃyuktāṃ padmāsananiṣeduṣīm || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ kumārīṃraktavastrāṃgīṃ raktasraganulepanām padmākṣamālāvalayaṃ vibhratīṃdakṣiṇekare abhayaṃvāmamaste ca padmapīṭhe pratiṣṭitām rasāyanāṃ ca bṛhatīṃgārhapatye pratiṣṭhitām || 4 || raktavarṇaḥ yuvatīṃśvetavastrāḍhyāṃ śuklasraganulepanām rudrākṣamālāvalayaṃ bibhratīṃdakṣiṇekare

vāmekare'bhayaṃ devīṃ tathaivārdhendudhāriṇīm mādhyaṃdinākhyasavanesatīṃgovṛṣavāhanām dakṣiṇāgni svarūpāṃtāṃ dhyāyennityaṃviśuddhadhīḥ || 2 || śuklavarṇaḥ sthavirendīvaraśyāmāṃ nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajām śaṃkhaṃcakraṃgadāṃ caiva tathaivābhayadaṃpunaḥ tṛtīyasavanākhyāṃ ca dhyāyedvai viṣṇurūpiṇīm varadāṃgaruḍārūḍhāmāhavanīye vyavasthitām || 4 || śyāmavarṇaḥ raktāgīṃpīnatuṃgastanabharavilasattārahārāṃtriṇetrāṃ vaṃde pūrṇendubibapratinidhivadanāmaṃbikāmannapūrṇām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ nānālaṃkārayuktāṃsarasijanayanāmiṃdusaṃkrāṃtamūrtiṃdevīṃ pāśāṃkuśāḍhyāmabhayavarakarāmannapūrṇāṃ namāmi || 1 || sindūravarṇaḥ hastaiścakravarāsikheṭaviśiravāṃścāpāṃkuśau tarjanīṃbibhrāṇāmana lātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃdurgāṃtriṇetrāṃbhaje || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ mārjanīkalaśopetāṃśūrpālaṃkṛtamastakām || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ pāśāṃkuśauśaraṃcāpaṃdhārayaṃtīṃ trilocanām | sūryābhāṃ caṃdracūḍāṃcalopāmudrāṃbhajeśivām || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ divyarūpāṃbujakarāsarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ pṛthakcaturbhujākāryā devīsiṃhāsaneśubhā aṣṭapatraṃ mahābhāgākarṇikāyāṃsu saṃsthitā bṛhannālaṃkarekāryaṃtasyāścakamalaṃ śubham vāme'mṛtaghaṭaḥkāryastathā rājanmanoharaḥ āvarjitakaraṃkāryaṃ tatpṛṣṭe kuṃjaradvayam devyāśca mastake kāryaṃpadmaṃcāpimanoharam || svarṇavarṇaḥ lakṣmīvatsā tadā kāryā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā vāmordhve kheṭakaṃ caiva śrīphalaṃtadadhaḥkare vibhratīmastakeliṃgaṃpūjanīyā vibhūtaye || svarṇavarṇaḥ padmāsanasthāṃ kurvīta śriyaṃtrailokyamātaram || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ ūrdhvapadmadvayauhastau tathā padmāsane sthitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ dakṣiṇetvabhayaṃ bityuttare varadaṃ tathā || ūrūpadmadalākārauvīra śrīmurtilakṣaṇam || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ

pāśāṃkuśākṣasūtravarābhayagadāpadmapātrahastākāryā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ bījāpūraṃ kanakakalaśaṃ hemapadmaṃdadhānāmādyāṃ śaktiṃ sakalajananīṃ viṣṇuvāmāṃkasaṃsthām || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ sarasvatīsitāraktā prītiḥ śyāmanibhākṛtiḥ tuṣṭiḥ pītābhavetpuṣṭiśśyāmā devyastutāḥsmṛtāḥ padmadvayakarāścaiva varābhayakarāstutāḥ pāṇibhyāmaṇipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃbibhratīṃ saumyāṃratnanidhistha savyacaraṇāṃdhyāyet parāmaṃbikām || 1 || sindūravarṇaḥ muktāhāralasatpayodharanatāṃ netratrayollāsinīṃ vaṃdehaṃsurapūjitāṃharavadhūṃ raktāraviṃdasthitām || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ bījāpūreṣupāśāṃkuśamusaladhanussrakkapālānihastairbibhrāṇāmāna- tāṃgīṃ stanabharanamitāmaṃbikāmānamāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dīpaukaṃbuṃrathāṃgaṃkarasarasiruhairdhārayaṃtī jaṭāṃtassphūrjacchītāṃśukhaṃḍābhavatu bhayaharādevatā ca triṇetrā || 1 || citravarṇaḥ raktāṃgarāgavasanābharaṇāṃtriṇetrāṃ dhyāyecchivasya vanitāṃmada vihvalāṃgīm || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ siṃhaskaṃdhādhirūḍhāṃ tribhuvanamakhilaṃ tejasāpūrayaṃtīṃ dhyāyeddurgāṃ jayākhyāṃtridaśaparivṛtāṃsevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ graiveyāṃgadahārakuṇḍaladharāmākhaṃḍalādyaistutāṃ dhyāyedviṃdhya nivāsinīṃ śaśimukhīṃpārśvastha paṃcānanām || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ tarjanīṃtriśikhaṃdorbhyāṃdhārayaṃtīṃ bhayaṃkarīm || raktāṃdhyātvāravairbiṃbe prajapedayutaṃ manum mārayedacirādevaripūnbaṃdhusamanvitān || raktavarṇaḥ hastābjairdadhatīṃtriṇetravilasadvaktrāraviṃdaśriyaṃ devīṃ baddhahimāṃśuratnamakuṭāṃvaṃderaviṃdasthatām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ śrīpustakaṃ japavaṭīmamṛtāḍhyakuṃbhaṃ vyākhyāṃ ca hastakamalair- dadhatīṃtriṇetrām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ netrotpalaistribhiralaṃkṛtapadmavaktrāṃtvāṃhārabhārarucirāṃ tripurebhajaṃti || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ hastairvahaṃtīmaruṇāṃtriṇetrāmāsphālayaṃtīṃkaravallakīṃtām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ tāṭaṃkāṃgadamekhalāṃguṇaraṇanmaṃjīrabhābhūṣitāṃkairātīṃ varadābhayodyatakarāṃdevīṃtriṇetrāṃbhaje || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ laṃboṣṭhīkarṇikākarṇītailābhyaktaśarīriṇī vardhanmūrdhadhvajā kṛṣṇākālarātrirbhayaṃkarī || 2 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktāratnakuṃḍalamaṃḍitā dukūlavasanādevī netratrayasamanvitā dakṣiṇecākṣamālāṃ ca kuṃḍikāṃ vāmahastake vāgīśyākṛtirākhyatā || śvetavarṇaḥ

aṃkuśenākṣasūtreṇa pāśapustakadhāriṇīm sitenadarpaṇābhe navastreṇaparibhūṣitām jaṭākalāpasaṃyuktāṃpūrṇacaṃdranibhānanām kaṭakaissvarṇaratnāḍhyairmahāvalayabhūṣitām śabdabrahmamayīṃdhyā yeddhenuvāgīśvarīṃ parām || 5 || śvetavarṇaḥ nijakarakamalodyallekhinīpustaka śrīssakalavibhavasaṃghaiḥpātuvāgdevatānaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ hemaratnojjvalannakrakuṃḍalaṃ karṇamaṃḍanam sayauvanāsuramyāṃgīkuṃcitabhrūsuvibhramā śirasomaṃḍanaṃ śaṃkhacakrasīmaṃtapadmakam paṃkajaṃ śrīphalaṃ vāmedakṣiṇebibhratīparā mekhalākaṭisūtrāṃkā lakṣmīlakṣmīvivarddhinī || 5 || padmavarṇaḥ ādyaṣṭakaṃsuvarṇābhaṃ triśūlaṃḍamaruṃ tathā atha dvitīyakaṃ dhyāyedakṣamālāmathāṃkuśam jvālāṃśaktiṃgadāṃkuṃtaṃ dadhānaṃnīlavarṇakam khaḍgaṃkheṭaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ ca dadhānaṃ paraśuṃ tathā kuṃtaṃkheṭaṃ ca parighaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ tathaiva ca paṃcamāṣṭakametaddhiśvetaṃ syātsumanoharam pītaṃṣaṣṭhamṛṣīraktamaṣṭamaṃ ca taṭitprabham divyayogāmahāyogā siddhayogāmaheśvarī kaṃkālī raudravetālīhuṃkārībhuvaneśvarī phaṭkārīvīrabhadrā ca dhūmrākṣīkalahapriyā kāmākṣīcogracāmuṃḍābhīṣaṇātripurāṃtakā bhairavīhastinī krodhadurmukhīpretavāhinī asthinīcakriṇīgrāhākaṃkālībhuvaneśvarī śaṃkhinīpadminīkṣīrāhyasaṃdhā ca prahāriṇī

dhūrjaṭīmālinīghorākapālīviṣabhojinī catuṣṣaṣṭissamākhyātā yoginyovarasiddhidāḥ nāsāṃte phālamadhye ḍaphakaṭhasahite kaṃṭhamadhye svarāṇāṃ haṃkṣaṃ tattvārthayuktaṃ sakaladalagataṃ varṇarūpaṃnamāmi śarāsanaṃ varaṃdakṣedhatte vāmeśarābhayau || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dhatte khaṭvāṃ ca kheṭaṃ ca krameṇaivavarābhayau || 1 || śyāvarṇaḥ caṃdrahāsavarau dakṣe vāmedhattegadābhayau || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ śārikāṃ ca varaṃdakṣe vāmedhatteṃkuśābhayau || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ dakṣeśūlāṃkuśavarānvāme pāśagadābhayān || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ raktācaturbhujā dhattekhaḍgakheṭavarābhayān || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dakṣepāśavaraudhatte tathā vāmeṃkuśābhayau || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ śūlaṃpāśaṃvaraṃ dakṣevāme khaḍgagadābhayān dadhānāraktasiṃhasthākrūrālokabhayaṃkarī || śvetavarṇaḥ caturmukhāṣṭahasteyaṃ dhattestrāṇikaraiḥparaiḥ khaḍgaṃ kapālamusalābhayānpītāṃbarāśubhā || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ raktādaśabhujārdhena dakṣādikramaśaḥkaraiḥ vāmaiḥkaraiḥkhaḍgakheṭagadāśaktyabhayāṃstathā || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ raktāviṃśadbhujā siṃhavāhanāphālalocanā akṣasūtraṃ ca cinmudrāṃbhuśuḍīṃmudgaraṃ varam kapālaṃdahanaṃśoṣaṃdaṃḍaṃ caiva gadābhayau || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ mayūragāṣaḍbhujeyaṃ raktakeśaiśca saṃvṛtā vāmaiḥśaṃkhaṃgadāṃgurvīṃkarairdhatte'bhayaṃ tathā || 2 || śubhravarṇaḥ mayūragārkabāhussyāddhattedakṣeṃkuśaṃśaram vāmeśūlaṃ kārmukaṃ ca kheṭaṃmusalameva ca pustakaṃcābhayaṃ caiva sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarī || raktavarṇaḥ ekavaktrāvakranetrābhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇā

ṣaḍbhujārkakarairdhatte śūlaṃkhaḍgaṃvaraṃ tathā gadākheṭābhayānvāmedadhānā ca mahodarī || śyāmavarṇaḥ mahodarīmahāvyāghravaravāhanamāsthitā caturbhujāśūlapāśavarābhayakarāmatā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ raktāpītāmbarākrūratarakṣuvaravāhanā vāmeṃkuśa mahākheṭābhayāndhattekaraiḥkramāt || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ triśūlaṃ ca varaṃdakṣe vāmeṃkuśamathābhayam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ khākhyākhadyotinīkhaḍgavarābhayakarāmatā || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ dhūmrābhādakṣiṇe dhatteśūlaṃ cākṣaṃsruvaṃvaram vāme tu pustakaṃkuṃḍīṃkapālamabhayaṃkramāt || dhūmravarṇaḥ ṣaḍbhujāśūlakhaṭvāṃgavarān dakṣabhujaiḥ kramāt vāme khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭamabhayaṃśatrubhaṃjanī || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ ṣaḍānaneṣu cāpāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ khaḍgakheṭadharācākhyāvarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ triśūlaṃ kṣurikāṃpāśaṃkheṭaṃ ca dadhatīśubhā || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ caturbhujākhaḍgakheṭavarābhayakarānvitā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ pāśaṃvarābhayau dhattenakrasthāśubhadānṛṇām || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ triśūlāṃbujacinmudrābhayānvitakarāśubhā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ dhattemattamataṃgasthā pāṭalābhāsitāṃśukā || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ dhatte siṃhavarārūḍhā caika vaktrāruṇāmatā || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥ caturbāhuḥkukkuṭasthāvarābhayakarā ca sā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ taṭidgaurīkarairdhatte śūlaṭaṃkavarābhayān || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ ekavaktrāśūlaśaktivarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ ekavaktrākarairdhatte vīṇātaṃ trīvarābhayān || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ śārikāṃḍamaruṃdhatte vṛṣārūḍhāvarābhayau || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ

dhattebjaṃ śārikāvīṇāṃḍamarveṇa varābhayān || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥ vṛṣasthā śārikāmabjaṃkarairdhatte varābhayau || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ ekavaktrātaṭidgairīdhatte padmavarābhayān || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ dhattekaraiḥ paṃcavaktrāphullapadmāsanāruṇā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ phākhyāśukaiṇāsikheṭavarābhayadharāśarān pāśaṃcaḍamṛgaṃdhatte krameṇadaśabhiḥkaraiḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥ dhattekrameṇadaśabhiḥkaraiḥ pūrvavadāyudhān || 1 || babhruvarṇaḥ udyadravinibhādhatteśaracāpavarābhayān || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ vīṇāvādana tattvajñāvarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ śūlacāpeṣu pāśāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ paṃcāsyāṣṭakarairdhatte dakṣavāmakrameṇa sā || 1 || khaḍgakheṭāṃkuśagadāpāśaśūlavarābhayān || śyāmavarṇaḥ ṣaḍbhujāṃkuśaśūlāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ sphuṭapadmāsanādhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ sahasrapadmapīṭhasthā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā caturbhujākarairdhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || kanakavarṇaḥ pītāṃbarākarairdhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ pāṭalābhākarairdhatte cidaṃbujavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ pāṭalābhākarairdhatte cidaṃbujavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ ṣaḍbhujāṃkuśaśūlāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ paṃcāsyā pāṭalādhatte khaḍgaśūlavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ śrīnārāyaṇodevatā (śeṣasaṃhitāyām) nārāyaṇonīlotpaladalaprabhaḥ paṃkajāṃtaḥ sthitaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ śrībhūbhyāṃsahitaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ viṣṇurdevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) padmakiṃjalkavarṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ gadāpaṃkajaśaṃkhāridharaḥ madhusūdanodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) aruṇapaṃkajavarṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ cakraśaṃkhābjagadādharaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ trivikramodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) kālānalavarṇaḥ pītavāsāḥ padmadaṃḍāriśaṃkhadharaḥ sarvābharaṇayuktaḥ sthitaḥ vāmanodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) bālārkavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ ābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ

śrīdharodevatā pītavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ padmacakragadāśaṃkhadharaḥ bhūṣāyuktaḥ sthitaḥ hṛṣīkeśodevatā taḍidvarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ gadāripadmaśaṃkhadharaḥ bhūṣāyuktaḥ sthitaḥ padmanābhodevatā nīlotpalavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ śaṃkhacakrapadmagadādharaḥ bhūṣāyuktaḥ sthitaḥ dāmodarodevatā japāpuṣpavarṇaḥ padmaśaṃkhagadācakradharaḥ pītavastrābharaṇādiyuktaḥ sthitaḥ śaṃbhurdevatā triṇetraḥ aruṇavarṇaḥ jaṭāmakuṭadhārī abhayaparaśumṛgavarahastaḥ vyāghracarmadhārī nārāyaṇodevatā asitadyutiḥ śaṃkhapadmagadācakradharaḥ vanamālābharaṇādibhūṣitaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sthitaḥ mādhavodevatā dhavalavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ gadācakraśaṃkhāṃbujadharaḥ bhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ goviṃdodevatā pāṭalābhaḥ pītavāsāḥ cakradaṃḍābjaśaṃkhadharaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ vāsudevodevatā ghanaśyāmaḥ pītavastraḥ padmacakraśaṃkhagadādharaḥ bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ saṃkarṣaṇodevatā raktavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ gadāśaṃkhābjacakradharaḥ bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ pradyumnodevatā kanatkanakavarṇaḥ cakraśaṃkhagadāpadmadharaḥ bhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ aniruddhodevatā dūrvādalaśyāmaḥ pītavāsāḥ cakragadāśaṃkhapadmadharaḥ bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ vidhirdevatā caturmukhaḥ hemavarṇaḥ varābhayakuṃḍikākṣasūtrakaraḥ mukhyahastayorvarābhayadharaḥ anyayoḥkuṃḍikākṣasūtradharaḥ jaṭāmaṃḍaladharaḥ sukhāsīnaḥ sudarśanodevatā agnijvālāvarṇaḥ ṣaṭkoṇasaṃsthaḥ śaṃkhacakracāpaparaśvasīṣuśūlapāśāṃkuśābja vajrakheṭahalamusalagadā kuṃtāyudhadharaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ jvālākeśaḥ sthitaḥ vāṇīdevatā sphaṭikavarṇā akṣamālāpadmaśukapustakadharā prādakṣiṇyena sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā śārṅgadhārīdevatā hemanibhaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ vāmahastenakaṭimavalaṃbya sthitaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥ sthitaḥ naṃdakodevatā dūrvādalaśyāmaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥ naṃdakodevatā śeṣaṃ pūrvavat yamodevatā kālavarṇaḥ abhayadaṃḍapāśavarahastaḥ mahiṣārūḍhaḥ karālavadanaḥ musalīdevatā sasyaśyāmaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ mastake svahnāṃkitaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ aṃkuśadhārīdevatā hemavarṇaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ bhṛgurdevatā dūrvādalaśyāmaḥ dakṣiṇahaste vijñānamudrāṃ vāme pustakaṃ ca dadhānaḥ upavītajaṭādibhiryuktaḥ kūrmodevatā kāṃcanasannibhaḥ abhayacakraśaṃkhavaradahastaḥ pītāṃbaradharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ paṭṭābhirāmodevatā śyāmavarṇaḥ pīṭhe madhyesukhāsīnaḥ tadvāme hemavarṇāsītāpurataḥ kanakavarṇo hanumān paścime hemavarṇolakṣmaṇaḥ pārśvayoḥ śyāmavarṇo bharataḥ raktavarṇaḥ śatrughnaśca vāyavye hemapiṅgalaḥ sugrīvaḥ kālavarṇovibhīṣaṇaḥ raktavarṇoṃgadaḥ kanakavarṇo jāṃbabān etaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ garuḍodevatā kāṃcanaprabhaḥ kuṃcitadakṣiṇapādaḥ pṛṣṭhenikṣipta vāmapādaḥ prasāritobhayapakṣaḥ hṛdibaddhāṃjalipuṭaḥ nānābharaṇabhuṣitaḥ

saptamātṛkādevatāḥ tatra brāhmīhemavarṇā abhayaśūlākṣamālāvarahastā jaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇī haṃsadhvajavāhanā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā māheśvarī raktābhā abhayaśūlākṣamālāvarahastā jaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇā vṛṣabhadhvajavāhanā kaumārī aruṇaprabhā abhayaśaktikukkuṭavarahastā mayūradhvajavāhanā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā vaiṣṇavī śyāmā abhayaśaṃkhacakravarahastāgaruḍadhvajavāhanā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā vārāhī śyāmavarṇā varāhamukhī aṣṭabhujā dakṣiṇāditaḥ abhayamusalakhaḍgacakraśaṃkhakheṭahalavaradharā siṃhārūḍhā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā māheṃdrī raktavarṇā caturbhujā abhayaśaktivajravarahastā gajadhvajavāhanā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā cāmuṃḍā raktavarṇā caturbhujā abhayakapālaśūlavarahastā vyāghracarmāṃbaradharā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā viṣṇurdevatā padmakiṃjalkanibhaḥ caturbhujaḥ padmagadācakraśaṃkhadharaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ acyutodevatā pītavarṇaḥ caturbhujaḥ śaṃkhapadmacakragadādharaḥ śrībhūsahitaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ puruṣottamodevatā cakrapadmaśaṃkhagadādharaḥ caturbhujaḥ sphaṭikavarṇaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ atrirdevatā aruṇaprabhaḥ jaṭāvān āsīnaḥ dakṣiṇe jñānamudrāṃ vāme pustakaṃ ca dadhānaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ kuberodevatā sitaprabhaḥ dvibhujaḥ padmakhalīnahastaḥ turaṃgārūḍhaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ laṃbodarodevatā aruṇaprabhaḥ caturbhujaḥ bhagnadaṃtapāśāṃkuśamahāphalahastaḥ gajavaktraḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ yoganṛsiṃhodevatā hemanibhaḥ jānūpariprasāritamukhyabāhudvayaḥ itarābhyāṃ cakraśaṃkhadharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ bhīmanṛharirdevatā taptakāṃcanasannibhaḥ caturbhirbāhubhiścatuścakrāṇi dadhānaḥ jvālākeśadharaḥ daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ balarāmodevatā sitaprabhaḥ dvibhujaḥ dakṣiṇehaladharaḥ pralaṃbavāmahastaḥ nīlāṃbaradharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ pūrvoktayoganṛsiṃhodevatā anyatsarvaṃ pakāravat nārāyaṇodevatā śyāmavarṇaḥ padmāsanasthaḥ caturbhujaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrībhūbhyāṃsahitaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ vāyurdevatā dhūmravarṇaḥ dvibhujaḥ aṃkuśadhvajahastaḥ hariṇārūḍhaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ dhūmadhvajodevatā aruṇavarṇaḥ dakṣiṇe caturhastaḥ vāmetrihastaḥ prādakṣiṇyena sruksruvākṣamālāśaktitomaravyajanaghṛtapātradharaḥ tripād dviśīrṣaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ iṃdrodevatā meghaśyāmaḥ caturbhujaḥ abhayavajraśaṃkhavarahastaḥ gajārūḍhaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ varuṇodevatā śyāmalaḥ dvibhujaḥ makaravāhanārūḍhaḥ dakṣiṇe pāśahastaḥ vāme'bhayapradaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ umādevatā śyāmavarṇā dvibhujā dakṣiṇe padmadharā pralaṃbavāmahastā caṃdrakalāvataṃ sā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā lakṣmīrdevatā kāṃcanaprabhā padmāsanāsīnā caturbhujā abhayapadmadvayavarahastā gajadvayasamuddhṛtakuṃbhāmṛtābhiṣiktā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā candrodevatā sphaṭikasannibhaḥ siṃhāsanesamāsīnaḥ dvibhujaḥ kumudadvayadhārī śyāmayā dhṛtakumudayā rohiṇyā sahitaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ

sūryodevatā raktavarṇaḥ prabhāmaṃḍalamadhye'ṣṭadalapadma āsīnaḥ dvibhujaḥ padmadvayadharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ sūryodevatā anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat pūrvoktabhīma nṛsiṃhodevatā anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavat śrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpā pratimavīranarapatibiru deṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukulapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkha cakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāha hanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyaneka birudāṃkitamahīśūrapuravarādhīśa kṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe cāmuṃḍādi śaktisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃnāmaprathamonidhiḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ mahātalaṃviśvasṛjassugulphau talātalaṃ vai puruṣasyajaṃghe mahītalaṃtajjaghanaṃ mahīpatenabhasthalaṃnābhisarogṛṇaṃti tapolalāṭaṃvidurādipuṃsassatyaṃ ca śīrṣāṇisahasraśīrṣṇaḥ nāsatyadasrauparamasyanāse ghrāṇaṃ ca gaṃdhomukhamagniriddhaḥ tadbhrūvijṛṃbhaḥ parameṣṭhidhiṣṇyamāposyatālūrasa eva jihvā hāsojanonmādakarī ca māyā duraṃtasargoyadapāṃgamokṣaḥ kastasya meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇau ca mitraḥkukṣissamudrāgirayosthi saṃghāḥ annaṃ ca vīryaṃśvasitaṃ mātariśvāgatirvayaḥ karmaguṇapravāhaḥ avyaktamāhurhṛdayaṃ manaśca sa caṃdramāssarvavikārakośaḥ aśvāśvataryuṣṭragajānakhāni sarve mṛgāḥ paśavaḥśroṇideśaḥ gaṃdharvavidyādharacāraṇāpsarassvarāḥ smṛtirhyasurānīkavaryaḥ svāhāsvadhāvīryaguṇopapannohavyātmakaḥ karmavitānayogaḥ saṃdhāryatesmin vapuṣisthaviṣṭhe manassvabuddhyānayato stikiṃcit || 13 vimāneśu śubhedivye saṃsthito bhagavānhariḥ nānāratnamaye divye nānāratnasamanvite karṇikāyāṃsuramyāyāṃ lakṣmībīje śubhākṣare divyonārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānāsīnaḥ paṃkajāsane sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannādivyābharaṇabhūṣitā vāmataḥpṛthivīdevīnīlotpaladalaprabhā vahāsāhyūrdhvabāhubhyāṃ ramyaṃraktotpaladvayam gṛhītacāmarā divyāśaktayovimalādayaḥ

tāsāṃ madhye samāsīnobhagavānacyutohariḥ keyūrāṃgadahārādyairbhūṣaṇairupaśobhitaḥ pūrvoktaistridaśairnityaṃ sevitaḥpuruṣottamaḥ śrīmadaṣṭākṣarairmaṃtraiḥ siddhānāṃ vai manīṣiṇām gamanaṃ vaiṣṇave lokenetareṣāṃ kathaṃcana || raktavarṇaḥ devadevastu kartavyaḥ śeṣasuptodvibāhukaḥ || ekapādosyakartavyolakṣmyutsaṃgagataḥprabhoḥ ekaḥ karosyakartavyaḥ savyajānauprasāritaḥ nābhīsaṃbhūtakamale sukhāsīnaḥ pitāmahaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādīnimūrtāniparito nyaset || 4 || meghavarṇaḥ maṇimukuṭavicitrālaṃkṛtā kalpajātairbhavatu bhuvanamātāsaṃtataṃśrīśśriyainaḥ || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ dāḍimīphalasaṃyuktā vāmekalpataroradhaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyā dhyeyāsarvaphalapradā || 2 || svarṇavarṇaḥ caturbhujāsukhāsīnāvarābhayakarānvitā sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā nīlādevīsamīritā || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ paścādbāhudvayena pratibhaṭaśamane dhārayañchaṃkha cakredevī bhūṣādijuṣṭo janayati jagatāṃśarmavaikuṃṭhanāthaḥ || 1 || meghavarṇaḥ agre vācayati prabhaṃjanasute tattvaṃ munibhyaḥ paraṃvyākhyāṃ taṃ bharatādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ rāmaṃbhajeśyāmalam || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakravarābhītilasat pāṇistrayīmayaḥ kālarūpī sadādhyeyobhaktābhīṣṭapradohariḥ || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥ kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṃḍalaiśca virājate madhuvratasragvanamālayāvṛtorarājarājanbhagavānurukramaḥ padaṃdvitīyātkramatastriviṣṭapaṃnavai tṛtīyasyatadīyamaṇvapi urukramasyāṃghriruparyadhodivomaharjanābhyāṃtapasaḥ paraṃgataḥ || raktavarṇaḥ aṃḍāṃtaraṃbahirapi pratibhāsayaṃtaṃ śaṃkhākṣapustakasubodhayutābjabāhum amlānaśrīramṛtaviśadairaṃśubhiḥ plāvayanmāmāvirbhūyādanaghamahi māmānasevāgadhīśaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ dhyeyonijaiśca tanubhissakalairupetaḥ koloharissakalavāṃchitasiddhayenaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ

śeṣaścaturbhujaḥ kāryaścāruratnaphaṇānvitaḥ sarparūpaśca kartavyastathaiva racitāṃjaliḥ vāmāratnigatā tasya yoṣidrūpāvasuṃdharā yasminbhujedharādevī tatra śaṃkhaḥkarebhavet padmāsanasthāṃ kurvītaśriyantrailokyamātaram raukmapadmakaravyagrāṃvaradāṃ dakṣiṇena tu varāhaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ || bhūmiśśuklavarṇā || śrīssuvarṇavarṇā || śeṣaśśubhravarṇaḥ ciṃtyaḥkarābhyāṃ vasutarpayansasvāṃkastha lakṣmīrgaruḍāṃsasaṃsthaḥ || 1 || kāṃcanavarṇaḥ śaṃkhāridordvayamudarkamaheṃdubiṃbātsaṃsicyamānamamṛtenaramādhinātham || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥ dorbhyāṃdadhānamakhilaiśca suraissametaṃ śītāṃśumaṃḍalagataṃ ramayāsametam || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakradharaṃdevaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam dhanurbāṇasamāyuktaṃ ciṃtayet puruṣottamam || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥ bibhrāṇaṃpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃlakṣmyāliṃgitavigraham siṃhavaktraṃmahākāyaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃhṛdibhāvayet || śvetavarṇaḥ śuklāṃbaradharassaumyomuktābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ dakṣiṇordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥ karegadā dakṣādhaḥkarepadmaṃ śuklāṃbaraḥ muktābharaṇaḥ kāryaḥ || svarṇavarṇaḥ pītavāsāmaṇimayairbhūṣaṇairuttamairvṛtaḥ dakṣiṇādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣordhvakarepadmaṃ vāmoccakare gadā vāmādhaḥkarecakram || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ citramālyāṃbaradharaḥ puṃḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣordhvakarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ raktāraviṃdanayanastaptakāṃcanabhūṣaṇaḥ vāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣordhvakare gadā vāmoccakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥ hemāṃbaradharassragvīkeyūrāṃgadabhūṣitaḥ vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā dakṣordhvakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥ śaṃkhaṃcakraṃgadāṃpadmaṃdorbhirnityaṃbibhartyasau

dakṣordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarepadmaṃ vāmādhaḥ karegadā dakṣādhaḥkarecakram || raktavarṇaḥ kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṃḍalaiśca virājate vāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkare padmaṃ dakṣodhrvakare gadā vāmordhvakare cakram || raktavarṇaḥ dorbhiśśaṃkhaṃgadāṃ cakraṃ padmaṃ caiva bibhartyasau dakṣādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ dakṣoccakare cakraṃ vamoccakare gadā vāmādhaḥkare padmam || śvetavarṇaḥ śrīdharaḥ puṃḍarīkābhaḥcakraśaṃkhagadābjabhṛt | raktāraviṃdanayanomuktādāmavibhūṣitaḥ vidyudvarṇohṛṣīkeśaścakraśaṃkhagadābjabṛt || raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥpuṃḍarīkāvataṃsakaḥ vāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā dakṣodhrvakarecakraṃ vāmordhvakarepadmam || kanakavarṇaḥ iṃdranīlanibhaścakraśaṃkhapadmagadādharaḥ || pdmanābhaḥpītavāsāścitramālyānulepanaḥ dakṣādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣodhrvakarepadmaṃ vāmordhvakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥkaregadā || nīlavarṇaḥ dāmodaraśśādvalābhogadāpadmāriśaṃkhabhṛt || pītavāsāviśālākṣonānāratnavibhūṣitaḥ dakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakaregadā vāmādhaḥ karecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkarepadmam || dūrvāśyāmavarṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇassitodhatte śaṃkhapadmārisadgadāḥ || dakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarepadmaṃ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadhā || śvetavarṇaḥ dakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā || śvetavarṇaḥ dakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakaregadā vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkarecakram || kanakavarṇaḥ aniruddhonīlavarṇaḥ śaṃkhapadmagadāribhṛt || vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣocca karegadā || nīlavarṇaḥ vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkaregadā dakṣādhaḥcakraṃ dakṣoccakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥ vāmordhvakare śaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣodhrvakaregadā || nīlavarṇaḥ vāmādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣordhvakarepadmaṃ vāmordhvakaregadā || śvetavarṇaḥ vāmādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā dakṣordhvakarepadmaṃ vāmoccakare cakram || kanakavarṇaḥ vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkaregadā dakṣādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣodhrvakarecakram || raktavarṇaḥ dakṣādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣodhrvakaregadā vāmoccakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥkarepadmam || nīlavarṇaḥ dakṣādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣordhvakarecakraṃ vāmoccakarepadmaṃ vāmādhaḥkaregadā || kanakavarṇaḥ nārāyaṇaśśyāmavarṇomādhavaḥ sphaṭikaprabhaḥ aruṇāṃbujasaṃkāśomadhusūdana ucyate

śrīdharaḥpītavarṇābho hṛṣīkeśastaṭitprabhaḥ dāmodarodvādaśaite kathitāḥ keśavādayaḥ sa eva vāsudevādicaturṇāṃ tadbhuvāmapi śuddhasphaṭikaśaṃkāśovijñeyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || adhokṣajaśśyāmavarṇonṛsiṃhohemasannibhaḥ upeṃdraśśyāmalaḥ proktohariḥ pītanibhaḥ smṛtaḥ satuśuklavapuḥ kāryonīlavāsāyadūttamaḥ gadāsthāne ca musalaṃcakrasthāne calāṃgalam || śvetavarṇaḥ yogamūrdhordhrva śaṃkhaśca dakṣeśārṅgadharassmṛtaḥ dhārayeduttare cakra dakṣiṇe ca gadāmiti || śvetavarṇaḥ cakramūrdhve tathā vāme gadāṃdadyādadhaḥkare || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ dhanuḥ kheṭadharaṃ vīramaniruddhaṃ pracakṣate || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ || 1 narāṃghrirmatsyarūpo vā matsyarūpījanārdanaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ kūrmastu kacchapākāromatsyarūpoktarūpavān || svarṇavarṇaḥ narāṃgaṃsūkarāsyaṃ ca manākpīnaṃsubhīṣaṇam etadrūpadharaṃ vaṃdevarāhaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ lolajihvāsubhīṣaṇam abhedyatīkṣṇanakharamātmoru kṛtadānavam gadācakradharaṃ dvābhyāṃnṛsiṃhaṃ praṇametprabhum || 3 || śvetavarṇaḥ kuṃḍīcchatradharodvābhyāṃ vāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ jāmadagnyaśva kartavyorāmaśśatruniṣūdanaḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ ājānubāhuḥkartavyorāmo bāṇadhanurdharaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ gadāmusalavajraṃ ca halīrāmaḥ dadhatsitaḥ musalarūpaṃvajramityarthaḥ || kṣīravarṇaḥ padmāsanasthodvibhujodhyeyo buddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ

mlecchacchedakaraḥ kalkīdvibhujaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakradharaḥ śyāmodvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃjñakaḥ || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 11 varāhaśśyāmalanibhodhvalākṛtireva vā vāmanaśśyāmalanibhokālavarṇo mahābalaḥ bharataśśyāmalaḥ proktaḥ lakṣmaṇaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ p. 56) māṃḍavīraktavarṇābhācormilāśyāmalākṛtiḥ śrutakīrtissitāṃgī syāddhanūmānkanakaprabhaḥ || aṃgadoraktavarṇābhassugrīvohemapiṃgalaḥ guhastuti lavarṇābhaḥ kālavarṇovibhīṣaṇaḥ meghaśyāmobhavet kṛṣṇorukmiṇī kanakaprabhā dakṣiṇe tu gadāpadmī nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ vāme śrīrvallakī hastāpuṣṭāpadmakarāpare || śyāmavarṇaḥ dhyeyassadā savitṛmaṃḍalamadhyavartī nārāyaṇassarasijāsanasanniviṣṭaḥ || keyūravānmakarakuṃḍalavānkirīṭīhārī hiraṇmayavapuḥ dhṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ vaṃdehaṃ krūraghoraprabalataramahāgaṃḍabheruṃḍa siṃhavyāghrāścakroḍaśākhāmṛgavarakhagarāṅbhallukādyaṣṭavaktram | dvātriṃśatkotibāhuṃhalamusalagadā śaṃkhacakrādihetīrvibhrāṇaṃ bhīmadaṣṭraṃśarabhakhagagajānbhakṣayaṃtaṃ nṛsiṃham śarīre raktavarṇaḥ mukheṣu tattadvarṇāḥ vajrasamānatuṃḍanakharaṃdaṃṣṭridvijihvānanam hṛdayajaṭharagāhyaṣṭakālyaṣṭadurgā || ūrūdvaurudrakālaukhagamṛganṛharirgaṃḍabherūpaḥpāyādasmān sa cakroharirihaśarabhādyugraśatrūnpravidhyan bāhudvaṃdvoparuddhāsuraka ca caraṇaṃdoryugodyannakhāgrapracchannārāti dehaṃraviśaśidahanatrīkṣaṇaṃvajrapakṣam hairaṇyāṃtraṃtriśūlaṃ phalakamapi mahāpāśaśīrṣaṃpinākaṃ vajraṃkaumodakīṃ cāpyatibalamasalaṃsaṃdadhānaṃ karāgraiḥ śarīreraktavarṇaḥ mukheṣu tattadvarṇāḥ muṃḍamālādharaṃraudraṃkaṃṭhahāreṇaśobhitam caṃdramauliṃnilakṃṭhaṃ prativaktraṃtrilocanam akṣasūtraṃgadāṃpadmaṃśaṃkhaṃgokṣīrasannibham khaḍgaṃ ca śūlapāśau ca nṛsiṃhaṃrudrarūpiṇam iṃdragopakanīlābhaṃ caṃdrābhaṃ svarṇasannibham || pūrvādimottarāṃtāsyamūdhrvāsyaṃ sarvavarṇakam bibhrāṇaṃ sarvajagatāmādhāraṃ girikanyake || śarīreraktavarṇaḥ || mukheṣuvarṇānāṃ paṃcakam

dorbhiḥkhaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃḍamarumasidhanurdaṃḍabāṇaṃ kuṭhāraṃśaṃkhaṃcakraṃ kṛpāṇaṃhalamusalagadābhiṃḍivālaṃ ca pāśam || udyadbāhuṃ ca muṣṭiṃhyabhayavarakaraṃbibhrataṃ śuklavarṇaṃ vaṃderāmaṃtriṇetraṃtvamararipu kulaṃmardayaṃtaṃpratāpaiḥ || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥ sugrīvaśca vibhīṣaṇaśca yuvaraṭtārāsutojāṃbavānmadye nīlasarojakomalarucaṃrāmaṃbhajeśyāmalam || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ navāmrapallavābhāsaṃpiṃgabhrūśmaśrulocanam || dakṣiṇodhrvakarepadmaṃśaṃkhaṃ tasyāpyadhaḥkare bhibhrataṃ puṃḍarikākṣaṃ phaṇāsaptānvitaṃbhaje || 2 || gomūtravarṇaḥ vanya srajekabalavetraviṣāṇaveṇu lakṣmaśriye mṛdupadepaśupāṃgajāya || 1 || nīlvarṇaḥ aṃgulyagraistanaṃcānyaṃ spṛśaṃ taṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ yaśodāṃkasthitaṃ gopaṃdhyāyet putrapradaṃsadā śaṃkhacakragadā padmapāśāṃkuśasumāśugān ṣoḍaśacchadapadmastha ṣaṭkoṇoparisaṃsithataḥ svarapatrastha gopībhirādarādīkṣitovatāt || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ jvālākeśaṃ triṇetraṃ jvaladanalanibhaṃhārakeyūrabhūṣaṃ dhyāyet ṣaṭkoṇasaṃsthaṃ sakalaripujanaḥprāṇasaṃhāracakram || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ tiryagjvālāgnirūpaṃ jvalitaśikhiśikhottuṃgakeyūra bāhuṃpiṃgākṣaṃdīpta jihvāṃdaśaśatavilasattīkṣṇadhārātiraudram || śārṅgacakrābjaśaṃkhānśaramusaladharaṃ sarvaśatrūndahaṃtaṃ ṣaṭkoṇābhyaṃtarasthaṃ raviniyutanibhaṃ cakrarājaṃprasannam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ caturbhirbhujaistarjanī śaṃkhacakragadādadhānaḥ pīṭhādhastātprasāritadakṣiṇapādaḥ ākuṃcitavāmapādaḥ kirīṭādi sarvālaṃkārabhūṣito viṣvaksenaḥ || śyāmavarṇaḥ sphaṭikābhaṃsvarṇakāṃtiṃ dvibhūjaṃ ca kṛtāṃjalim || kuṃḍaladvayasaṃśobhimukhāṃbujamahaṃbhaje || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ kapivaktraṃsu tejasam asyaikaṃdakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nārasiṃhaṃ mahādbhutam paścime gāruḍaṃvaktraṃ vakratuṃḍaṃmahādyuti uttaraṃsaukaraṃ vaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃdīptaṃ śikhojjvalam ūrddhvaṃhayānanaṃ ghoraṃdānavāṃtakaraṃ param drumagomudrikāmuṃḍaṃdadhānaṃsuravaṃditam || 6 || svarṇavarṇaḥ savyajānugatobhūmaumūrdhnā ca phaṇimaṃḍitaḥ dvibāhuḥ pakṣayuktaśca kartavyovinatāsutaḥ || 2 || suvarṇavarṇaḥ nānākalpavibhūṣaṇaḥkara sahasrārdhāttabāṇāsanobāṇāttārdhasahastrabāhuraniśaṃbhūvallabhonaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ || sahasrabāhuṃsaśaraṃsacāpaṃ raktāṃbaraṃ ratnakirīṭakuṃḍalam || corādiduṣṭāmayanāśamiśṭaṃ dhyāyen mahāṃtaṃbhuvikārtavīryam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ aṣṭabāhuḥ prakartavyośaṃkhapadmavibhūṣitaḥ

ratiḥprītistathā śaktirbhedaśaktistathojjvalā catvāraścakarāstasya kāryābhāryāstanopagāḥ kāmaṃkāṃcana saṃnibhamiti saivāgame || svarṇavarṇaḥ maṃdāramūle maṇimaṃṭapasthitaṃ suvarṇadānaikanibaddhadīkṣam || dhyāyetparītaṃnavanāthasiddhairdāridryadā vānalakālameghaiḥ vyākhyāmudrāṃkarasarasijedakṣiṇe saṃdadhānojānunyastāvarakarasarojātavāmonnatāṃsaḥ || dhyānādhārātsukhaparavaśādardhamāmīlitākṣodattātreyobhasita dhavalaḥ pātunaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ nāgaṃ pāśaṃ ca ghaṃṭāṃ pralayahutavahaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ vāmabhāge nānālaṃkārayuktaṃsphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ pārvatīśaṃ namāmi || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ pṛthak caturbhujākāryā devī siṃhāsane śubhā aṣṭapatraṃ mahābhāgākarṇikāyāṃsu saṃsthitā bṛhannālaṃkare kāryaṃ tasyāśca kamalaṃśubham vāmemṛtaghaṭaḥ kāryastathā rājanmanoharaḥ tasyā anyaukaraukāryaubilvaśaṃkhadharāviti || marakatavarṇaḥ astimerorudagbhāge mahānkailāsaparvataḥ saṃvāsoyojanānāṃ ca viṃśatkoṭibhirāyataḥ navaratnamayaṃ tasyamadhye śikharamuttamam prākāragopurāṭṭālavalabhībhirvirājitam praphullakamalollāsa paṃcaviṃśanmukhojjvalaḥ phullaraktāṃbujātta śrīnābhyaṃghriyugalojjvalaḥ anekakoṭisūryābhaḥ paramānaṃdavigrahaḥ yatovāconivartaṃte aprāpyamanasāsaha bhasmoddhūlita sarvāṃgovyālajñopavītavān prativaktraṃ trinayanobhakta sarvarthasiddhidaḥ abhayaṃ cakraśūle caṭaṃkabāṇaugadāṃbhuje halāṃkuśākṣamālāśca cchurikāṃdhvajadaṃḍakau vajrakuṃtāsthi daṃṣṭrāścakrakacaṃbhiṃḍīvālakaṃ || paṃcaviṃśatibhirhastairdadhānodakṣiṇaiśśubhaiḥ mudgaraṃḍamaruṃ ghaṃkṭāṃ rudravīṇāṃ ca pustakam

phalakaṃpaṭta saṃvetraṃkamaṃḍaluhutāśanau mahān sadāśivassoyaṃrājate tatra parvate || 16 || śvetavarṇaḥ jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ triṇetraṃ caṃdraśekharam dadhānamasthibāṇau ca gadāṃpadmaṃ kapālakam khaṭvāṃgaṃparaśuṃ caiva dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ nāgamagniṃ mṛgaṃ ghaṃṭāṃdhanuśca kaṭihastakam etadāyudhasaṃyuktaṃ ruṃḍamālāvibhūṣitam nīlavarṇaḥ śūlaṃkapālamabhayavaraudadhatamiṣṭadam ahibhūṣita sarvāṃgaṃtamaghoramupāsmahe || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥ śyāmakaṃcukadhārī ca madāruṇavilocanaḥ mahākālīṃ ghanaśyāmāmanaṃgārdrāmapāṃgayan kālamṛtyumukhairyuktassarvalokaika bhakṣakaḥ vitanvaṁllalitābhakteṣvāyuṣo dīrghadīrghatām || 4 || nīlavarṇaḥ caṃdravarṇaṃsravaddivyāmṛta caṃdrakalādharam amṛtāpūrṇakanakakalaśāptakaradvayaṃ nānābharaṇasaṃbhūṣaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam bhasmānulepinaṃ rudraṃ mṛtyuṃjayamimaṃ smaret || 4 || śubhravarṇaḥ akṣamalāṃ ca śūlaṃ ca kapālaṃ dadhataṃkaraiḥ triṇetramabjanilyaṃbālārka sadṛśaprabham || sādhakābhīṣṭadātāraṃ nīlakaṃṭhamahaṃbhaje || 2 || aruṇavarṇaḥ nīlakaṃṭhaṃsarpabhūṣaṃ vyāghracarmāṃbarāvṛtam caṃdragaṃgājaṭājūṭaṃrūdraṃtaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥ bhṛṃgīnāradabāṇabhairava gajāsyaskaṃda vīreśvarāmadhyeśubhra sarojakomalarucaṃ śaṃbhuṃbhajepāṃḍuram || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ nṛtyaṃtamādipuruṣaṃ śaśiśekharaṃtaṃ devāḥ pradoṣasamayenubhajaṃti sarve gākautuṃburunāradausamurajaunaṃdī kumārastathā rudronṛttakarassvabhāvajanitaṃnāṭyaṃ sadāpātunaḥ || 1 || gauravarṇaḥ

tryakṣaścaturvaktra-uruprabhāvassadyodhijātovatumāṃ pratīcyām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ trīlocanaścārucaturmukhomāṃ pāyādudīcyāṃdiśivāmadevaḥ || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ caturmukhonīlarucistriṇetraḥ pāyādaghorodiśidakṣiṇasyām || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ caturmukhastatpuruṣastriṇetraḥ prācyāṃ sthitorakṣatu māmajasram || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ sitadyutiḥ paṃcamukhovatānmāmīśāna-urdhvaṃparamaprakāśaḥ || 1 || śvetavrṇaḥ || 1 gauravarṇasamāyuktaṃ barhipiṃchasamanvitam dakṣiṇe svajaṭāgre tu jāhnavyāparimaṃḍitam sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktamupavīta samanvitam prasāritabhujaṃ vāmedakṣiṇe'bhayahastakam vakraṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃpādamapasmāroparisthitam ānaṃdatāṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥ abhayaṃ ḍamaruṃsavye vāme piṃchaṃsavismayam ūdhrve tu dakṣiṇaṃpādamapasavyānugaṃdadham saṃdhyātāṃḍavamevaṃ syād || varṇādikaṃ pūrvavat gaurāṃgaṃṣaḍbhujopetamabhayaṃ damaruṃ tathā gajahastopamaṃ hastaṃsavyapārśvānugaṃdadham uddhṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaṃpādaṃ vāmapādānugaṃ tathā sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyakam umātāṃḍavamatrom || śiṣṭaṃpūrvavat karoṭiṃbakapuṣpaṃ ca dhuttūraṃ cārkapuṣpakam sarpakaṃkaṇasaṃyuktamapasmāroparisthitam savyedadhānamabhayamanyasmin ḍamaruṃkare vāmegaurī samāyuktamavāme naṃdikeśinam vāme maulisamāyuktaṃśeṣaṃ prathamanṛttavat gaurītāṃḍavamityuktam || raktavarṇaḥ

bhujāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ savyapādaṃ samuddhṛtam abhayaṃ śūlapāśaṃ ca ḍamaruṃdakaṣiṇekare gajahastopamaṃhastaṃ prasṛtaṃdakṣiṇānugam kālikātaṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥ skaṃdaṃdakṣiṇapārśve tu savyahaste dhṛtāṃjalim pāśaṃṭaṃkaṃ tathā daṃḍaṃnāgaṃ vai dakṣiṇekare analaṃ pustakaṃ caiva varadaṃ ketukheṭakam sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śeṣaṃprathamanṛttavat traipuraṃtāṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥ kuṃcitaṃ vāmapādaṃtamapasmāroparisthitam abhayaṃśūlapāśau ca ḍamaruṃdakṣiṇekare gajahastopamaṃ vāme caturdorbhissamanvitam naṃdīśaṃ savyabhāge tu vāmegaurīsamanvitam śiṣṭaṃ prathamanṛttavat || gauravarṇaḥ || 1 umātāṃḍavamevaṃ syādgaurītāṃḍavamapyatho saṃhāratāṃḍavaṃ saptamamitthaṃ saptatāṃḍavāḥ || 2 rudrobhīmo mahādevaḥ kīrtitāstvaṣṭamūrtayaḥ || 1 || || varābhayakarāścaivaṭaṃka kṛṣṇadharāstathā kesarovidrumonīlobhavādināṃ ca varṇakaḥ || 1 śivoharastathā śarvaḥ kapālībhava eva ca ekādaśaite kathitāḥ rudrālokahiteratāḥ yasmāt prajajñiredevāstaṃ śaṃbhuṃpraṇamāmyaham || 1|| śoṇavarṇaḥ caturvedaiśca sahitaṃ pinākinamahaṃbhaje haridvarṇaḥ giriśogirijāprāṇavallabhostu sadāmude || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ

sthāṇuṃnamāmi śirasā sarvadeva namaskṛtam śvetavarṇaḥ hṛdayasthaḥ sadābhūyādbhargobhayavināśanaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ rudrobhūtvāharannaṃte gatirmestu sadāśivaḥ śyāmalavarṇaḥ kalyāṇaguṇadhāmnestu śivāyavihitānatiḥ pītavarṇaḥ pinākāṃkitahastāyaharāyāstu namaskṛtiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ khaḍgapāṇistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraśśarvākhyostumude mama babhruvarṇaḥ śūlapāṇissukhāyāstu kapālīmehyaharniśam pāṭalavarṇaḥ vedāṃtakṛtasaṃcāraṃ bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇaṃbhaje śvetavarṇaḥ rudraṃtriṇetramaruṇaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍaladhāriṇam vaiyyāghracarmavasanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam aparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃparaśuṃmṛgam pītaḥkālastathā babhruvarṇakaḥpāṭalassitaḥ ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ varṇoyaṃsamudāhṛtaḥ ṛjutanusamapādasthānakaṃ vidrumābhaṃhariṇaparaśupāṇiṃpadmapīṭhopariṣṭham pravālavarṇaḥ savye tu nīlotpalacāruhastāṃ devasya vāmasthitapadmapīṭhām śyāmavarṇaḥ

sumukhaṃ paramutpaladṛgvaradaṃ hyumayāsahanaumisarūpamidam śvetavarṇaḥ phālasthākṣaṃ prasannaṃtrinayanalasitaṃ baddhaveṇīkirīṭaṃ vāme gauryāsametaṃ namataśubhakaraṃ taṃ vṛṣārūḍhamīśam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ śivakāmavallī caṃdraśekharasamīpasthāṃbāvatkāryā śaṃbhuṃdakṣiṇapārvatīkaratalaṃ savyena saṃgṛhṇataṃṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃdharaṃ varakaraṃcūḍeṃdubaddhādaram tryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃnaṃsye navayauvanagarvitam kuṃcitaṃ savyapādena sthitasavyetarāṃghrikam || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ dvibāhukāṃdvinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām dukūlavasanāṃ devīṃ kuryāddevasyavāmake || śyāmavarṇaḥ yajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutam sruvaṃdakṣiṇahaste tu pustakaṃ vāmakedadham kuṃḍaṃ tu caturaśraṃ vai mekhalātrayasaṃyutam kuryānmadhye havyavāhaṃ jvālāpaṃcakasaṃvṛtam brahmaṇaḥ puratobhāgenyastāgniṃ samyagarcayet || pāṭalavarṇaḥ devyāstu dakṣiṇepārśve menakāsusmitānanām sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām || kāñcanavarṇaḥ hastadvaye hemakuṃbhajalaṃdharakṛtiṃ bhajet devasyavāmapārśve tu sanakaśca sanaṃdanaḥ viṣṇvādyamaramukhyāśca vivāhe sevayāyutāḥ sanakasanandanau pāṭalavarṇau || viṣṇvādīnāṃ tattadvarṇāḥ bhasmadigdhaṃ vidrumābhaṃ kaṭyāṃpannagasaṃvṛtam dakṣiṇaṃ tatkarāgraṃ tu hariṇāsyānugaṃ bhavet vāme tvaparahaste tu triśūlaṃpiṃchadhāriṇam samabhaṃgasthānakaṃ ca gamanonmukharūpakam evaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ proktam || guṃḍodaramathośṛṇu

hastadvayasamāyuktaṃ kapālaṃśirasi nyaset daṃṣṭrākarālavaktraṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam devovidrumavarṇaḥ || guṃḍodaraḥśyāmavarṇaḥ kṛṣṇaṭaṃkasamāyuktamabhayaṃvaradānvitam dakṣiṇelaṃbitaṃpādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu śāyitam kāryaḥkāmaripustvevaṃ vakṣyehaṃkālanāśanam || raktavarṇaḥ vāme kuṃcitapādamuddhṛtatalaṃkālasya vakṣasthalechinnābhinna jaṭādharaṃgirijayāyuktaṃ jagaddaivatam savyapādaṃliṃgamūrdhni sthitaṃ raudramukhaṃ bhajet || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ dvibhujaśca dvinetraśca bhasmarudrākṣasaṃyutaḥ śivārcanaparaśśāṃtaḥ śivadhyānaparo bhavet || śvetavarṇaḥ devasya vāmapāśve tu kālaṃ mṛtyusvarūpakam hastadvaye daṃḍapāśakarṣaṇākṛtirūpakam tanmadhye mahiṣasthityākālarupamihocyate || śyāmavarṇaḥ dhanurbāṇasamāyuktamumayāsahitaṃ tathā patraṃdadhaṃvāmakarṇe dakṣiṇe kuṃḍalānvitam jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃvilasadvidrumāṃgakam || 3 || evaṃ tripurasaṃhāram || vidrumavarṇaḥ upavītasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitam dakṣahaste sthitaṃchatraṃ vāmepūrṇakamaṃḍalum karṇakuṃḍalasaṃyuktaṃ hāranūpurasaṃyutam sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ kakṣekhaḍgasamanvitam jalaṃdharamathaproktam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || jalaṃdharaḥ pītavarṇaḥ tāṭaṃkaṃkuṃḍalaṃ savyavāmaśrutyośca bibhratam vajraṃparaśupūrvāṃsaṃ vāme brahmakaroṭikam apare śūlahastaṃ ca śeṣaṃ purvoktavatkuru || gauravarṇaḥ ṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃdharaṃparakare bhīṣmānaneṃdu prabhaṃvāmo mātibhayonmukhīsutayutaṃ sūcyāḍhyahastaṃharam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ

dakṣiṇe khaḍgabāṇau ca vāme cāpaṃ gadāṃdharam ruṃḍamālāsamāyuktaṃ pādukoparisusthitam bhadrakālīsamāyukaṃ karālaṃ hṛdivinyaset || nīlavarṇaḥ ajavaktraṃ dvinayanaṃśṛṃgadvayavibhūṣitam namaskārāṃ jaliṃvipraṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇam || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1 savyeṭaṃkābhayaṃ syāditarakarayuge śaṃkhakaumodaki syāt kiṃcillālāṭanetraṃ vilasatupurataḥ śrīharerardhadeham phālārdhe locanārdhākalitasamapadaṃ śubhayajñopavītaṃ haryardhaṃnaumi śaṃbhuṃsakalaśubhakaraṃ sarvasaṃpatkarāḍhyam raktavarṇa īśkarabhāgaḥ || viṣṇubhāgaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ vāmārdhaṃ vāmabhāge tu sīmaṃtatilakālakam dakṣiṇe kuṃḍalaṃkarṇedadhaṃ vāme tu patrakam varadotpalake vāmekeyūrakaṭakānvitam śroṇyardhaṃ dakṣiṇe śaṃbhorvyāghracarmakṛtāṃbaram nūpurālaṃkṛtaṃ vāme savyapādaṃ tu kuṃcitam devībhāgaśśyāmavarṇaḥ sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ divyāṃbarasamāvṛtam upavītasamāyuktaṃ samabhaṃgatanuṃkuru sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ sthitam evaṃ kirātamākhyātam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || arjunaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ śūlaṃkṛṣṇamṛgāsya laṃbitakaraṃ baddheṃdu cūḍaṃharaṃ vaṃdedeva-ṛṣīśvaraiḥ parivṛtaṃvaiyyāghracarmāṃbaram pādayoḥ pādukāyuktaṃ kiṃcidvaigamanonmukham śaṃkhaṃ tu vāmakarṇe tu pakṣiṇenakrakuṃḍalam churikāṃ dakṣakaṭyāṃ tu dadhānaṃ bhūtasaṃyutam devasya vāmapārśve tu mahābhūtaṃprakalpayet kapālaṃśirasi nyasya devavāme tu saṃsthitam evaṃ kaṃkālamākhyātam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || bhūtaḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ

caṃḍeśasyottamāṃge pratinihitakaraṃ dakṣabhāgetriṇetraṃ sarvālaṃkārayuktaṃ śaśiśakaladharaṃgaṃgayāyuktamīḍe devasya bāhumātreṇacaṃḍeśāyāma-ucyate caṃḍeśvaraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃbālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam caṃḍeśānugrahaṃproktam devaḥ caṃḍeśaśca pītavarṇaḥ caturbāhuṃsuraktaṃ samṛgaṃparaśudhāriṇam varadaṃ vāmahaste tu sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam kaṃṭhenipīḍya sthita savyalaṃbāṃciṃtākulāmīśvaratuṣṭidātrīm devoraktavarṇaḥ || devīśyāmavarṇā yastasmaidayayā paraṃ paśupatiṃpadmākṣa ityākhyayāṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃvaraṃ ca dadhataṃcakrapradaṃtaṃbhaje dadhameṇaṃ ca paraśuṃvaraṃ ca caiva vāmake devasya vāmabhāge tu śyāmarūpaṃ susaṃsthitam śaṃkhacakrasamāyuktamuttare cāṃjaliṃ nyaset devaḥśvetavarṇaḥ || viṣṇuḥśyāmavarṇaḥ abhayaṃ śirasinyasyavaradaṃ vāmahastake śayānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃpādaṃdadhaṃvāmaṃ tu laṃbitam devasya vāmapārśve tu devīṃprahasitānanām vāme varadasaṃyuktāṃ dvibhujāṃ ca triṇetrakām ekapīṭhasthitāṃ devīmumāṃskaṃdoktivatkuru namaskārāṃjalikaraṃ paśāṃkuśasamanvitam vighnaprasādamityuktam || devodevī ca śyāmavarṇau || vighneśoraktavarṇaḥ vāmegauriyutaṃ sukhāsamubhayormadhye kumārasthitiṃsomāskaṃdavibhuṃmṛgābhayavarān ṭaṃkaṃdadhānaṃbhaje caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam kṛṣṇaṭaṃkaṃ dadhānaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vāmakepi ca upavītadharaṃ caiva śayānaṃ vāmapādakam

tayormadhyagataṃ skaṃdaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam somāskaṃdasya pārśve tu bhogaśaktiśca vāmake paṃcaviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ somāskaṃdomahānmataḥ dharāṃ tu kumudaṃ devīṃ vāmevaradasaṃyutām saralābjadharaṃhaste sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam somāskaṃdamiti proktam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || devīśyāmavarṇā || skaṃdonīlavarṇaḥ śaṃbhordakṣiṇavāmakakṣabhujayorbrahmācyutābhayāṃ sthitaṃ tattallakṣaṇamāyudhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ hastadvayāḍhyāṃjalim ekapādamitikhyātaṃ sukhāsinam || raktavarṇaḥ || pakṣāṃtare śvetavarnopi prasiddhaḥ aruṇāṃbaraśobhilasachubhadaṃguṇanetrasukhāsanarūpamidam abhayaṃ dakṣiṇehastevaradaṃ vāmahastake śayānaṃdakṣiṇaṃpādaṃ dadhaṃvāmaṃ tu kuṃcitam sukhāsīnamiti proktam || raktavarṇaḥ vyākhyāpīṭheniṣaṇṇassakalamunivaraissevitaḥ suprasannassavyālaḥ kṛttivāsāssatatamavatunodakṣiṇāmūrtirīśaḥ bharadvājaśśaunakaścāpyagastyobhārgavastathā kailāsaparvate tasmin vaṭavṛkṣasyamūlake śubhravarṇaḥ nālakādhasthitaṃ pādaṃliṃgodbhavasamanvitam dakṣevarāharūpasya rūpeṇādhogatohariḥ svarūpeṇadvipādasthāvajaviṣṇūvibhoḥpare śobhānvitaṃ śubhakaraṃsakalaprajānāmaiśvarya saṃghaparivṛddhikaraṃvidadhyāt pakṣāṃtare śubhravarṇopi prasiddhaḥ dvātriṃśadbāhusaṃyuktaṃ sūryasomāgnilocanam ūdhrvakeśaṃ mahābāhuṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam khaḍgakhaṭvāṃgaparaśūnakṣamālāsthi śūlakam varadaṃpāśahastaṃ ca gadāṃbāṇadhvajau tathā

kapālaṃ pustakaṃkuṃtaṃ durgāśliṣṭakarāṃbujam daṃṣṭrollāsaṃ mahāsiṃhacchaṭācchaṭanipīḍitam raktavarṇaḥ siddha-ucchiṣṭavighneśaukṣiproheraṃbanāmakaḥ vijayaḥkalpanṛttaścāpyūrdhva vighneśa-ucyate haridrākhyaścaikadaṃtassṛṣṭiruddaṃḍanāmakaḥ siṃhoyogaśca durgā ca devassaṃkaṭahārakaḥ bālasūryamimaṃvaṃde devaṃbālagaṇādhipam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dhatte sadāyastaruṇāruṇābhaḥ pāyātsayuṣmāṃstaruṇogaṇeśaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ śaraccandrābhavapuṣaṃbhaje bhaktagaṇādhipam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ śūlaṃ ca kuṃtaparaśudhvajamudvahaṃtaṃ vīraṃgaṇeśamaruṇaṃ satataṃsmarāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ saṃdhyāruṇaṃ pāśasṛṇīvahaṃtaṃ bhayāpahaṃ śaktigaṇeśamīḍe || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥ staṃberamānanacatuṣṭayaśomamānaṃtvāṃyaḥ smareddijagaṇādhipatesadhanyaḥ || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥ udvahanparaśumastu tenamaśrīsamṛddhiyuta hemapiṃgala || 1 || piṃgalavarṇaḥ dadhaducchiṣṭanāmāyaṃ gaṇeśaḥ pātumecakaḥ prakārāṃtareṇa nārīyonirasāsvādalolupaṃ kāmamohitam || nīlavarṇaḥ pāṇiśritaiḥ parisamīhitabhūṣaṇaśrīrvighneśvarovijayateta panīyagauraḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ baṃdhūkakamanīyābhaṃ dhyāyet kṣipragaṇādhipam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ phalamadhigatasiṃhaḥ paṃcamātaṃgavaktrogaṇapatiratigauraḥ pātuheraṃbanāmā || 1 || gauravarṇaḥ śyāmenāttasaroruheṇasahitaṃ devīdvayaṃcāṃtike gorāṃgauvaradānahastasahitolakṣmī gaṇeśovatāt || gauravarṇaḥ bījāpūragadekṣukārmukalasaccakrābjapāśotpalavrīhyagrasvaviṣāṇaratnakalaśān-hastairvahaṃtaṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ vighnaṃnihaṃtunassarvaṃ raktavarṇo vināyakaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ pītaprabhaṃkalpataroradhasthaṃbhajāmi nṛttopapadaṃgaṇeśam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ āliṃganodyatakaroharitāṃga yaṣṭyādevyākarotu śubhamūrdhvagaṇādhipome || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ hastāgrākḷpta pāśāṃkuśaradavaradonāgavaktro hi bhūṣodevaḥ padmāsanasthobhavatu sukhakarobhūtaye vighnarājaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ

puṣṭyāśliṣṭatanuṃ dhvajāgrakarayāpadmollasaddhastayā tadyonyā hitapāṇimāttavasumatpātrollasatpuṣkaram || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ hemavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃpāśāṃkuśadharaṃvaram puṣkarairmodakaṃ caiva dhārayaṃtamanusmaret || 2 || svarṇavarṇaḥ śaśiśakalakalitamaulistrilocanoruṇaśca gajavadanaḥ vighnapayodhrapavanaḥkaradhṛtakamalassadāstume bhūtyai || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ pāśāṃkuśaudharaṃ devaṃ modakaṃdaṃtameva ca bhaktābhayapradātāraṃvaṃde vighnavināśanam || haridrāvarṇaḥ salaḍḍukaṃdaṃtamadhaḥ karābhyāṃ vāmetarābhyāṃ ca dadhānamīḍe || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ vighnaṃnihaṃtu naśśoṇaḥ sṛṣṭidakṣovināyakaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ gaurāṃgyārucirāraviṃdakarayā devyā samāliṃgitaśśoṇāṃgaśśubhamātano tu bhajatāmuddaṃḍavighneśvaraḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ raktāṃśukogaṇapatirmude syādṛṇamocakaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ dhattekarairvighnarājoḍhuṃḍināmāmudestunaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ raktāṃśukoratnakirīṭamālībhūtyai sadāmedvimukhogaṇeśaḥ || 1 || haridvarṇaḥ pīṭhe svarṇamayāraviṃdavilasatsatkarṇikābhāsure svāsīnastrimukhaḥ palāśarucironāgānanaḥ pātunaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ śuṃḍādaḍalasanmṛgeṃdravadanaḥ śaṃkheṃdugauraḥśubhodīvyadratnanibhāṃśukogaṇapatiḥ pāyādapāyātsanaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ pāśekṣvakṣānyogadaṃḍaṃdadhānopāyānnityaṃ yogavighneśvaronaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ taptakāṃcanasaṃkāśaścāṣṭahastomahattanuḥ || dīptāṃkuśaṃśaraṃcākṣaṃdaṃtaṃ dakṣevahankaraiḥ raktāṃśukassadābhūyāddurgāgaṇapatirmude || 2 || kanakavarṇaḥ lasadiṃdīvarahastāṃgaurāṃgīṃ ratnaśobhāḍhyām nīlāṃśukalasamānaḥ pīṭhepadmāruṇe tiṣṭhan saṃkaṭaharaṇaḥpāyātsaṃkaṭapūgādgajānanonityam || raktavarṇaḥ śvetārkapuṣpamālaṃ ca hemaratnakirīṭinam divyagaṃdhānuliptāṃgaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam śivaśaktijñānayogaṃ jñānaśaktisvarūpakam || śvetavarṇaḥ kukkuṭābhayavajrāṇi dadhataṃ varadaṃ kare

mekhalāṃbarasaṃvītaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam dhūmravarṇaprabhaṃ skaṃdaṃprabhāmaṇḍalamaṃḍitam || skaṃdarūpamidaṃproktam || dhūmravarṇaḥ sruvākṣamālāṃkhaḍgaṃ ca svastikaṃdakṣiṇekare agnihotravidhiṃ devamagnijātasvarūpakam nīlavarṇaḥ kuṃcitaṃ vāmapādaṃ ca susthitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ padam vajraṃ cekṣudhanuśśūlaṃ varadaṃ vāmake dadham padmapuṣpanibhaṃ caiva saurabheyasvarūpakam || pāṭalavarṇaḥ karaṃḍamukuṭopetaṃ kukkuṭadhvajadhāriṇam paraśuṃpūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca savyahaste tu dhāriṇam araṇiṃkukkuṭaṃ vāmegāṃgeyasamarūpakam || pāṭalavarṇaḥ sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhasthaṃ dadhataṃbhaje khaḍgaṃkhetaṃ ca vajraṃ ca kukkuṭadhvajadhāriṇam śarajanmasamākhyātam || raktavarṇaḥ śaktiṃśūlaṃ tathā ca kramaṃkuśābhayamanyake mayuravāhanārūḍhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam bālasūryapratīkāśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ śivātmajam || raktavarṇaḥ śaktiṃcābhayadadaṃkṣe savyevaradavajrake padmapuṣpaṃdharaṃ kaṃṭhedevaṃbālasvarupakam || raktavarṇaḥ kukkuṭaṃ ca dhanuḥkheṭaṃśaṃkhaṃdhattehalaṃvaram jayā ca vijayā caiva vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃcābhayaṃ khaḍgaṃ śaktiṃ vāmetaredadham tārakāriṃbhajekhyātam || raktavarṇaḥ sarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanam susmitaṃcāruvadanaṃ devasenāpatiṃbhaje || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ

śūlaṃ vajraṃdharaṃ savyevarābhayakamanyake jāyayā vāmapārśve tu kalyāṇotsavavigraham pādāṃbujaṃ hṛdidhyāttvāguharūpaṃsamāśraye || śyāmavarṇaḥ dakṣabhāge daṃḍahastaṃ vajravāmoruhastakam śikhāyajñopavītāḍhyaṃmauṃjīkaupīnasaṃyutam divyarūpadharaṃ devaṃ brahmacāriṇamāśraye || 3 || raktavarṇaḥ śaktihastadvayaṃ caiva japamālādharaṃśubham ityevaṃ vidhivaddhyāyecchiva devasyadeśikam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ varadābhayasaṃyuṃktapuṣpabāṇekṣukārmukam krauṃcabhedakara dvaṃdvaṃkrauṃca bhedisvarūpakam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ pāśāṃkuśaṃdadhaṃ caiva jvalākeśaśikhaṃḍakam caturdaśādibhavanaṃ śikhivāhanamācaret || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ kātyāyanīsutamahaṃ kaṭibaddhavāmahastaṃ ca daṃḍadharadakṣiṇahastamīḍe || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ dadhataṃ ruṃḍamālāṃ ca pādukādvayasaṃyutam dakṣiṇaṃpītavasanaṃ vīrabhadramupāsmahe || nīlavarṇaḥ akṣayasvarṇamāṇikyagaṇapūritapātrakam satataṃ ciṃtayed bhaktyābhairavaṃ sarvasiddhidam madonmattaṃ sadānaṃdaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam evaṃ dhyāyecca maṃtrajñaḥ svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavam || pītavarṇaḥ śūlaṃ kapālaṃpāśaṃ ca ḍamuruṃdadhataṃkaraiḥ śvānārūḍhaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ vadukaṃ bhairavaṃbhaje || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ anukṛtaśaśitejaḥ kuṃḍalaṃ cāruhāsaṃ prakaṭadaśanaśobhānirjitāneka hīram saphaṇapavanabhugdordaṃḍabhūṣābhirāmaṃkara ḍamaruninādaiḥ pūritadyokhagarbham bhujagaphaṇasuguptairbhūṣaṇairnyastabhūṣaṃpraṇata surakirīṭavyāptapā dāraviṃdam kanakagirisamābhaṃnaiśacūrṇābhirāmaṃ sakalanigamaguhyaṃ naumimallāridevam || 4 || raktavarṇaḥ

ṭaṃkaṃca śūlamabhayaṃjapamālikāṃ ca bibrāṇamekamanasāsatataṃ smarāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ saṃhārābhaṃsumūrdhānaṃ prativatkraṃ trilocanam śaktimudgaraśaṃkhāsīn dadhānaṃ somasūtriṇam sāṃgaṃpāśupataṃ śastraṃbhaje padmāsane sthitam || raktavarṇaḥ ghaṃṭāṃkapālaṃ ca sṛṇiṃmuḍaṃ cāpikṛpāṇakam dadhānaṃ raktavasanaṃbhajehaṃ khaḍgarāvaṇam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥ aṣṭāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ bhairavāṇāmabhīṣṭadam pūrvavadvarṇatodhyāne dhyeyaṃ sarvaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak pāśaṃ cāsiṃdadhānaṃ ca dhyāyetsarvāṅgasuṃdaram || 1 || kanakavarṇam dadhānaṃpustakaṃ vīṇāṃsuśvetamaṇibhūṣaṇam || 1 || śvetavarṇam dhyāyettṛtīyaṃ śubhadamaṣṭakaṃśubhalakṣaṇam || 1 || nīlavarṇam dhūmravarṇamabhipretaṃ dhyāyedaṣṭakamādarāt kuṃtaṃ kheṭaṃ ca parighaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ tathaiva ca || dhūmravarṇam paṃcamāṣṭakametadviśvetaṃ syātsumanoharam || śvetavarṇam || 1 paṃcamāṣṭakametaddhiśvetaṃ syātsumanoharam krameṇapītaraktataṭidvarṇāḥ svacchaṃdovighnasaṃtuṣṭaḥ khecaraḥ sacarācaraḥ viśvarūpovirūpākṣo nānārūpadharaḥparaḥ bhūmikaṃponīlakaṃṭho viṣṇuśca kulapālakaḥ abhrarūpodharāpālaḥ kuṭilomaṃtranāyakaḥ śaṃkarobhūtavetālotriṇetrastripurāṃtakaḥ hasticarmāṃbaradharoyogīśo brahmarākṣasaḥ bhīṣaṇākhyobhayaharassarvajñākhyastathaiva ca saṃhāraścātiriktāṃgokālāgniśca priyaṃkaraḥ ghoranādoviśālākṣoyogīśodakṣasaṃsthitaḥ

iti śrīmatsamastabhūmaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānanikhiladeśāvataṃ sakarnāṭakajanapadasaṃpadadhiṣṭhānabhūta śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthāna madhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūtadivya-ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍha śrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvara prauḍhapratāpā pratimavīranarapatibirudeteṃbaragaṃḍalokaika vīrayadukulapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsya śarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyaneka virudāṃkitamahīśūrapuravarādhīśa śrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe mahākailāsamūrtyādiśivamūrtisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃnāmatṛtīyaśśivanidhissaṃ-pūrṇaḥ yajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutam sruvaṃ dakṣiṇahaste ca pustakaṃ vāmahastake padmapatradalāgrābhaṃ dhyāyedevaṃ caturmukham || 3 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ caturbhujā sā kartavyā tathaiva ca samasthitā vāmayośca tathā kārye vaiṇavī ca kamaṃḍaluḥ samapādāpratiṣṭhāpyākāryā saumyamukhīsitā || śvetavarṇā baddhapadmāsanaṃ tuṣṭaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājināṃbaram vāmanyaste tarakaraṃ tasyaikaṃdoryugaṃ bhavet kamaṃḍaluṃ dvitīye ca sarvābharaṇadhāriṇam padmapatradalāgrābhaṃ dhyānasaṃmīlite kṣaṇam ācāryaḥ kārayedevaṃ citre vā vāstukarmaṇi || pāṭalavarṇaḥ ādityavarṇodharmajñassākṣasūtradharastathā rūpaṃ pūrvoditaṃkāryaṃ sarvamanyajjagatpateḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥ sāvitrī tasya kartavyāvāmotsaṃgagatā śubhā brahmoktaṃ paramaṃrūpaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prajāpateḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥ dvibhujodaśapāṇiśca tejomūrtidharomahān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ sarvābharaṇavāñchāṃtodharmakārya vidavyayaḥ mūrtimān vyavasāyastu kāryodakṣiṇabhāgataḥ kāryau padmakaraumūrdhni vinyastau ca tathātayoḥ || 3 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ || 2 kardamaḥ kaśyapodakṣonavaite brahmasūnavaḥ || 1 akṣasrakkuṃḍikāpāṇiṃ jaṭāvalkalabhūṣitam akṣasrakkuṃḍikāhastaṃ prajeśaṃkanakaprabham || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ jaṭilaṃśmaśrulaṃ śāṃtaṃśyāmalāṃgaṃbhaje'niśam || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ śāṃtaṃjitāriṣaḍvargamakṣasragdaṃḍahastakam

kṛṣṇājinottarīyaṃ ca jaṭilaṃpiṃgalaprabham || piṃgalavarṇaḥ akṣamālāṃkuṃḍikāṃ ca dadhataṃghanamecakam || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ jaṭilaṃśmaśrulaṃdaṃḍakamaṃlukarojjvalam saptārcirivabhāsvaṃtaṃ dhyāyehaṃtapasāṃnidhim || raktavarṇaḥ jaṭāmakuṭaśobhāḍhyaṃ saṃdhyābhrāruṇavigraham akṣasrakkuṃḍikāhastaṃcīrakṛṣṇājināṃbaram || siṃdūravarṇaḥ praṇavabrahmasaṃsaktacittaṃ satkāṃcanaprabham prajāsaṃsarjanodyuktamakṣasrakkuṃḍikādharam || 2 || kāṃcanavarṇaḥ namaskārāṃjaliṃvaṃde śivadhyānaparāyaṇam || 1 || svāyaṃbhuvaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dakṣamadhvaradīkṣitam || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1 jaṭilāśśmaśrulāśśāṃtā-āsīnā dhyānatatparāḥ jamadagnirvasiṣṭho trisapta vaivasvateṃtare || 1 akṣasrakkuṃḍikādaṃḍāndadhānaṃ gautamaṃbhaje || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥ akṣasragdaṃḍahastaṃ ca munimāṃgirasaṃbhaje || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ kumudvatīpatiṃśāṃtaṃ viśvāmitraṃbhajāmyaham || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ japākṣasragdharaṃ patnīsahitaṃ munipuṃgavam || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ daṃḍākṣasūtrapāṇiṃ ca jamadagniṃ namāmyaham || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ sragdaṃḍapāṇiṃvaradaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 1 || sitavarṇaḥ anasūyāpatiṃśāṃtamatriṃniṣkalmaṣaṃbhaje || 1 || asitavarṇaḥ || 1 sitāruṇaṃ pītakṛṣṇaṃsiṃharūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 1 yamavāyuśiveṃdrāśca jñeyādharmādidevatāḥ || (eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇānidikpāleṣu draṣṭavyā 4 nidhau) caturbhujāssiṃhavaktrāssita pūrvāruṇāḥpare aparābhyāṃ ca vibhrāṇāḥ karābhyāṃ yogapīṭhakau mukheśvetavarṇāḥ || śarīreruṇavarṇāḥ nir-ṛtiścaiva durgā ca kāmorudrastathaiva ca || 1 || (eteṣāṃ svarūpāṇiṃ tattanmūrtilakṣaṇe pūrvamuktānivakṣyaṃte ca krameṇa 4 - 5 - 2 - 5 nidhau) || (rudraḥ-ārdrānakṣatradevatāvat) durgāraudrivatsaradevatāvat) gīrvāṇamutapādābjaṃpuṇyaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ

surāpānahṛdāyuktaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayam upapātakaromāṇaṃpiṃgabhrūśmaśrulocanam khaḍgacarmadharaṃkṛṣṇaṃkukṣaupāpaṃ viciṃtayet || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ dīrghajihvaṃ pītavastraṃ smarāmibagalāmukham || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ akṣamālādharaḥ saumyaḥ prītovyākhyāpanodyataḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ vāme kuliśapāṇistu bhūtidomaṃgalapradaḥ || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ akṣamālānvitodakṣe vāmekuṃbhadharassmṛtaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ akṣamālānvito vāmedakṣekuṃbhadharassmṛtaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ hastābhyāṃdadhatīpadmaṃ pītavastramanūpamam sāmidhenīsamākhyātā || śubhravarṇā sṛgāyālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || raktavarṇāviśālākṣī padmahastākṛśodarī || 1 || raktavarṇā savyeśukaṃ tathā dakṣedhānyamaṃjarikāṃ tathā dadhānāsākahūrdevī || śvetavarṇā sūkarāsyā cakorākṣī caṃpakā bhāsitāṃśukā kanakavarṇāḥ kāśyapaṃcayajurvedaṃ rudradaivaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ adhidaivaṃ vijāniyādvaitānaṃ syādatharvaṇe (atharvaṇavedābhimānībrahmā bṛhaspatipratyadhidevatāvat 4 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ sudhākuṃbhaṃ bibhadārogyado bhṛśam pītavarṇaḥ udatiṣṭhanmahārājapuruṣaḥ paramādbhutaḥ śyāmalastaruṇaḥ sragvī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ nīlakuṃcitakeśāṃta subhagassiṃhavikramaḥ savaibhagavatassākṣādviṣṇoraṃśāṃśa saṃbhavaḥ sitavasanavirājanmaulirārogyadāyīśatamakhamaṇivarṇaḥ pātudhanvaṃtarirnaḥ

nīlavarṇaḥ kālāṃbhodojjvalāṃgaṃ kaṭitaṭavilasaccārupītāṃbarāḍhyaṃ vaṃde dhanvaṃtariṃ taṃ nikhilagadavanavrātadāvāgnilīlam bibhrāṇaḥ karuṇākaraśśubhakarassarvāmayadhvaṃsakassarvaṃ te duritaṃ chinattu bhagavāndhanvaṃtarissaṃtatam nīlavarṇaḥ dhanurbāṇadharoraudro mastake kapilā jaṭāḥ pītavarṇaḥ sahasranetraṃ pītābhamiṃdraṃ hṛdi vibhāvaye pītavarṇaḥ || (śukrapratyadhi devatāvat 5 ni0) tryakṣasūtrā sa kuṇḍā ca ṣaḍbhujādaṃḍapaṃkajā śubhravarṇā sāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatāśubhā pāṭalavarṇaḥ (paṃcabrahmasuprajāpatibrahmavat 4 ni0) kuṭhāradaṃḍābjahasto mekhalākuṇḍalānvitaḥ kumudavarṇaḥ yajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutam sruvaṃ dakṣiṇahaste ca pustakaṃ vāmahastake pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (trimūrtyaṃtargatabrahmavat 4 ni0) vīṇākarānvitaṃ divyaṃ divyavastravibhūṣitam śubhravarṇam bhāsākuṃdeṃdu śaṃkhasphaṭikamaṇinibhābhāsamānā samānāsāmevāgdevateyaṃ nivasatu vadane sarvadāsu prasannā || 1 || śvetavarṇā pāśapaṃkajasaṃyuktaṃ sākṣasūtraṃ sa pustakam niruktamitinirṇītam || śubhravarṇam varuṇoṃbupatissvarṇa varṇo makaravāhanaḥ kanakavarṇaḥ || (dikpālāntargatavaruṇavat 4 ni0)

cakorāsyaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ śaktiṃ bibhracchikhānvitam dadhānāśubhadāmesyād devamātā yaśasvinī pītavarṇā || (punarvasvadhidevatāvat 5 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ japāṃbibhraddhastayordakṣavāmayoḥ kanakavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtirathaharivat 2 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ dadhaddakṣe sūdhāpūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃpare śvetavarṇam gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī śvetavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthacaṃdravat 5 ni0) siṃhāsyo dakṣiṇe sūtraṃ dhvajaṃvāmakare dadhat nīlavarṇam varadānakaraṃdhūmravarṇaṃ vāyu mahaṃbhaje dhūmravarṇaḥ || (paṃcabhūtasthavāyuvat 4 ni0) muktājapākṣa dhṛk dakṣe tulā hastaṃ tu vāmataḥ śvetavarṇam sarvābharaṇavānśveto dharmaḥ kāryo vijānatā śvetavarṇaḥ akṣasūtrā bhayaṃjñeyaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam caṃpakavarṇam śvetavarṇaḥ || (anyat sarvaṃ 14 manuṣudraṣṭavyam 4 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ ghaṭaṃvibhrat paṃkajā varaṇānvitaḥ dūrvāśyāmavarṇaḥ sāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatā śubhā pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (paṃcabrahmasthaprajāpatibrahmavat 4 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ triśūlaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ ca trilocanam

śvetavarṇam sumukhīkṛtamutpala dṛgvaradamumayā sahadeva sa rūpamidam śvetavarṇaḥ akṣasūtraṃ halaṃbibhradvanamālāvibhūṣitam śvetavarṇam sa tu śuklavapuḥ kāryo nīlavāsāyadūttamaḥ dakṣordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥ kare musalaṃ vāmādhaḥ kareśārṅgaṃ vāmordhva kare lāṃgalam śvetavarṇaḥ || vyūhamūrtivat 2 ni0) sūtrapātradharaṃbhīmaṃ vyāghracarmāṃbarā vṛtam śvetavarṇam varadābhayaśūlākṣa sūtradhṛk parameśvaraḥ śvetavarṇaḥ || (sūryapratyadhidevatāvat 5 ni0) akṣasūtraṃ pātākāṃ ca dadhataṃ kuṃḍalānvitam dakṣiṇordhvakare padmaṃ śaṃkhaṃ tasyāpyadhaḥ kare bibhrataṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ phaṇāsaptānvitaṃ bhaje gomūtravarṇaḥ jāpyadaṃḍadharaṃdīrghaṃ na khalomajaṭādharam jñānābhayāṃkita karaṃkapilaṃ ca dattaṃ dhyāyedajādi samitiṃ pratibodhayaṃ tam raktavarṇaḥ nyāyaśāstraṃ tathākāvya malaṃkāraśca nāṭakam deśabhāṣāparijñānaṃ lipijñānaṃ lipikriyā sāmudrikaṃ ca śakunaṃ parīkṣāratnasaṃtateḥ gajaśāstraṃ mallavidyā pākakarma tataḥ param dhātuvādaḥ khanīvādo rasavādastataḥ paraḥ vāyustaṃbhastathā vaśyaṃ mohanākarṣaṇe tathā

vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ ca kṛṣirā savakarma ca ratikauśalamākheṭo pyadṛśyakaraṇī tathā tathaiva dyūtakaraṇī corakarmājanaṃ tathā jalaplavanavāksiddhi ghuṭikā siddhayastathā vidyāmaheṃdrajālena catuṣṣaṣṭirmatā imāḥ caturbhūjāṃ saumyatanuṃ caṃḍāṃśu sadṛśāṃbarām dakṣiṇābhyāṃ tathāvāma karābhyāṃ sarasīruham diṅnāgānāṃ caturṇāṃ ca pṛṣṭhārūḍhāṃ caturbhujām śubhravarṇā mādhuryaguṇasaṃyuktāḥ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitāḥ dadhānāḥ pāśakalaśau sadāmakaravāhanāḥ śubhravarṇāḥ meṣārūḍaṃ saptahastaṃ svāhādevī samanvitam kanakavarṇaḥ varadānakaraṃdhūmravarṇaṃvāyumahaṃbhaje dhūmravarṇaḥ caṃdrārkahastaṃ dvibhujaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam nīlavarṇam raktavarṇā padmavarṇā pītavarṇā haridvarṇā kṛṣṇavarṇā nīlavarṇā raktavarṇā

śvetavarṇā ūrdhvāgaganasannimā || nīlavarṇā adhasthāpṛthivītulyā || śvetavarṇā mahāpadmaśca śaṃkhaśca kulikoṣṭau kulānihi pratyekaṃ tu sahasrāṣṭa phaṇaistau samalaṃkṛtau pratyekaṃ tu phaṇā śaptaśatasaṃkhyā virājitau pītavarṇau phaṇaiḥ paṃcaśatatuṃgottamāṃgakau phaṇātriśatakau jñeyau vikhyātā vititattvataḥ || 5 puṣpadaṃto bṛhacchyāmo ṣaḍdaṃtaḥ puṣpadaṃtavān puṣpadaṃtassārvabhaumassupratīkoṣṭadiggajāḥ || 1 tāmraparṇīsudaṃtī syādaṃ janācāṃjanāvatī || 1 abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe haste varadaṃvāmahastake ratnakaustubhamaṇikya divyābharaṇabhūṣitam airāvatagajārūḍhaṃ śacīkāṃtaṃ namāmyaham hemavarṇaḥ tripātprasannavadanassukhāsīnaśśuci smitaḥ vibhraddakṣiṇahaste tu śaktimannaṃ srucaṃ sruvam meṣārūḍhaṃ jaṭābaddhaṃ ghoravarṇaṃ mahodaram ātmābhimukhamāsīnamevaṃ dhyāyeddhutāśanam raktavarṇaḥ śyāmavarṇaṃ pāśahastaṃ kṛtāṃtaṃ praṇamāmyaham raktavarṇo hi lokānāṃ svasvakarmaphalapradaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ ūrdhvakeśo virūpākṣaḥ karālaḥ kālikā priyaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ

varuṇoṃbu patiḥsvarṇa varṇomakaravāhanaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ hemadaṃḍadhvajaḥ śyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ nidhīśvaraḥ svarṇavarṇo dhanadorūpavānprabhuḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ varadābhayaśūlākṣa sūtradhṛtparameśvaraḥ śvetavarṇaḥ dhruvaṃdhruvāya yaśase ciṃtayāmi sadāmudā pītavarṇaḥ agniśuśrūṣaṇaratamadhvaraṃ praṇamenvaham śyāmavarṇaḥ ratnasiṃhāsanagataṃ somaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye sitavarṇaḥ āpaḥśubhapradāssaṃtu matsyavāhanasaṃgatāḥ śvetavarṇāḥ samastadevanivahavaṃdyamānapadāṃbujaḥ haridvarṇaḥ kirīṭojjvalamūrdhānamanalaṃ bhāvayāmyaham lohitavarṇaḥ pratyūṣaṃ ciṃtaye bhūyaḥ pratyūhonmūlakāraṇam śvetavarṇaḥ akṣasūtrojjvalakaraṃ vyāghrājinanivāsinam śvetavarṇaḥ āpaḥsitā itiproktā hyanalolohitaḥ smṛtaḥ

prasannavadanāḥ saumyā varadāḥ śaktipāṇayaḥ padmāsanasthā dvibhujāḥ kartavyāvasavassadā āsamaṃtātsaṃcariṣṇuḥ sutīvragaruḍasthitaḥ dhūmravarṇaḥ nabhomadhyagatovāyuḥ vivahobhūtidostume raktavarṇaḥ jagatīṃ kṣobhayannityamudvahaḥ sevyate mayā pītavarṇaḥ śītāṃbukaṇasaṃvāhaḥ saṃvahaḥ sukhadostume śyāmavarṇaḥ nivahaṃ pavanaśreṣṭhaṃ śirasāpraṇamāmyaham śvetavarṇaḥ marutāṃ pravahaṃ nityamāśrayenuvahābhidham asitavarṇaḥ sevyatāṃ prāṇinivahaiḥ marudvyavahasaṃjñakaḥ aruṇavarṇaḥ nivahonuvahaścaiva vyavahaśceti nāmabhiḥ varṇoyaṃ marutāmuktassaptānāmānu pūrvyaśaḥ || 1 prāṇaḥ (1) | apānaḥ (2) | vyānaḥ (3) | udānaḥ (4) | samānaḥ (5) | nāgaḥ (6) | kṛkaraḥ (7) | kūrmaḥ (8) | devadattaḥ (9) | dhanaṃjayaḥ (10) | pravahaḥ (11) | vivahaḥ (12) | śaṃbhuḥ (13) | saṃvahaḥ (14) | parivahaḥ (15) | udvahaḥ (16) | āvahaḥ (17) | śaṃkuḥ (18) | kālaḥ (19) | prāvahaḥ (20) | śāsaḥ (21) | anilaḥ (22) | analaḥ (23) | pratibhaḥ (24) | kumudaḥ (25) | kāṃtaḥ (26) | śibiḥ (27) | śvetaḥ (28) | raktaḥ (29) | kṛṣṇaḥ (30) | jitaḥ (31) | ajitaḥ (32) | jaṃjhādyotaḥ (33) | kratuḥ (34) | siddhaḥ (35) | piṃgaḥ (36) | śuciḥ (37) | saumyaḥ (38) | kāmyaḥ (39) | mārutaḥ (40) | hanuḥ (41) | kaṃpanaḥ (42) | maṃḍūkaḥ (43) | bhīmaḥ (44) | kapiḥ (45) | saṃvartakaḥ (46) | jaḍaḥ (47) | atijaḍaḥ (48) | saṃtataḥ (49) kirīṭahārakeyūra kaṭakādi vibhūṣitāḥ eteṣāṃ varṇarūrūpāṇi mukhyānāṃ marutāṃ yathā || 2 kartavyāvāmapāṇau tu śarāsanadharāssitāḥ || 1 || - || purūravārdravau ceti viśvedevā daśasmṛtāḥ śvetavarṇāḥ dakṣekṣamālikāṃvāme pātraṃ ca bahuratnabhṛt

pāṭalavarṇaḥ ghaṭaṃ daṃḍaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ devaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye gomūtravarṇaḥ mudgaraṃ kuṃḍikāṃ caiva bibhrāṇaṃ hṛdibhāvaye gomedavarṇaḥ kaśerupūritaṃ pātraṃ ghaṭaṃ bibhradvidūrathaḥ kapilavarṇaḥ daṃḍaṃ śaktiṃ ca bibhrāṇo dvibujosau jaṭāyutaḥ śubhravarṇaḥ makarasthoṃbujaṃdakṣe vāme kalaśamādadhat śvetavarṇaḥ makarasthoṃbujaṃdakṣe vāme kalaśamādadhat mauktikavarṇaḥ || 1 dadhānā dvibhujāḥ pūjyā nadyo makaravāhanāḥ || 1 bhāgīrathīṃ namasyāmi gaṃgāṃtripathagāṃ nadīm śubhravarṇā || 1 || - || vidhiharihararūpāṃ seṃdukoṭīrajuṣṭāṃ kalitasitadukūlāṃ jāhnavīṃ tāṃ namāmi || 1 || śvetavarṇā || 1|| - || lāvaṇyāmṛtaniṣyaṃda saṃśliṣadnātrayaṣṭikām evaṃ dhyāyet susaumyāṃ ca caṃdrāyuta samaprabhām sudhāplāvitabhūpṛṣṭhāṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanām śvetavarṇā kṛṣṇapādarajaḥpūtāṃ yamunāṃ hṛdi bhāvayet kṛṣṇavarṇā pāvanīṃ sarvalokasya svargadvārasya kuṃcikām pāṭalavarṇā

kṛṣṇāṃgarajasādhūta kalmaṣe te namonamaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā kalyāṇajananīṃ loke namāmi kanakaprabhām kanakavarṇā aṃtastāpapraśamanīṃ praṇamāmi mahānadīm raktavarṇā veṇīṃ pravālasaṃkāśāmupāse sukhasiddhaye raktavarṇā namāmi maṃgalānaṃda saṃdhātrīṃ bahudhāmudā mauktikavarṇā yo dhatte sarvajīvānāṃ varaṃ jīvaṃ ca śoṣakam pāśaṃ cakraṃ kisalayaṃ kuṃḍikāṃ daśabhiḥ karaiḥ śvetavarṇā phullaraktotpalākṣau ca pītasragvastravarṇakau śvetavarṇau || 2 || - || pādādi kaṃṭhaparyaṃtamaśvarūpaṃ prakalpayet śrotradvayau sthūlakaṃṭhau caturbāhusamanvitau karaṃḍaṃ cāmṛtaghaṭaṃvāma haste ca bibhrataḥ devānāṃdasranāsatyau nāmnoktau śvetarūpiṇau śvetavarṇau ghāsamuṣṭiṃ tathākuṃḍīṃ bibhrāṇābhūtapuṣṭidā gauravarṇā || 1|| - || maṇḍūkanetrāṃ sannāsāṃ kāmadhenupraninditām atyāyata śirogrīvāṃ vismitā syābhivīkṣitām gauravarṇā

gadātriśūlacakre ca padmaṃ ceti daśāyudham kṛtāṃjali puṭopetāḥ karaṃḍamukuṭānvitāḥ nānāvarṇamahāvidyun nīlajīmūtavarṇakam śāraṃ dābhraṃ ca raktaṃ ca vajrādīnāṃ ca varṇakam śesāḥ puṃstvena vikhyātāḥ kīrtitāstvastramūrtayaḥ || 5 || - || dhanuḥ strīraktapadmābhā mūrdhnibhūṣita cāpabhṛt uktānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ mūrdhnisvāyudhalāṃchanam bhujau dvau tu prakartavyau skaṃdhalagna tadā yudhau strīrūpiṇī pāṭalābhā svetāśva varavāhanā dakṣe vāme śamkhaghaṃṭā kheṭābhaya gadāstathā kausuṃbhavastrasaṃvītā pujitā ceṣṭadā nṛṇām pāṭalavarṇā khaḍgacāpau bhṛśuṃḍīṃ ca śūlaṃ śaktiṃ varaṃ halam caturdaśabhujairddhatte dakṣevāme pṛthakpṛhak raktavarṇā jāṃbūnadarucirnṛtyan mayūravaravāhanā dadhānākramaśaścitra vasanāmakuṭojjvalā raktavarṇā ṣaḍbhirbhujaiścakraśaṃkha varābhayadhanuśśarān kanakavarṇā saṃdhyāruṇoṣṭabhirhastaiścakraṃ padmaṃnidhiṃvaram dadhānaḥ pītavasanaḥ kirīṭāṃgadaśobhitaḥ raktavarṇaḥ meghavarṇaḥ karālāsyaḥ krūradaṃṣṭraśca digbhujaiḥ śaṃkhaṃdaḍaṃśaraṃkhaṭvā bhayaubibhradarīnvaśe

meghavarṇaḥ cakraśūlagadādaṃḍa khaḍgaghaṃṭāvaraṃdhanuḥ dadhāno dvyaṣṭabhirhastairnīlaśuklacitāṃśukaḥ raktavarṇaḥ śatarūpā tasya bhāryā kṣatradharmamanuvrataḥ ākūtiḥrdevahūtiśca prasūtiḥ śvetavarṇavān yatradharmāśca vividhāḥ caturvarṇya śritāśśubhāḥ śvetavarṇaḥ dyumatsuṣeṇarociṣmat pramukhāstasya cātmajāḥ taptakārtasvarābhāsassarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ hemavarṇaḥ bhāryoṣāsṛṃjayajayahotrādyāstasya cātmajāḥ caturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ patirīśvaraḥ raktavarṇaḥ khyātiḥ patnīketumaṃta ityādyāstatsutāmatāḥ haridvarṇostradhārī tu sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ haridvarṇaḥ patnīviṃdhyāvaliḥ putrādattakārjunapūrvakāḥ sadākhaḍgādyastradhārī sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ ādityapautrastatpatnī kāṃtistasyātmajāñchṛṇu brāhmavratadharodevaḥ sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ raktavarṇaḥ ikṣvāku pramukhāḥ putrāḥ patnīriṣṭiritīritā sauvarṇavarṇaḥ padmākṣo jagatāṃ prabhurīritaḥ

svarṇavarṇaḥ nirmohavirājaskādyāḥ pūtrāḥ patnī tu devikā caturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ patnīparādhṛṣṭaketurityādyāstatsutāssmṛtāḥ caturnāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥ raktavarṇaḥ tatsutābhūriṣeṇādyāstatpatnī bṛhatī matā sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ bhartā pūrvoktā manavo yathā śvetavarṇaḥ dharmaputrastatsutāstu satyadharmādayomatāḥ caturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥ raktavarṇaḥ devānudevāstatputrāḥ patnītvāryā nṛbhiḥ smṛtāḥ caṃḍapraśāsanastvāsīt sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ āsīdvedaśirāḥ putrobrāhmaṃdharmamanuvrataḥ caturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ patirīśvaraḥ śvetavarṇaḥ iṃdraputrastatsutāścāpyurugaṃbhīrakādayaḥ abhūtpatnīmatistasya sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥ nīlavarṇaḥ || 1 aśvatthāmā ciraṃjīvī dīrghamāyurdadātume śvetavarṇaḥ viṣṇupādāṃkitaśirāściraṃ jīvīprasīdatu

kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ ciraṃjīvī dīrghamāyurdadātu jaṭilo mama kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ saṃjīvanāpahartā me dīrghamāyurdadātviha sphaṭikavarṇaḥ dadātu cirajīvitvaṃ ciraṃjīvī jiteṃdriyaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ vitanotu prasannātmā yāvajjīvamarogatām śvetavarṇaḥ dadātu cirajīvitvaṃ prasannātmā bhṛgūdvahaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ dhyāyāmyahaṃ mahāsaumyaṃ prahlādaṃ cirajīvinam svarṇavarṇaḥ vedaśāstrārtha tattvajñaṃ mārkaṃḍeya mahaṃbhaje śubhravarṇaḥ || 1 vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇo mārutistu sphaṭikābhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ jāmadagnyassuvarṇābho mārkaṃḍeyassitassmṛtaḥ prahlādaśca suvarṇābho varṇā eṣāṃ prakīrtitāḥ sa vedāśca vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca sukuṃbhākṣadharāḥkāryā munayo dvibhujā daśa sakhyeva vīṇayāvāma bhujamūlopagūḍhayā śvetavarṇāḥ bhṛvaṇo bhāvanaścaiva sujanyassujanastathā pravāsaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣodvādaśakastathā śvetavarṇāḥ

ātmā āyurmanodakṣaḥ pādaprāpastathaiva ca pītavarṇāḥ sārasvataṃ vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ mīmāṃsā bhagavānsomo nyāyamārgassamīraṇaḥ itihāsaḥ prajādhyakṣo dhanurvedaśśatakratuḥ phalavedo mahādevo nṛttaśāstraṃ maheśvaraḥ pātaṃjalamanaṃtaśca sāṃkhyaṃ ca kapilo muniḥ kalāśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kāmadevo jagadguruḥ sa eva devatā tasya śāstraṃ kāvyaṃ ca vedavat khecarā ye devacarāstānnamasye sukhāptaye || 1 saṃdaṃśapāṇirdvibhujastejo mūrtidharo mahān kanakavarṇaḥ || 1 saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujassyāt sadāraviḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ hastāṃbhojairdadhānaṃ trinayanavilasadvedavaktrābhirāmaṃ mārtāṃḍaṃvallabhāḍhyaṃ maṇimayamakuṭaṃ hīradīptaṃ bhajāmaḥ vidrumavarṇā || 1 || - || padmadvayābhayavarāndadhataṃ karābjairmāṇikyamaulimaruṇāṃgaruciṃ triṇetram raktavarṇaḥ chāgasthaḥ sākṣasūtraśca varadaḥ śaktidhārakaḥ aruṇavarṇaḥ kapālaśūlakhaṭvāṃgapinākīṃduśirāḥ śivaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaśśaśī śvetavarṇaḥ || 1 || - || svasyāṃkasthamṛgoditā śrayaguṇaṃ somaṃ sudhābdhiṃ bhaje

śvetavarṇaḥ dadhānāḥ pāśakalaśau muktābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ śvetavarṇāḥ umābibharti hasteṣu pūjitā tridaśairapi svarṇavarṇā caturbhujomeṣagamovaradassyāddharāsutaḥ raktavarṇaḥ caturbhujā saumyavapuścaṃḍāṃśu sadṛśāṃbarā padmaṃkare ca kartavyaṃ bhuvoyādavanaṃdana śvetavarṇā raktāṃbaradharodevo mayūravaravāhanaḥ patākāvaijayaṃtī syācchaktiḥ kāryā ca vāmayoḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇissiṃhasthovarado budhaḥ kanakavarṇaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādārabhya nityaśaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ || 1 tiṣṭhantarati vai varṣaṃ rāśaurāśau bṛhaspatiḥ daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalū kanakavarṇaḥ prācīpatiḥ prakartavyo nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ sopāsaṃgapatākastu śuklassyāttu rathomahān
