daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalū śvetavarṇaḥ abhayā''maṃḍitākāryādvibhujā ca tathā śacī kanakavarṇā sahasranetraṃ pītābhamiṃdraṃ hṛdivibhāvaye kanakavarṇaḥ bāṇacāpadharovīraḥ kartavyorkasutassadā kṛṣaṇavarṇaḥ sāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatā śubhā yajñopavītī haṃsastha ekavaktraścaturbhujaḥ padmavarṇaḥ kālaḥkarālavadanaḥ nīlāṃgaścāti bhīṣaṇaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhurmesyācchubha pradaḥ nīlameghavarṇaḥ ekabhogāstribhogā vā sarvekāryāśca bhīṣaṇāḥ raktavarṇaḥ pāśadaṃḍadharaḥ kāryassarpavṛścikaromavān kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kapotavāhanā nityaṃ ketavassyūrvarapradāḥ (ketūnāṃbahutvepi ekasyaiva prādhānyam ) dhūmravarṇāḥ akṣasrakkuṃḍikābhīti dānahastaṃ viciṃtaye padmavarṇaḥ dakṣiṇe lekhinīṃ caiva dadhaṃvāme ca patrakam kanakavarṇaḥ

dhyāyāmi daityahaṃtrīṃ tāṃraktā svādana tatparām nīlavarṇā śūrpakarṇaṃ namasyāmi śirasākhuvarasthitam raktavarṇaḥ trilocanaṃ cordhvakeśamatikruddhaṃ sudaṃṣṭrakam kṣudraghaṃṭā baddhagulphaṃ kapālasragvibhūṣaṇam dakṣiṇeśūlavetāla khaḍgaduṃdubhidhāriṇam kṣetrapālamahaṃvande sarvāriṣṭopa śāṃtaye śyāmavarṇaḥ abhayaṃkaramīḍehaṃ satataṃ saukhyadāyinam kanakavarṇaḥ || (anyatsarvamiṃdravat 4 ni0) vaṃdehaṃ vāstupuruṣaṃ śayānaṃ śayane śubhe nīlavarṇaḥ || dvibhujaḥ maulibaddheṃdu vigaladamṛtādraṃsitadyutim bhaktārtiharamīśānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamupāsmahe śvetavarṇaḥ supakvāmrātasīpuṣpanīlābjaśukasannibhāḥ śaṃkhapadmadharāssarve varābhayakarāstu vai || 2 daṃḍahastaṃ ca vṛṣalaṃ dadṛśe nṛpalāṃchanam || (1 skaṃ0 17 adhyā0) kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ pītaḥkalaughanaśyāmo vāsudevaḥ puraḥpumān sukhāsīnāścāruhastā yugānāmadhi devatāḥ || 2 raktākṣasthūladehaśca prabhavobrāhmaṇaḥ pumān kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ divyāṃgadaṃrathārūḍhaṃ dhyāyedvibhavamīdṛśam meghavarṇaḥ

lipikalpadrumasyādho dhyāyechruklākhya vatsaram śvetavarṇaḥ pramodūtassavijñeyaḥ kāṃtāliṃgitavigrahaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ mahodaro lohitākṣo vatsarastu prajāvatiḥ raktavarṇaḥ padmahastadvayaṃ devaṃ dhyāyedāṃgira sābhidham śvetavarṇaḥ puṣkarākṣaṃ haridrābhaṃ dhyāyecchrīmukhavatsaram kanakavarṇaḥ ūrdhvabāhuyutaścaiva dvibhujaḥ kṣatriyassmṛtaḥ raktavarṇaḥ dvibhujaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca padmākṣaṃyuvavatsaram śvetavarṇaḥ triṇetraṃ padmavarṇaṃ ca nirbhayaṃ dhātusaṃjñakam padmavarṇaḥ citrāṃbaradharaṃdevaṃ dhyāyedīśvarasaṃjñakam aruṇavarṇaḥ vitatalalitatejādīrghavakṣādvipādaḥ kamalanayanayuktaściṃtitodvādaśobdaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ graiveyakṛtamāṇikyaḥ pramāthī vatsaraḥpumān kanakavarṇaḥ madhyamoccaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ dvipādaṃ vikramaṃ viduḥ godhūmavarṇaḥ ākhubhuksadṛśokṣibhyāṃ mukhevraṇayutaścalaḥ

nīlavarṇaḥ devālaye japansthāne nānālaṃkārabhūḍitaḥ kapilavarṇaḥ tṛṣārtomeṣavadanassvabhānurdvibhujo vibhuḥ kapilavarṇaḥ nīrajākṣo vyāghrapātsyād gajāsyastāraṇābhidhaḥ raktavarṇaḥ taskarodaṃḍayuktaśca sthūloṣaṭhaḥ pārthivaḥ smṛtaḥ gauravarṇaḥ nipuṇaḥ satyavākcaiva vyayovyayakaraḥpumān kapilavarṇaḥ saddhastaḥ kūpakhanakaḥ sarvajitsarvasādhakaḥ gauravarṇaḥ sūkṣmoṣṭho dīrghadehaśca sarvadhārī ca sarvadā raktavarṇaḥ sūkṣmagrīvasthūladehasthūlamadhyo virodhikaḥ raktavarṇaḥ śuṣkodarodīrghakaṃtho raktākṣo vikṛtiḥ pumān gauravarṇaḥ varadhābhayapāṇiśca gadāpadmadharaḥ paraḥ raktavarṇaḥ bhasmarudrākṣasaṃyukto varado naṃdanaḥ pumān raktavarṇaḥ vāmatassarvato dṛṣṭirvijayorjunamūlagaḥ padmavarṇaḥ

varadābhayapāṇiśca sitaḥ śyāmayutojayaḥ dhūmravarṇaḥ baḍabāpaṃcakārūḍho manmatho manmathā kṛtiḥ kāṃcanavarṇaḥ dvibāhuḥśārṅgapāṇiśca durmukhī durmukholasaḥ raktavarṇau tu tau vṛddhau sadāmātṛsamīpagau śiṃśupākhyatarormūle cāsīnau girisannibhau turaṃgaguptiyuktaśca capalaḥ plavavatsaraḥ raktavarṇaḥ dhāriṇau puṃḍrarudrākṣaṃ malayadrumasannibhau śivanārāyaṇau dhyāyankrodhyabdo hrasvakaḥsitaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ vāpīsopānamāśritya dhyāyanvai viśvato mukham raktavarṇaḥ tiṣṭhatyekaḥ plavatyekaḥ yuvānāvati darpitau śvetavarṇau kīlakaścaiva saumyaśca tapasyaṃtau girestaṭe nīlaraktavarṇau purastāddevamīśānamarcayanvasati dvijaḥ kanakavarṇaḥ raktākṣaḥ sthūladehaśca mṛgānhiṃsaṃścaratyayam nīlavarṇaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ dhyāyanraviṃkṛśonīlaḥ pramādīcodvijaḥ smṛtaḥ ānaṃdo lohito dhyāyannakṣamālāvabhūṣitaḥ

raktavarṇaḥ pathikānbādhamānastu rākṣasaḥ śvānagositaḥ jaṭābhṛcchmamu?laśśāṃtaḥ kṛṣṇobhūti vibhuṣaṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ japataḥ śvetanīlāṃgāṃ varaṇye niṃbasannidhau || 1 śvetavarṇaḥ || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥ tiṣṭhandhyāyanjapanvarṇī śvetassidhārthivatsaraḥ śvetavarṇaḥ raktākṣaḥ sthūladehaśca śyāmo?kṣakriḍane rataḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ khaḍgacarmadharoraktaḥ śatrucchedanalālasaḥ raktavarṇaḥ dhyāyanvasati niśśaṃkaṃ viṣṇuṃ vai viśvarūpiṇam nīlavarṇaḥ arcayandroṇapuṣpaistu rudramekādaśātmakam kanakavarṇaḥ strībhiḥkrīḍanbhūṣitāṃgo raktākṣī tu yuvāvibhuḥ śvetavarṇaḥ śvabhiḥ kriḍanvilolākṣo krodhano vikṛtānanaḥ raktavarṇaḥ krūraḥ kṛṣṇo dīrgharomā'kṣayo dīrghākṛtiḥ pumān kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ idvatsaraḥ iḍāvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ parivatsaraḥ anuvatsaraḥ iti saṃjñāstu prabhavādiṣu ṣaṣṭisaṃvatsareṣu āditaḥ paṃcānāṃ paṃcānāmekaikaśaḥ krameṇa jñeyāḥ sarvabhogayutadīrghajīvito jāyate prabhavasaṃbhavaḥ pumān rājābhavedātmakule suśīlovidvānmanuṣyo vibhavābdajanmā

sadbhāgyavidyāvinayopapannonūnaṃ pumāñchuklasamudbhavaḥ syāt dakṣaśca dhūrtaḥ parakāryakartā pramodajanmāmanujobhimānī devadvirjārcābhirato vinītomartyaḥ prajādhīśasamadbhavassyāt saguptabuddhiḥ khaludīrghajīvī naroṃgirogirovatsarasaṃbhavassyāt satkīrtiyuktotitarāmudāro bhavennaraḥ śrīmukhasaṃbhavaśca sadāsaharṣo vimato bahūnāṃ bhāvābhidhānodbhavamānavassyāt sudhīścirāyurdṛḍhadehaśālī jātoyuvābde puruṣassatoṣaḥ śilpaśāstrakuśalaśca suśīlodhātuvatsara bhavohinarassyāt dakṣaḥkalākauśalaśīlaśālī martyobhavedīśvara jātajanmā bahuprakārairbahudhānyavittaḥ syānmānavo vai bahudhānyajanmā maṃtrī nareṃdrasyanaraḥ kṛtajñaḥ pramāthisaṃvatsarasaṃbhavassyāt śūraśca vīrotitarāmudāraḥ parākramīvikramavarṣajātaḥ bartā bahūnāṃgalinolasaśca jāto vṛṣābdemanujoti lubdhaḥ cāruśīlavilasatkalācitaścitrabhānujanito hi pūruṣaḥ prasannamūrtissamasiddhihūtissvabhānusaṃvatsarajo narassyāt utpannabhoktādraviṇena muktassyāt tāraṇābdodbhavamānavo yaḥ kalākalāpekuśalo vilāsīyaḥ pārthivābde kulapārthivassyāt jātaḥ pumānasthiracittavṛttirvyayābhidhāne vyayakarmaśīlaḥ || 1 vairivargavijayodyatassadāsarvajiccharadisaṃbhavaḥ pumān dhīratadguṇayutoti dāruṇassarvadhāriṇi ca yasya saṃbhavaḥ janenasākaṃ gatacittavṛttirvirodhivarṣaprabhavo narassyāt cārubuddhirahitopyamitrakomānavo vikṛtivarṣasaṃbhavaḥ kleśī ca lajjāvidhivarjitassyānnaraḥ kharābdaprabhavoti dīrghaḥ vilāsinīnaṃdanajātaharṣo narobhayennaṃdanavarṣajanmā dātādayāluḥ kilavairihaṃtā yasya prasūtirvijayābhidhāne

jayābhilāpī viṣayānurakto jātojayābde manujo mahaujāḥ sadgītanṛtyābhirataśca bhoktā yo manmathābde jananaṃ prapannaḥ krūroddhato niṃdyamatiśca lubdho vakrāsya bāhvaṃghriraruśaṃ? priyaḥ syāt || viruddhabāṣī bahuduṣṭaceṣṭo yo hāyane durmukhināmnijātaḥ samastavastugrahaṇaikabuddhiryo hemalaṃbi prabhavaḥ pumāntsyāt prārabdhakāryetitarāṃ pralāpī vimalaṃbisaṃvatsarassaṃbhavassyāt analpajalpassvasuhṛdvikalpo vikārisaṃvatsarajonarassyāt anekavidyābhyasanānuraktaḥ saṃvatsare śārvarināmnijātaḥ suguptabuddhiścapalasvabhāvaḥ plavābhidhānābdabhavonarassyāt syānmānavassūnudhanorusaṃpadyasya prasūtiḥ śubhakṛtsamāsu kāṃtovinītaḥ śubhakṛtpravīṇoyaḥ śobhakṛdvatsarasaṃbhavaḥ syāt ācāratolpatvaśaṭhatvayuktaḥ parābhave yasya bhavet prasūtiḥ dhūrtassadācāravicārahīnaḥ plavaṃgajovaimanujaḥ kṛśāṃgaḥ sthūlāṃghrisanmauliralaṃbalīyāñjātorikīlaḥ kilakīlakābde sāttvikaḥ kṛśakalebarayaṣṭiḥ saumyavatsarabhavomanujastu krodhīśucirbhoganivṛttacetāḥ prāṇī hi sādhāraṇajaḥ pragītaḥ parāṅmukhastātavacasyatīvavirodhikṛnnāmni hi janma yasya vyāpārasaṃprāptamahatpratiṣṭhaḥ pumānbhavedvai paridhāvināmni syādalpadhīrgarhitakarmakarttā pramādi janmā manujaḥ pramādī prājñaḥ kṛtajñaḥ sutarāṃvinītopyānaṃdajāto manujovadānyaḥ dayāvihīnaśca sasāhasopi bhavennaro rākṣasavarṣajanmā syādalpavitto bahupālakaśca jātonalābde capalomanuṣyaḥ tyāgīśaṭhotyaṃtakaṭhoravākyo jātonaraḥ piṃgalanāmadheye nareṃdramaṃtrī bahupūjitārthaḥ siddhārthijāto manujaḥ samarthaḥ jātāpakīrtiḥ khalacittavṛttirnarotiraudraḥ khaluraudrijanmā kāmīprakāmaṃ duritepravṛtto yo durmatirdurmati varṣajātaḥ

tauryatrikaprītiratīvajātaścenmānavo duṃdubhināmavarṣe pādadvaṃdve bhavati kunakhīhastayuṇmethavāsyācchastrāddukhaṃ vrajatirudhirodgārijanmāmanuṣyaḥ anyādhikattvaṃ sahatenakiṃcidraktākṣijātokṣirujānvitaśca parasyabuddhiṃ praharetprakāmaṃ yohāyane krodhananāmnijātaḥ satkāryaketyalpamanaḥ pravṛtiḥ kṣayābhidhāne jananaṃ hi yasya || 1 āṃgīrasaḥ śrīmukhaśca bhāvothayuvavatsaraḥ citrabhānuḥ svabhānuśca tāraṇaḥ pārthivo vyayaḥ naṃdanovijayaścaiva jayomanmathadurmukhau śubhakṛcchobhakṛtkrodhī viśvāvasuparābhavau paridhāvīpramādīsyādānaṃdo rākṣasonalaḥ duṃdubhīrudhirodgāriraktākṣī krodhanākṣayau ṣaḍānanaśca vallī ca gaurībrahmīmaheśvarī cāmuṃḍikāpyarogaśca bhrājaḥpaṭara eva ca raviḥsūryaśca bhānuśca khagaḥ pūṣā tathaiva ca arkastatobhāskarāgni jātavedassahaujasaḥ paṅtirāthavisarpiśca matsyakūrmavarāhakāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kalkībuddhadurgeyā tu dhānaśca bhairavaḥ abhimāninya eteṣāmabdānāṃ devatāḥ kramāt || 7 vakṣobhāgavirājamānaviśadaśrībrahmasūtrojjvalaṃ vaṃdehaṃ prabhavābhidhaṃ kamalajaṃ śreyobhivṛddhipradam padmavarṇaḥ karairanaṃtāsanasanniviṣṭaṃ dhyāyedrameśaṃvibhavādhinātham meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ vṛṣavarakṛtavāhaṃ śuklasaṃjñaṃ girīśaṃnamadamaramunīṃdraṃ śūlapāṇiṃ namāmi śvetavarṇaḥ pratyūhaśāṃtipradamākhusaṃsthaṃ dhyāyeddhṛdabje satataṃ gaṇeśam

raktavarṇaḥ bhakteṣṭapātho nidhipūrṇacaṃdrāṃ vaṃdeprajotpatti kṛtābhidhānām raktavarṇā āṃgirasanāmadheyaṃ ṣaṇmukhamīḍemareṃdrasenānyam raktavarṇaḥ śrīmukhasaṃjñāṃ vallīṃ śreyovṛddhipradāmahaṃkalaye pāṭalavarṇā bhāvākhyā mahamīḍe bhavakutukāṃbhodhi pūrṇacaṃdrāṃtām marakatavarṇā haṃsapravarārūḍhāṃ śaṃbhumanohārirūpasaubhāgyām kanakavarṇā caṃdrāvataṃsasahitā śreyovṛddhipradāsadāśaṃbhoḥ śubhravarṇā tāmīśvarābhidhānāṃśaṃ karatoṣapradāṃ svarūpeṇa pāṭalavarṇā śaṃkaravāmāṃkasthāṃ namatāmiṣṭārthadāyikāmaniśam meghaśyāmavarṇā śreyobhivṛddhidātrīṃ kṛtanijanāmnīṃ pramāthīti śyāmavarṇā bhāsuracaṃdrakirīṭāṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāṃbhiyāṃśāṃtyai kanakavarṇā vi(vṛ)ṣunāmnīṃ suravaṃdyāṃ daityakuladhvaṃsakāriṇīmaniśam kṛṣṇavarṇā turaṃgamavarārūḍhaṃ makuṭojjvalamastakam raktavarṇaḥ

gajārūḍhaṃlasatkhaḍgakheṭahastaṃ namāmyaham raktavarṇaḥ tāraṇaṃ sūryagamanaṃ śūlodbhāsikarāṃbujam raktavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakradharaṃdivya pītāṃbaramahaṃbhaje raktavarṇaḥ caṃdrāvataṃsaṃ jaṭilaṃ triṇetraṃśūlabhāsuram raktavarṇaḥ bhṛśuṃḍīpāśahastābjaṃ vyāghrārūḍhaṃ trilocanam raktavarṇaḥ iṣṭaprāptyaisadāvaṃde saptāśvarathamāsthitam raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) kaśyapaṃ paṃcavadanaṃ daśahastaṃ namāmyaham raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) pannageśvaramārūḍhaṃ cārupītāṃbarā vṛtam raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) sūryābhidhaṃ kharaṃvaṃde caturvaktāṣṭa hastakam raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) mṛgeṃdravāhanaṃpaṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ bhaje raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) vyāghracarmāṃbaradharaṃvaṃde vijayasaṃjñakam raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) śaṃkhacakrāṃkitakaradvaṃdvaṃ hṛdisamāśraye raktavarṇaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaṃvaṃdehaṃ manmathākhyaṃ mameṣṭadam

raktavarṇaḥ vivṛttāsyaṃ jagadbhīti dāyakaṃ saṃśraye mudā raktavarṇaḥ || (śaṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) saptasaptisamārūḍhaṃ jagatāṃ netramāśraye raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5) cāpabāṇadharaṃdorbhyāṃ turaṃgavaravāhanam raktavarṇaḥ kraravyāghrasamārūḍhamekanetraṃ namāmyaham raktavarṇaḥ cakrojjvalakaraṃvaṃde bhāsvadrathasamāśritam raktavarṇaḥ ajārūḍhaṃ caturhastaṃ dviśīrṣaṃ plavasaṃjñakam raktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭamagnivat ni0 4) āṃdolikāsamārūḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭadharaṃ śubham raktavarṇaḥ śibikāvāhanārūḍhaṃ cāmaradvayapāṇikam raktavarṇaḥ gorathārūḍhamaniśaṃ kuṃtojjvalakarāṃbujam raktavarṇaḥ naravāhanamārūḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭadharaṃśubham raktavarṇaḥ uttuṃgaturagārūḍhaṃ paraśūjjvalapāṇikam raktavarṇaḥ śvetāśvavaramārūḍhaṃ śārṅgavāṇadharaṃ sadā raktavarṇaḥ

uttuṃgagajamārūḍhaṃ śūlojjvalakarāṃbujam raktavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakrojjvalakaraṃbhaktābhīṣṭapradāyakam śvetavarṇaḥ kāṃcanavarṇaḥ varadābhayadaṃ vaṃde virodhikṛditi śrutam śyāmavarṇaḥ prahlādaharṣadātāraṃ parīdhāvikṛtā hvayam śvetavarṇaḥ balipratāpanakaraṃpramādī ca kṛtāhvayam śyāmavarṇaḥ dūrvādalavat rāmamānaṃdanāmānaṃ dhṛtakodaṃḍamārgaṇam śyāmavarṇaḥ bhārgavaṃrāmamāśāse rākṣasābhidhamaṃjasā kāṃcanavarṇaḥ balarāmamahaṃvaṃde nalāhvayamaharniśam śubhravarṇaḥ navanītojjvalakaraṃnṛtyaṃ taṃ hṛdisaṃśraye śyāmavarṇaḥ āśrayekalkimārūḍhaṃ dhanurbāṇakaraṃ sadā śvetavarṇaḥ nagnaṃvirūpavapuṣaṃ stripradharṣaṇakāraṇam pāṭalavarṇaḥ dhyāyāmidaityahaṃtrīṃtāṃ raktāsvādanatatparām nīlavarṇā

dhyāyāmyaniṣṭaśāṃtyarthaṃ durmatītikṛtāhvayam nīlavarṇaḥ bhairavaṃśca varārūḍhaṃ digaṃbaramupāśraye śyāmavarṇaḥ samudralaṃghanodyuktaṃ dīrghalāṃgūlamāśraye kanakavarṇaḥ raktāṃkṣasaṃjñikāṃ devīṃ prapadyevāgvibhūtidām śvetavarṇā śukārūḍhāṃśūladharāṃbhajebhīṣṭārthasiddhaye kanakavarṇā haṃsārūḍhāmiṃdumukhīṃpāṇidvayakṛtāṃbujām svarṇavarṇā || 1 pītavastrovahankuṃḍaṃ karṇikāradalākṛtiḥ pūjitaḥ siddhaye nityaṃ dhanadhānyasamṛddhaye śyāmavarṇaḥ māṃjiṣṭhavasanopetaḥ svarṇamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ dadhanmuktyaimude ca syāt pūjanīyastu kīrtaye śvetavarṇaḥ || 1 bhavati dakṣiṇamanyadṛtutrayaṃ nigaditārajanī marutāṃ ca sā || 1 dakṣiṇāśā mukhe kurvan na tatphalamavāpnuyāt || 1 || - || mahiṣāsurahaṃtrī ca sthāpyā vai dakṣiṇāyane || 1 || - || saumyāyane karmaśubhaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ yadgarhitaṃ tatkhalu dakṣiṇe syāt sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṃdate paramaṃ sukham || 1 || - || tilapūrṇamanaḍvāhaṃ dattvārogaiḥ pramucyate ghṛtābhiṣekaṃ vā kuryān mahāpuṇyaphalecchayā

gavyenājyena vā śaṃbhoḥ pradadyādghṛtakaṃbalam narassadātrāṇaparopyudārobhīruśca saumyāyanajātajanmā śaṭhopyasahyonanumānavānāṃ yāmyāyane yojananaṃ prapannaḥ bhāsvadrathagataṃsūryaṃ caṃdranakṣatrasaṃvṛtam raktavarṇaḥ divyasyaṃdanamārūḍhaṃ sūryādigrahasaṃyutam śvetavarṇaḥ akṣamālodyatakaraṃ paṃcākṣaraparāyaṇam baddhapadmāsanāsīnaḥ prāṅkhohasitānanaḥ bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgo vasaṃtostumudemama śvetavarṇaḥ akṣasūtrārka hastastu caṃdraśubhrātapatrayuk grīṣmaṃprāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ viṣṭare munipūjite kamaṃḍalūjjvalakaraṃ namāmi śirasānvaham dhūmravarṇaḥ tāmravarṇaśukopetaḥ nīlavidrumakuṃḍalaḥ meghamālāvṛtaścaiva vidyutvānathadīptimān śirasāpraṇamāmyadyavarṣāharṣābhidhāyikāḥ haridvarṇaḥ kaṃṭhemauktikamālastu karṇeceṃdrāśmakuṃḍalaḥ dadhānaḥ pūjanīyoyamāyurvṛddhyaisukhāya ca ṛtuḥ pratyaṅmukhāsīnaḥ sphā.ikaṃ valayaṃ vahan caṃdragauravarṇaḥ pītavastrasamāvītastrijaṭaḥ kṛṣṇagodhikaḥ pūjanīyo vibhūtyarthaṃ dhānyasaṃpadvivṛddhaye

śuciryajñopavītī ca prasīdatu śubhapradaḥ kapilavarṇaḥ pītakuṃḍalakarṇastu kaṃṭhevidrumamālakaḥ vāmedhānyaśarāvaṃ ca dhārayanniṣṭavṛddhaye sūryabiṃbādṛtakaraṃ paṃcākṣarajapodyatam haridvarṇaḥ || 1 yānakānāṃ tathāgrīṣme chatrāṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram || 1 || - || vipreṣuviprakanyāsu tilādīntsaṃprayacchati vahnerdānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā sūryamuddiśya codaye kulmāṣaṃ sughṛtaṃdattvā yathāśaktyā dvijātiṣu śastrāstra śīlāmala cittavṛttiḥ vasaṃtajāto manujaḥ prasannaḥ bhogībhavennāti vicāraśīlo yo grīṣmakāle jananaṃ prapannaḥ kaphānilātmālalanāvilāsī varṣovyo?vaipuruṣaḥ saharṣaḥ raṇapriyo vāhanasaṃyutaśca ṛatau śarannāmni ca janma yasya satkarmadharmānurato manasvī hemaṃtajātaḥ satataṃ vinītaḥ satkarmaveṣaḥ puruṣaḥ saroṣobalādiśālīśiśirartujanmā || 1 etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāmadhi devatāḥ puṣpabāṇavinirbhinna jagattrayamahaṃbhaje kāṃcanavarṇaḥ śaktisruksruvahastāḍhyaṃ devaṃ bhaktajana priyam lohitavarṇaḥ nakrārūḍhaṃ pāśapāṇiṃ lokānāṃ jīvanapradam kanakavarṇaḥ vaṃdelokaikajananīṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīm haridvarṇā

kādraveyaṃ mahāsattvaṃ bhajemāṃpātu sarvadā śvetavarṇaḥ vaṃdetripurahaṃtāraṃ samebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu śvetavarṇaḥ || 1 jagadānaṃdajanakaṃ madhumāsamupāsmahe raktavarṇaḥ garutmadvāhanārūḍhaṃ vaṃdebhīṣṭasya siddhaye śvetavarṇaḥ vaiyyāghravāhanārūḍhaṃ śuklamāsamupāsmahe śvetavarṇaḥ upāsmaheśuciṃmāsaṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāyakam aruṇavarṇaḥ paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ sāraṃgapravarasthitam haridvarṇaḥ caturmukhaṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ haṃsapravarasaṃsthitam śvetavarṇaḥ bhaktābhīṣṭapradaṃnityamiṣamāsamupāsmahe aruṇavarṇaḥ kailāsasikharārūḍhamūrjamāsamupāsmahe śvetavarṇaḥ namāmi śirasādevaṃ sahākhyaṃmāsamanvaham śvetavarṇaḥ dhyāyehaṃmanasānityaṃ sahasyaṃ māsamanvaham haridvarṇaḥ dhyāyāmiṣṭakṛtenityaṃ tapomāsamananyadhīḥ

haridvarṇaḥ brahmasūtrojjvalāṃsaṃca kirīṭāṃkitamastakam pāṭalavarṇaḥ || 1 jyeṣṭhaḥ śuklaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ śucirāṣāḍhakoruṇaḥ bhādronabhasyaḥ śvetaḥ syādāśvayugro hitoruṇaḥ puṣyaḥ sahasyo haritaḥ māghopi haritaḥ smṛtaḥ uktāmāsādhi devāśca varṇaiste pṛthivīpate viṣṇoḥprītyarthametāni deyānibrāhmaṇoṣviti haviṣyaṃbrahmacaryaṃ ca bhūśayyāni yama sthitiḥ apijanmasahasrotthaṃ pāpaṃdahati dāruṇam trivikramasya prītyarthaṃ dātavyaṃ jyeṣṭhamāsi ca āṣāḍhe vāmanaprītyai dātavyānīhabhaktitaḥ śrāvaṇeśrīdharaprītyai dātavyāni dinedine hṛṣīkeśaprīṇanārthaṃ darpaṇaṃ sa guḍodanam prītyarthaṃ padmanābhasya deyamāśvayuje naraiḥ dāmodarasya prītyarthaṃ pradadyāt kārtike naraḥ dātavyā viṣṇusaṃprītyai mārgaśīrṣe narottamaiḥ subhagodarśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate pauṃḍarīka phalaṃ tasya divase divase bhavet goviṃdaprīṇanārthāya dātavyaṃ puruṣarṣabha || 1 pauṣekanakadānena parāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathaiva ca satpātradānānu rataśca maṃtrī caitrodbhavaścāpi vicitramaṃtraḥ kāmīcirāyurjalayānaśīlassyānmādhave bāṃdhavasaukhyayuktaḥ vicitrabuddhiḥ khaludīrghasūtro jyeṣṭhodbhavaśśreṣṭhataronarassyāt sadāgnimāṃdyaśśubhakarmakṛtsyādāṣāḍhajogāḍhatarābhimānaḥ

lokaprasiddhaḥ kaphavānvadānyoyaśśrāvaṇe puṇyaguṇaiḥ sapūrṇaḥ sukhaiśca duḥkhairvikṛto hi martyo dhūrto bhavedbhādrapadesujanmā dātāguṇajño bahuputrasaṃtatissyādāśvine'śvādi samṛddhibhājī kāmaṃ sa kāmaḥ krayavikrayārtha satkāryakṛtkārtikajātajanmā paropakarttā dhṛtasādhumārgo mārgodbhavo vai vibhavaissametaḥ suguptamaṃtraḥ kṛtaśāstrayuktaḥ pauṣeviśeṣī puruṣaḥ kalāvān buddherviśeṣādvijitārisaṃgho māghodbhavassyādanagho manuṣyaḥ vilāsinīkelividhānaśīloyaḥ phālgunephalguvaco vilāsaḥ || 1 pūjāḥkrameṇamāseṣusarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye (eṣāṃlakṣaṇānikeśavādi caturviśatimūrtivat ni0 2) kapālābhayahastāsyādekavaktrākarālikā raktavarṇā śvetavarṇā mahāghorā kapālābhayasaṃyutā śvetavarṇā abhayaṃ ca kapālaṃ ca dadhānaikamukhīśubhā pāṭalāṃgī dvihastā ca kapālābhayadhāriṇī pāṭalavarṇā jihmikāsiṃhasaṃkrāṃtirekavaktrā prasīdatu raktavarṇā siṃhikānāmavijñeyā kapālābhayaśobhitā mukhekṛṣṇavarṇā || deheraktavarṇā maṃdātriṇetrasahitā kapālābhayadhāriṇī nīlavarṇā kapālaśaktihastā ca saṃkrāṃtirvṛścikābhidhā nīlavarṇā

kapālābhayahastā ca dhanussakrāṃtirucyate citravarṇā kapālavajrahastā ca rākṣasī coṣṭravāhanā raktavarṇā kapālābhayahastā ca kuṃbhasaṃkrāṃtirīritā nīlavarṇā mīnākhyāruṇavarṇāsyāt kapālābhayasaṃyutā aruṇavarṇā || 1 jiṃhikāsihmikāmaṃdāhlādinī cojjvalāmatā rākṣasībhaṃjikāvakrā ceti saṃkrāṃtayaḥ kramāt kukkuṭājau ca mahisaścoṣṭrośvo ṛkṣa eva ca etānivāhanānisyuḥ saṃkrāṃtī nāmajāditaḥ vṛṣasaṃkramaṇedānaṃ gavāṃproktaṃ tathaiva ca ghṛtadhenupradānaṃ tu karkaṭe pariśasyate kanyāpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ surabhīṇāṃ tathaiva ca kīṭapraveśe vastrāṇāṃ veśmanāṃdānameva ca mṛgapraveśedārūṇāṃ dānamagnestathaiva ca mīnapraveśe hyamlānamālyānāmapi cottamam vivasvattvaṣṭṛviṣṇvaṃśubhagapūṣaṇa eva ca parjanyaśca dvādaśaite saṃkrāṃtīnāṃ hi devatāḥ pulastyastuṃbururītimadhumāsaṃnayaṃtyamī raśmijālasamāślaṣṭastamastomavināśanaḥ apsarāḥkṛtasthalī || gaṃdharvastuṃbaruḥ || pulastya-ṛṣiḥ || pāśasthānīyo vāsukiḥ || rathakṛdākhyovardhakiḥ || hetirnāmārākṣasaḥ || raśmayoṣṭasahasrāṇi || raktavarṇaḥ nāradaḥ kacchanīraśca nayaṃtyetesmamādhavam aryamāstu sadābhūtyai bhūyasyai praṇatasya me

vṛṣabhemāsi aryamāsūryaḥ || pulaha-ṛṣiḥ || apsarāḥ puṃjikasthalī || nāradākhyogaṃdharvaḥ | kacchanīrākhyonāgaḥ || ūrjākhyovardhakiḥ || prahetīrākṣasaḥ || raśmayodaśasahasrāṇi || pītavarṇaḥ rathasvana itihyete śuklamāsaṃnayaṃtyamī mitrostu mama modāyatamastomavināśanaḥ mithunamāsimitrassūryaḥ || atrir-ṛṣiḥ || menakāpsarāḥ || hāhāgaṃdharvaḥ || takṣakonāgaḥ || rathasvanākhyovardhakiḥ || pauruṣeyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayassaptasahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥ śukaścitrasvanaścaiva śucimāsaṃnayaṃtyamī kālabhūtaḥ kāmarūpo hyaruṇassevyate mayā karkakemāsi aruṇassūryaḥ || vasiṣṭha-ṛṣiḥ || raṃbhā'psarāḥ || hūhūrgaṃdharvaḥ || śukākhyonāgaḥ || citrasvanovardhakiḥ || sahajanyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayaḥpaṃcasahasrāṇi || śyāmavarṇaḥ pramlocārākṣasaśśaryo nabhomāsaṃnayaṃtyamī śirasāpraṇamāmyadyaśreyovṛddhipradāyakam siṃhemāsi iṃdrassūryaḥ || aṃgirā ṛṣiḥ || viśvāvasūrgaṃdharvaḥ || pramlocā'psarāḥ || ilāputronāgaḥ || śrotrākhyovardhakiḥ || śaryākhyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayassaptasahasrāṇi || śvetavarṇaḥ anumlocāśśaṃkhapālonabhasyākhyaṃnayaṃtyamī nabhograhamahādīpaṃ vivasvaṃtaṃ namāmyaham kanyāmāsivivasvānsūryaḥ || bhṛgur-ṛṣiḥ || anumlocāpsarāḥ || ugrasenogaṃdharvaḥ || śaṃkhapālonāgaḥ || āsāraṇovardhakiḥ || vyāghrorākṣasaḥ || raśmayodaśasahasrāṇi || babhruvarṇaḥ brahmarātothaśatajiddhṛtarāṣṭra iṣaṃbharā nānāśilpakaronānā dhāturūpaḥ prabhākaraḥ tulāmāsitvaṣṭāsūryaḥ || brahmarāta-ṛṣiḥ || tilottamā'psarāḥ || dhṛtarāṣṭrogaṃdharvaḥ || kaṃbalākhyonāgaḥ || śatajinnāmāvardhakiḥ || ṛcīkākhyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayoṣṭasahasrāṇi || citravarṇaḥ viśvāmitro mahāpreta ūrjamāsaṃnayaṃtyamī gāyatripratipādyaṃtaṃ viṣṇuṃbhaktyā namāmyaham vṛścikemāsiviṣṇussūryaḥ || viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ || raṃbhā'psarāḥ || sūryavarcāgaṃdharvaḥ || satyajinnāmāvardhakiḥ || aśvataronāgaḥ || mahāpretorākṣasaḥ || raśmayaḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥ vidyuchatrurmahāśaṃkhassahomāsaṃnayaṃtyamī munīṃdranivahastutyobhūtidoṃśurbhavenmama dhanurmāsi aṃśussūryaḥ || kāśyapa ṛṣiḥ || urvaśyapsarāḥ || ṛtasenogaṃdharvaḥ || mahāśaṃkhonāgaḥ || tārkṣyovardhakiḥ || vidyucchatrūrākṣasaḥ || raśmayonavasahasrāṇi || haridvarṇaḥ karkoṭakaḥ pūrvacittiḥ pauṣamāsaṃnayaṃtyamī ghaṭikānāṃ ca yaḥ kartābhagobhāgyapradostume makaremāsibhagassūryaḥ || ariṣṭanemir-ṛṣiḥ || pūrvacittirapsarāḥ || ūrṇogaṃdharvaḥ || karkoṭakonāgaḥ || āyurvardhakiḥ || sphūrjorākṣasaḥ || raśmaya ekādaśasahasrāṇi || raktavarṇaḥ

ghṛtācīgautamaśceti tapomāsaṃnayaṃtyamī sahasrakarasaṃvītassamastā śāṃtarāṃtaraḥ kuṃbhemāsipuṣāsūryaḥ || gautama ṛṣiḥ || ghṛtācyapsarāḥ || surucirgaṃdharvaḥ || dhanaṃjayonāgaḥ || suṣeṇovardhakiḥ || dhātārākṣasaḥ || raśmayaṣṣaṭsahasrāṇi || alaktakavarṇaḥ viśvaścairāvataścaiva tapasyākhyaṃnayaṃtyamī jagadānaṃdajanakaḥ parjanyaḥ pūjyate mayā mīnemāsiparjanyassūryaḥ || bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ || varcāgaṃdharvaḥ || airāvatonāgaḥ || senajidvardhakiḥ || viśvorākṣasaḥ || raśmayonavasahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgeśiraścakraṃ sthānevimalamaṃḍalam uraḥpradeśe vimalaṃsyamaṃtakamahāmaṇim samāśvamekacakraṃ ca bhāvayerathamāsthitam aruṇoharitaścaiva śoṇaḥkāṃtanibhoruṇaḥ kṣayaḥ kārtikāadi trayenānyathā syāt tadāvarṣamadhyedhimāsadvayaṃ ca saguḍājyaphalaṃdadyāt kāṃsyapātrapratiṣṭhitam saptahastaṃ tripādaṃ ca dviśīrṣaṃ cordhvadṛṣṭikam gadāṃvāme ca bibhrāṇaṃ kheṭaṃpātraṃ śarāsanam kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ vīṇāsijīrṇaśūrpāaṇi sitapadmaṃ śarāsanam tulādaṃḍamahīṃdraṃ ca dadhānā saptabhiḥ karaiḥ asiṃśurpaṃsitāṃbhojaṃ tulādaṃḍaṃśarāsanam sarpaṃcakrakacaṃ caiva bibhrāṇā varadāstume mahodarīti vikhyātā jīrṇaśūrpaṃ sitāṃbujam bibhrāṇā varadābhūyāt sarvadāriṣṭaśāṃtaye || 2 sitapadmaśarāse ca tulādaṃḍaṃphaṇīṃdrakam krakacakṣurikābāṇān bibhrāṇā śubhadā sadā śarāsanatulādaṃḍau nāgeṃdraṃ krakacaṃ śarān kṣurikāṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ ca dadhānābāhubhirmudā

tulādaṃḍamahīṃdraṃ ca krakacaṃ kṣurikāṃ tathā viśikhaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ ca kuṃtaṃcāpi bibhartyasau jihmagakrakacau cāpi kṣurikāṃ bāṇameva ca bhiṃḍivālaṃ ca kuṃtaṃ ca bhuśuṃḍīṃ bibhratī karaiḥ ṣaṣṭiyojanavistīrṇā śatayojanamunnatā ūrdhvakeśī virūpākṣī saṃkrāṃtiḥ puruṣā kṛtiḥ nīlavarṇā kastūrikāṃ caiva suhemapātramannaṃ ca bhuṅkte hi bavevivasvān nīlavarṇaḥ kāṃsyaṃ ca pātraṃ sahabhiṃḍivālaṃdhatte raviḥ pāyasabhuk ca bālave nīlavaraṇaḥ bhakṣyaudanorājitabhūṣaṇaścasatāmrapātraḥkhalukaulaverkaḥ || 1 || nīlavaraṇaḥ dhattedyayaḥpātrampūpabhojanomāṇisyabhuṣāmapitailerkaḥ || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ || nīlāni vastrāṇi ca sīsapātraṃ japāprasūnānigaredadhāti nīlavarṇaḥ nīlotpalaṃnīlamaṇīṃ ca dhattedadhyannabhoktātrapupātradhārī nīlavarṇaḥ dhatteharidrāvapikāṃsyapātraṃ citrānnabhuksvarṇavibhūṣaṇorkaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ sa caṃpakaḥ pīśi?diśiprayātoguḍāśanaḥ śākunikoravissyāt nīlavarṇaḥ dhatte ca meṣenugataḥ sunidraścatuṣpade madhvaśanoravistu nīlavarṇaḥ kuṃḍānivibhraccasapūti gaṃdhaṃ bhuṃkte dhṛtaṃ nāgavasaṃjñakerkaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ

śarkarābhugathatāmrabhūṣaṇo veṇupātrabhṛdathāṃtyasaṃjñake nīlavarṇaḥ śoṇavastrojaṭālākṣo viśālatilakāṃcitaḥ sūryaṃ dakṣedadhānoyaṃ vāmecaṃdrasya biṃbakam pūjanīyo mahābhaktyā pratipakṣaṃsite'site śvetavarṇaḥ sūyabiṃbaṃ karebibhradvāme sārasamavyayam kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ phalānāṃ ca tathādānaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe mahāphalam sadāsadānaṃdavinītakālaścejjanmakālastu valakṣapakṣe manobhavādhikyayutonitāṃtaṃ sitetareyasya narasya janma āpūryamāṇapakṣāyanamaśśvetavapuṣmate śvetavarṇaḥ asitāya namastestu pitṛprītikarāyavai kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ caturthīpaṃcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamī cāṣṭamītathā trayodaśīcaturdaśyau pūrṇimāśśuklapakṣagāḥ ubhābhyāmapi pakṣābhyāṃ māsastriṃśaddinātmakaḥ meṣagāśaktipātrāsā śvetapakṣādimāmatā aruṇavarṇā dvitīyāhaṃsagāśubhrāśubhrapustakadhāriṇī || śubhravarṇā tṛtīyāvṛṣagāgaurāśūlapātrakarāmatā || gauravarṇā paraśuṃbibhratīpātraṃ pitavastrābhisaṃyutā nīlotpalavarṇā śaṃkhaṃmudrāṃ tathāpātraṃ bibhrāṇā paṃcamī matā

pravālavarṇā aruṇavarṇā meghavarṇā kṣīravarṇā śvetavarṇā kṛṣṇavarṇā sitānanāruṇākṣīsyadiṃdranīlasamadyutiḥ citravarṇā meghavarṇā gauravarṇā nīlakaṃṭhāceṃdragopanayanā ca caturdaśī pāṭalavarṇā sudhāpūr.ṇaṃ ghaṭaṃdhatte vāme dakṣepi dhānakam śvetavarṇā || 1 astraṃpātraṃ sruvaṃcāpaṃ karairdhatte caturbhujā dhūmravarṇā śvetavarṇā nīlavarṇā dhattekṣamālikāṃdaṃḍaṃ pāśaṃpātraṃ ca dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇavarṇā śvetavarṇā ekāsyā dvibhujāṣaṣṭhī raktavastropaśobhitā raktavarṇā gauravarṇā akṣaṃkhetaṃtathākhaḍgaṃ pātraṃdhatte caturbhujā

raktavarṇā śyāmavarṇā jñānamudrābhayāceyaṃ pītavastrābjamālinī śubhravarṇā nīlavarṇā dvādaśīśubhravastreyaṃ nīlakuṃḍalabhūṣitā dvibhujācoragārūḍhā kṛṣṇavarṇā trayodaśī kṛṣṇavarṇā nīlavarṇā darbhāsanasthitā ceyaṃ darbhapiṃḍadharākṛśā marakatavarṇā raṇopakaraṇaṃtatra tithaupratipadīritam pauṣṭivāstvādikaṃkarma dvitīyāyāṃ vidhīyate kāryaṃ dvitīye divase yaduktaṃ sadā tṛtīye divasepi tat syāt yanmaṃgalaṃ tāsukṛtaṃ ca māsairvināśamāyāti tathānumāsam ciraṃsthiraṃsarvakarmapaṃcamyāṃsamudīritam bhūṣākarma ca bhaiṣajyaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vidhīyate tānisidhyaṃti kāryāṇi saptamyāmakhilānyapi strīratnapaṇyākhilabhūṣaṇāni kāryāṇyakāryāṇi maheśatithyām navamyāṃbhūtakarmāṇi bahūnyapi ca kārayet darśanaṃ gṛhakāryāṇi daśamyāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ vāstukaṃśilpanṛttādyamekādaśyāṃ vidhīyate carasthirāṇi dvādaśyāmanyatraśravaṇaṃvinā aśvaśikṣātathālekhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu kārayet caturdaśyāṃ na kartavyamanyacca śubhakarma vā

udvāhaśilpākhilabhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣṭhākhalupaurṇamāsyām kharaṃvaraṃ kaviṃviṣṇuṃ rālaṃsākaṃ viyatkramāt || 1 || - || digvahnyarkamanukṣmābhṛdvasavo ghaṭikāḥ kramāt tṛtīyāyāṃ priyamgūṇāṃ caturthyāṃ rajatasya ca saptamyāṃ vāsasāṃ caiva tvaṣṭamyāṃ vai guḍasya ca ekādaśyāṃ suvarṇasya dvādaśyāṃ vasanasya ca dānaṃ ca paramānnasya paṃcadaśyāṃ mahāphalam dvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃjāto godhānyādhipatirbhavet medhāvī vākparovidvānjātaḥ śuddho jayātithau oṣadhīśatithaujātaḥ kāruṇya caritaḥ kaviḥ mukhapṛṣṭhorutilakaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃjāyate naraḥ sṛṣṭisthityaṃtadakṣassyājjātaśceṃdratithauprabhuḥ kāmīkalatravāṃstyāgī tvaṣṭamyāṃ jāyate naraḥ śūraḥkuputravānvaśyo navamyāṃ jāyate naraḥ nītimānsatyavānvidvāndaśamyāṃ jāyate naraḥ dhanavānprabhukāryaśca goviṃdatithijonaraḥ dhīrastyāgī sukhīvīro dvādaśyāṃ jāyate naraḥ dhanavānnṛttagobhoktā trayodaśyāṃ tu jātavān paradārarataścaiva caturdaśyāṃ tu saṃbhavaḥ putramitrakalatrāḍhyo jātaḥpaṃcadaśī tithau || 1 || - || atisulalitakāṃtirbhūmipālāttavittaḥpratipadiyadisūti jāyate yasya jaṃtoḥ prasannamūrtirbahugītakīrtirjātodvitīyātithisaṃbhavassyāt pravāsaśīlaścaturovilāsī martyastṛtīyāprabhavobhimānī dyūteratirlolamanāmanuṣyo vādīyadisyājjananeṃ caturthī nareṃdramānyastu narovadānyaḥ prasūtikāle kilapaṃcamī syāt

prakṛṣṭakīrtiścaturovariṣṭhaṣṣaṣṭhyāṃ prajātovraṇakīrṇagātraḥ kanyāpanetāparavittahartā syātsaptamījomanujorihaṃtā kāṃtāprītiścaṃcalasvāṃtavṛttiryasyāṣṭamyāṃ jāyate janmasasyāt narassadācārakṛtādarassyādyasya prasūtaunavamītithissyāt udāracitto nitarāṃvinīto ramyaśca kāmī daśamī bhavassyāt puṇyaikacitto gurukarmakṛtsyādekādaśījotikṛśotiroṣaḥ sadānnadātā kṣitipāptavittassyāddvādaśījomanujaḥ prajāvān narotiśuraścaturaḥ prakāmaṃ trayodaśīnāmatithiprasūtaḥ syāddussahotyaṃtaviruddhabhāṣī caturdaśījaḥ puruṣassaroṣaḥ prabalabalavilāsotyaṃtakāruṇyapuṇyo guṇagaṇaparipūrṇaḥ pūrṇimājātajanmā mānyojanānāṃhatakāṃti harṣodarśodbhavassyātpuruṣaḥ kṛśāṃgaḥ śāṃtikarmaṇipūjārthametāṃ mūrtiṃsamāviśa raktavarṇaḥ pratimāyāmamuṣyāṃ tvaṃ sannidhatsvacaturmukha raktavarṇaḥ namasyāmipadābjaṃtepumarthapratipattaye pītavarṇaḥ gajānanārcāṃ gṛhṇīṣvapratimāmetyasādaram raktavarṇaḥ pūjayāmi padābjaṃte sarvasaṃpadavāptaye śubhravarṇaḥ pratimāyāṃhiraṇmayyāmehivallī manaḥ priya raktavarṇaḥ trayītanonamasyāṃte bhūyobhūyaḥ karomyaham raktavarṇaḥ

prasādaṃ kuru me śambho pratimāme hi sādaram śvetavarṇaḥ ihāgatyaprasādaṃ me racayāśu sureśvari śyāmavarṇā namonamostunāgāya pratimā me hi sādaram śubhravarṇaḥ bhūriśreyassādhanāya dharmāyamahate namaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ pratimāmetyasahasā prasādaṃ kuru me vibho kanakavarṇaḥ ehīmāṃpratimāṃtūrṇaṃ prasīdamayimanmatha kāṃcanavarṇaḥ vaṃcanā caturaṃvaṃde bhūtaye kalibhūpatim kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kṣīrābdhipriyapūtrāya namaścaṃdramasestute śvetavarṇaḥ pratimāṃprāpyasauvarṇī prasīdaṃ tu sadāmayi kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ || 1 saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujassyātsadāraviḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī śvetavarṇaḥ caturbhujomeṣagamovaradaḥ syāddharāsutaḥ raktavarṇaḥ khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ

pītavarṇaḥ daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalū iṃdranīlākṛtiḥśūlī varadogṛdhravāhanaḥ bāṇabāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyorkasutaḥsadā nīlavarṇaḥ || 1 auṣadhāhavadhānyādi nilayaṃ bhānuvāsare puṣpagītakratukṣīrakṛṣikarmeduvāsare dhātvākarapravālāstrakarma bhūmijavāsare vivādadhātusaṃgrāmakarmasaumyasya vāsare vṛkṣagulmalatāyānakarmadevejyavāsare paṇyotsavādigodhānyakarma bhārgavavāsare sthirakarmākhilaṃvāstu saṃgrahaḥ saurivāsare || 1 daśajīve tu saptaiva bhṛguje paṃca sūryaje paṃcaviṃśāśukrabhānvormaṃdeṃdvoścāṣṭanāḍikāḥ || 1 tadratnaṃ caiva taddhānyaṃ tadvarṇaṃ vastrameva ca taddineṣu yathāśaktyā sarvātkāmānavāpnuyāt sahiraṇyaṃ naro dattvā na rogairabhibhūyate abhyaṃgaṃsauridivase dattvājīvitamāpnuyāt dātāmahotsāha yutomahaujā dinedine śasya bhavenmanuṣyaḥ kukhe ca duḥkhepi samasvabhāvo vārenaraḥ śītakarasya jātaḥ sattvānvitastīvratarasvabhāvo dinodbhavothāvaninaṃdanasya vaṇikkriyāyāṃ hi bhavedabhijñaḥ prājñoguṇajñojñadinodbhavoyaḥ ācāryavaryaśca janapriyassyādvāreguroryasya narasyajanma śuklāṃbaraḥ prītidharo narassyātsumārgagobhārgavavārajātaḥ tamoguṇaḥ kraurya ca yā bhibhūtaḥ śanerdine jātajanirmanuṣyaḥ || 1

pittavātātmakomānī ravivārodbhavo naraḥ śleṣmalaḥ paradārecchuścaṃdravārodbhavo naraḥ kharvaḥkopī ca senāḍhyaḥ kujavārodbhavonaraḥ sadā tu dharmanirato budhavārodbhavonaraḥ tyāgībhogībhaviṣyajjño guruvārodbhavonaraḥ gaṃdhamālyopabhogī ca śukravārodbhvonaraḥ kunakhīmaṃdakṛtyaśca śanivārodbhavonaraḥ || 1 divākarādivārāṇāmadhi devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ śirasāpraṇamāmyadyaravivārādhipaṃ śivam śubhravarṇaḥ dhyāyāmidaityahaṃtriṃtāṃ raktāsvādanatatparām meghavarṇā aṃgārakādhināthaṃ ṣaṇmukhamīḍemareṃdrasenānyam raktavarṇaḥ karairanaṃtāsanasanniviṣṭaṃ dhyāyedrameśaṃbudhavāranātham nīlavarṇaḥ varābhayakaraḥśuddho guruvārādhipomataḥ padmavarṇaḥ karaiścaturbhirdadhataṃ śukrādhīśvaramāśraye pītavarṇaḥ yamaṃnīlatanuṃbhīmaṃ śanivārābhidhaṃbhaje nīlavarṇaḥ caṃdreśāditijīvāhipitaraścāryāmābhagaḥ yātudhānoṃbuviśve ca viṣṇuśca vasutoyapau ajaikapādahirbudhnyapūṣaṇaścetikīrtitāḥ

sudhāsaṃpūrṇakalaśakarābjāvaśvavāhanau yātrābhiṣekamakhadīkṣaṇacaulamauṃjīḥkurvaṃtiśāṃtikavidhānamathāśvinīṣu yamaṃnīlaṃbhajebhīmaṃsuvarṇapratimāgatam dyutābhicāravidhimaṃtrabilapraveśakanyājanāni yamabhe kilayāṃtisiddhim ekādaśāhātsukhībhavatī || - || asminnakṣatreprathamarajasvalāvidhavābhavati || - || asminnakṣatre ugrakāryāṇipraśastāni || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - capalaḥ | bahusutaḥ | śāstrajñaḥ | sumukhaḥ | sukhī | dīrghāyuḥ | satyavādī | subhojanaḥ | strīpriyaḥ | tīvranidraḥ | raktākṣaḥ | raktakeśaḥ | bhogaśarīravān | nābhipradeśetilamatsyāṃkitaḥ | ṣaḍaśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃsarvametadgraṃthedraṣṭavyam sruksruvābhītivaradhṛkcaturhastaṃ namāmyaham maṃtrauṣadhīrasarasāyanasādhakāni sidhyaṃtivahni vihitāni hutāśanarkṣe sitakeśaḥ | gaṃbhīraśarīraḥ | vāmabhāgematsyāṃkitaḥ | aśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃ sarvametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyam varābhayakaraḥ śuddhorohiṇīdevatāstume śālīkṣuvṛkṣavratabaṃdhanavāhanāninavyāṃbarābharāṇabhūṣaṇamabjajarkṣe rohiṇīśakaṭākāraṃ paṃca | ū vā vī vū rohiṇī | kṛṣṇavarṇam | paṃcatārāḥ | śakaṭākṛtiḥ | pumān | manuṣyagaṇaḥ | bhujaṃgayoniḥ | brahmādevatā | śūdrajātiḥ | catuṣpāt | ūrdhvamukham | aṃdhalocanam | sthiram | madhyatārā | pattanasthānam | iṃdramaṃḍalam | jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ | kukkuṭapakṣī | ukāra ṛkārāvakṣarau | asmin kṛṣṇabhīmau jātau | catvāriṃśadghaṭikābhyaḥ paraṃviṣanāḍyaścatasraḥ | ghṛtamiśraparamānnaṃbhuktvāpūrvottaraprayāṇe śubham | jvaresaptadinānyariṣṭāni || - || tacchāṃtyaibrahmadevatāpūjāvidhānam || kṛṣṇavastram | kastūrīgaṃdhaḥ || kahlārapuṣpam | gugguladhūpaḥ | kṣīrānnanaivedyam | namobrahmaṇe itimantreṇaṣoḍaśopacāraissaṃpūjyasarpirmiśrasaptadhānyairgāyatryā aṣṭottaraśataṃjuhuyāt | gaṃdhamālyaiḥ kṣīrodanaṃ prāgdiśibaliṃ haret || - || asminnakṣatreprathamarajasvalāpati priyāputravatī bhavati || - || asminnakṣatre ṛtusīmaṃtapuṃsavanacaulopanayanavedaśāstrābhyāsasamāvartanavivāha-tailābhyaṃgana vā bharaṇarājābhiṣekasiṃhāsanāṃ dolanārohaṇanavavāstu puragrāmasvīkaraṇapraveśagṛhapraveśadevatāpratisṭhākrayavikrayayajñādhyayana-homaśāṃtikapauṣṭikadhanadhānyataṭākādi śubhakāryāṇi praśastāti || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - karmajñaḥ | nṛttagītapriyaḥ | yuvatijanapriyaḥ | dhairyavān | parākramī | dīrghabuddhiḥ | janabhīṣaṇaḥ | dhanāḍhyaḥ | atibhogī | gaṃdhamālyapriyaḥ | maṃdagamanaḥ | kubjaḥ | svadāradveṣī | baṃdhuniṃdakaḥ | navativarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃ sarvametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyam

varābhayojjvalakaraṃratnasiṃhāsane sthitam || 1 || - || karituragādyadhirohaṇamuktaṃtadapiśubhāni hi pauṣṇaśubharkṣe devagaṇaḥ | strī | gajīyoniḥ | pūṣādevatā | catuṣpāt | tiryaṅmukham | aṃdhalocanam | mṛduḥ | bāhyam | samatārā | sthānaṃśūnyam | varuṇamaṃḍalam | madhūkavṛkṣaḥ | mayūrapakṣī | kṣakārākṣaraḥ | asminnabhimanyurjātaḥ | triṃśadghaṭhikābhyaḥ paraṃviṣanāḍyaścatasraḥ | piṣṭaṃbhuktvāpūrvottaraprayāṇeśubham | jvaremāsamariṣaṭam || - || tacchāṃtyaipūṣadevatāpūjāvidhānam || padmarāgavastram | raktacaṃdanagaṃdhaḥ | maṃdārapuṣpam | gugguladhūpaḥ | tilodananaivedyam | haṁsaśśuciṣaditimaṃtreṇaṣoḍaśopacāraissaṃpūjyatilodanājyairgāyatryā aṣṭottaraśataṃjuhuyāt | gaṃdhamālyaistilodanabaliṃharet | māsātsukhībhavati || - || asminnakṣatreprathamarajasvalāputravatībhavati || - || asminnakṣatrekratupuṃsavananāmakaraṇānnaprāśanacaulopanayanavedaśāstrā-bhyāsākṣaraprāraṃbhatailābhyaṃgavastrābharaṇasamāvartanarājābhiṣekarāja-darśanasiṃhāsanāṃdolikāgajāśvārohaṇaśāṃtikapauṣṭikamahotsavamaṃtrā-bhyāsabhaiṣajyanṛttagītavādyaprayogabījāvāpanayātrādiśubhakāryāṇi praśastāni || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - saubhāgyayutaḥ | tejasvī | sthūlakāyaḥ | saṃpūrṇāṃgaḥ | kopavān | bhogī | arthavyayakaraḥ | paṃḍitaḥ | dīrghajīvī | vicitraripugaṇaḥ | pittavān | annadātā | matsarī | krūrakāryaḥ | dhīraḥ | paradeśagaḥ | raktakeśaḥ | kiṃcittilamatsyāṃkitaḥ | caturaśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃ sarvametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyam || 1 saṃgrāmauṣadhavāditrakriyāḥ śastāśca vahnibhe || 1 || - || saṃtarpyabrāhmaṇāṃtsādhūṁllokānāpnotyanuttamān payonupānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye || 1 kṣauravāstu gajoṣṭrāśva yātrāḥ śastāśca caṃdrabhe || 1 || - || dattvā divyavimānasthaḥ svargaṃprāpnotyanuttamam saṃdhivigrahavaitāna rasādyāḥ śārvabhe śubhāḥ || 1 || - || narastaratidūrgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃśca parvatān || 1 kṣaurāstrakarmāditibhe vidheyaṃ dhānyabhuṣaṇam || 1 || - || yaśasvīrūpasaṃpanno bahvanne jāyate kule || 1 karagrahaṃvināsarva karmadevejyabhe śubham || 1 || - || anālokeṣulokeṣu somavatsavirājate || 1 vivādarasavāṇijyakarmabhaujaṃgabhe śubham || 1 || - || sasarvabhayanirmuktaḥ śāstravānabhijāyate || 1 vivāhanṛttagītādyāṃ nikhilaṃ karmapaitṛbhe || 1 || - || pradāyapaśumāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajāyate || 1 pūrvatrayekhilaṃkarma kartavyaṃ māṃsavikrayaḥ || 1 || - || bhakṣyāṃśca phāṇitairyuktāndattvā saubhāgyamaśnute || 1 praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - || uttarāviṣaye dattvā svargeloke mahīyate sadāphalamanaṃtaṃ ca bhavatīhaviniścayaḥ || 2 kṣauravāstvabhiṣekāśca bhūṣaṇaṃkarmabhānubhe || 1 || - || narastarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāśca parvatān || 1

tvāṣṭrabhevāstuvidyāssyuḥ kṣurabhūṣaṇakarmayat || 1 || - || caratyapsarasāṃ loke ramate naṃdane vane || 1 paśvaṃbvaśvebhakṛṣyādi kṣaurakarmasamīrabhe || 1 || - || prāpnoti lokāṃśca śubhāniha caiva mahadyaśaḥ || 1 sagrāsaṃgaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃyutam na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati nārakīyāṃśca saṃkleśānna prāpnotīti niścayaḥ || 3 vastrabhūṣaṇavāstvādya maitrabhe saṃdhivigraham || 1 || - || dattvāyugaśataṃvāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate || 1 iṃdrabhenṛttavāditraśilpalohāśma locanam || 1 || - || jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mṛtyumutsādya gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati || 1 nir-ṛtaunṛttaśilpāstra saṃdhi vigraha lekhanam svapitṝnprīṇaye deva gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati pūrvāṣāḍhāsu kartavyaṃ māṃsavikraya karma vai || 1 || - || kulavṛttopasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumāndhanavāṃstathā || 2 praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - || dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvalokānavāpnuyāt || 1 || - || dharmaniṣṭhomanīṣibhyaḥ svarge loke mahīyate || 1 (uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatracaturthapādaśravaṇabhasyādyaghaṭikācatuṣṭayayuktaḥ-kālo'bhijidyoga ityucyate) purārāmagṛhāraṃbhaṃviṣṇubhe paṭṭabaṃdhanam || 1 || - || śvetenayātvā yānena svargeloke mahīyate || 1 vasubhevāstusīmaṃta praveśāśvebhabhūṣaṇam || 1 || - || vastramasminnavaṃ dattvā pretyarājyaṃ prapadyate || 1 aśvābharaṇasīmaṃta vāstukarmajale śubhe || 1 || - ||

prāpnotyapsarasāṃlokaṃ dhattegaṃdhāṃśca śāśvatān || 1 pūrvātrayekhilaṃkāryaṃ māṃsavikrayaṇādikam || 1 || - || sarvabhakṣyaphalopetaṃ sarvaiḥ pretyasukhī bhavet || 1 praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - || pitṛnprīṇāti sakalānpretyacānaṃtyamaśnute || 1 praveśavastrasīmaṃta kṣaurabheṣajamaṃtyabhe || 1 || - || sapretyakāmānādāyadātāramupatiṣṭhate || 1 sthāpanāśvebhayānāstra kṛṣividyādayośvibhe || 1 || - || hastyaśvarathasaṃpanne varcasvāñjāyate kule || 1 bilapraveśagaṇitanikṣepāyāmyabhe śubhāḥ || 1 || - || gā prabhṛtā athāpnoti naraḥpretyayaśastathā || 1 kṛtidhṛtisamidhaḥ kṛtimanumanudiṅmanukṭijināḥkṛtiḥkakubhaḥ paratoghṭīcatuṣkaṃ viṣasaṃjñaṃ kṛttikādiṣu jñeyam || 2 vidyeṃdrābdhiyugābdhidigdhṛtijinairarkaiḥpurāṇairyutānāḍīstriṃśadatītyabheṣu-puratonāḍyaścatasro'mṛtam || 1 yoṣidvibhūṣātmajabhūritoṣaḥ syādaśvinībhejananaṃ prapannaḥ jalāttabhītiścapalaḥ khalassyātprāṇipraṇītobharaṇībhajātaḥ kaṭhoravāggarhitakarmakṛtsyāccetkṛttikājanmani yasya jaṃtoḥ vāgvilāsakalitākhilāśayorohiṇībhavati yasya janmabham bhoktānṛpasnehabhareṇapūrṇaḥ sanmārgavettā mṛgajātajanmā pasūtikāle ca bhavet kilārdrādayārdracetānabhavenmanuṣyaḥ dātāpratāpīvasudhāvasuśca punarvasū yasya bhavet prasūtau bhavenmanuṣyaḥ khalupaṣyajanmā sanmānanānādhanavāhanāḍhyaḥ sārpesadarpohivṛthārpitārthaḥ kaṃdarpasaṃtaptamanāmanuṣyaḥ cejjavmabhaṃ yasya maghānaghassyānmatissadārāti vighātadakṣā dhūrtaḥkrotyantasaṃjātagarvaḥ pūrvāphalgunyasti cejjanmakāle

dhīronarotyaṃtamṛdūttaraḥ syācceduttarāphalgunikāprasūtau prasutikāle yadi yasya hasto hastodgatā tasya samastasaṃpat prasutikāle yadi yasya citrābuddhirvicitrākhalu tasya śāstre svātīprasūtaumanujasya yasya bhavennṛpaḥ prāptavibhūti yuktaḥ yasya prasūtau ca bhavedviśākhāsakhānakasyāpi bhavenmanuṣyaḥ syātsaṃbhave yasya kilānurādhāsaṃpadvibādhāvividhā ca tasya śreṣṭhapratiṣṭhovadatāṃ variṣṭho jyeṣṭhodbhavasssyātpuruṣo viśeṣāt cedanyathā tatkurute viśeṣātsaubhāgyamātu(yu)ścakulābhivṛddhim tatrotpannaśiśormukham || aṣṭavarṣāṇinālokyaṃtā tena śubhamicchatā ratnaiśśatauṣadhīmūlaiḥ saptamṛdbhiḥ prapūrayet bālakāṃ'vāpitṛsnāne vipraissaṃpādite sati viruddhāvayave mūle vidhirevaṃ smṛto budhaiḥ caturthapādaśśubhado nitāṃtaṃ sārpe vilomaṃ parikalpanīyam cejjanmakāle kilatatramūlamunmūlanaṃ tatkurute kulasya paśūnāṃmitravargasya kramānmūlamaniṣṭadam gajāśca bhujayoryugme hastayorhṛdayeṣṭakam vinyasya puruṣākāre mūlasya phalamādiśet skaṃdhayordhūrvahatvaṃ ca bāhuyugmetva karmakṛt alpāyurnābhi deśe ca guhye ca sukhamadbhutam ghaṭīphalaṃ kilaproktaṃ mūlasya munipuṃgavaiḥ pitāmātāyamaḥ kālo viśvedevāmaheśvaraḥ gaṃdharvo yamadevaśca brahmāviṣṇuryamastathā ṣaṇmukhobhṛṃgirīṭiśca gaurīnāmnāsarasvatī viparītāḥ punarjñeyā āśleṣājātabālake trayoviṃśe ca navame kulakṣayakaraḥ śiśuḥ

mūlavṛkṣavibhāgeṣu maṃgalaṃ hi phale bhavet pādemūhūrte velāyāṃ vṛkṣe ca puruṣā kṛtau tātaṃvābhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃriṣṭa sātkurute dhruvam bhūmiratnānnahemādi deyaṃ vipreṣu bhaktitaḥ pratāpitārātijanomanuṣyo mūlekṛtīsyājjananaṃprapannaḥ nūnaṃsaṃpajjāyate tasya gāḍhāpūrvāṣāḍhājanmabhaṃ yasya puṃsaḥ kāṃtāsutāvāptasukhonitāṃtaṃ lokesuveṣaḥ puruṣomanīṣī dvijavarasurabhaktirvyaktavāṅmānavassyādabhijitiyadisūtirbhūpatiḥ sa svaṃvaṃśe prāṇīpurāṇaśravaṇapravīṇaścejjanmakāle śravaṇaṃ hi yasya yasya prasūtau ca bhaveddhaniṣṭhāmahānpratiṣṭhā sahito narassyāt vairiṇāmativiśeṣadāruṇo vāruṇo yadi ca yasya saṃbhave bhavenmanīṣāsutarāmapūrvāpurvāyadābhādrapadāprasūtau yasyottarābhādrapadā ca janyāṃ dhanyāṃ labhen māṃ ca bhavedvādānyaḥ mānavonanubhavenmahāmatīrevatī bhavati yasya janmabham || 1 atigaṃḍassukarmā ca dhṛtiśśūlastathaiva ca vajraṃsiddhirvyatīpātovarīyāt parivaśśivaḥ ete yogāḥ prakathitāssaptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 3 prāṅmukhaṃprāṃjalikaraṃtrikoṇoparisaṃsthitam kāṣṭhakarmaripūccāṭaṃviṣkaṃbhetu prakārayet || 1 || - || viṣkaṃbhesarvadhānyānāṃ dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanam prāṅmukhaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ japamālādharaṃ śubham rājavaśyaṃ mahotsāhaṃ prītiyoge ca kārayet || 1 || - || prītautathānnasvarṇānām prāṅmukhaṃpaṃcakoṇasthaṃ kauṃḍinyānvayasaṃbhavam vivādaṃpāṇipīḍāñca hyāyuṣmatyapi kārayet || 1 || - ||

(dānam) - āyuṣmatighṛtasya ca kauṃḍinyagotrajanitaṃ prāṅmukhaṃjapatāṃvaram yajñakarmasurāpānaṃ saubhāgyekārayedbudhaḥ || 1 || - || (dānam) - kuṃkumasya ca saubhāgye śobhanaṃśobhanakaraṃ namatāmāśraye sadā nṛpābhiṣekamārogyakarmakuryāccaśobhane || 1 || - || (dānam) - yavadānaṃcaśobhane atigaṃḍābhidhaṃvaṃde japaṃtaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sadā kṣudrakriyātigaṃḍekāryaṃ viṣaśastravahnikarmādyam || 2 || - || (dānam) - atigaṃḍecavastrāṇām kauṣikānvayasaṃbhūtaṃ japaṃtaṃ lokapūjitam rājābhiṣekakarmāṇisukarmaṇi ca kārayet || 1 || - || (dānam) - pāyasasyasukarmaṇi dakṣiṇāmukhamāsīno vedāmreḍanatatparaḥ vratabaṃdhaṃgajārohaṃ dhṛtiyoge tu kārayet || 1 || - || (dānam) - dhṛtaurajatadānaṃca dakṣiṇāmukha āsīnaḥkuṃḍinānvayasaṃbhavaḥ nivāraṇaṃkrūrakarmaśūlayogevidhīyate || 1 || - || (dānam) - śūlemūlādidānakam dakṣiṇāmukha āsīno brahmapāṭhaparāyaṇaḥ bāhuyuddhaṃbhṛtyakarmakṣātraṃgaṃḍe praśasyate || 1 || - || (dānam) - gaṃḍemaṃḍanadānaṃca yaściṃtayanparaṃbrahmabrasīmāśrityatiṣṭhati taṭākasetubaṃdhaṃ ca vṛddhiyoge tu kārayet || 1 || - || (dānam) - vṛddhaugodānamiṣyate

karebibhrannakṣamālāṃ gāyattrīmādarājjapan setubaṃdhanakarmāṇi kuryādyoge dhruvā hvaye || 1 || - || (dānam) - dhruvecapaṃcaratnānām pratyaṅmukhopavisṭaṃtaṃ pratyagraravisannibham sarvāṇikrūrakarmāṇibhedanoccāṭanāni ca || 1 || - || (phāṇitamityasyaguḍamiśrāpūpamityarthaḥ) paṭhaṃtaṃvedamaniśaṃ kāśyapānvayasaṃbhavam vaivāhikāstrasaṃgrahanṛpābhiṣekādyamakhilaśubhakarma || 1 || - || (dānam) - harṣaṇegaṃdhadānaṃsyāt pratyaṅmukha upāsīnaḥ paṭhanpraṇavamanvaham śastrasaṃgrahaṇādyaṃ ca vajrayoge praśasyate || 1 || - || (dānam) - vajredadyānmaṇīnapi viṣṭaroparisaṃviṣṭovedāṃtapaṭhanonmukhaḥ suvarṇamuktāphalabhūṣaṇādi karmāṇisidhyaṃti ca siddhiyoge || 1 || - || (dānam) - siddhausiddhārthakādeyāḥ pratyaṅmukhaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ vedāñchiṣyānaharniśam aṣṭanetraścaturvaktro vistīrṇaḥ śatayojanam ripubhedoviṣātyugraṃ kāryaṃ ca vyatipātake || 1 || - || (dānam) - vyatīpāte ca kāṃcanam pratyaṅmukhaḥ prāṃjalikassāvetasakulodbhavaḥ gajaturagādyadhirohaṇamakhilaṃ ca śubhaṃ varīyasi proktam || 1 || - || (dānam) - varīyasitilāndadyāt kailāsaśikharārūḍhosāmagāyanbhavenmayi krūraṃsamastaṃparighasyapūrvadalepikāryaṃ śubhamanyabhāge || 1 || - || (dānam) - śastrāṇiparighe tathā

viṣṇuvaṃśasamudbhūtaḥ ṛgadhyāpanatatparaḥ vivāhādyakhilaṃ yātrā śivayoge praśasyate || 1 || - || (dānam) - jalakuṃbhāśśivedeyāḥ udaṅmukhassvaśiṣyebhyo yajūṃṣisatataṃ paṭhan devapratiṣṭhādi śubhaṃ ca karmasiddhāhvaye sarvamuśaṃti yoge || 1 || - || (dānam) - siddhesidhānnamiṣyate udaṅmukhomahāmaṃtramātharvaṇamanusmaran sthiracarayātrādyakhilaṃ kāryaṃ sādhyāhvaye yoge || 1 || - || sādhyelaṃkaraṇānāṃ ca udaṅmukhojapanmaṃtraṃ śaivaṃpaṃcākṣaraṃ śubham dhanadhānyagṛhodyogaṃ kāryaṃyoge śubhā hvaye || 1 || - || (dānam) - chatradānaṃśubheśubham pratyagdṛṣṭissadābhūyātkauśikānvayasaṃbhavaḥ kanyādānaṃ mahotsāhaṃ śuklayoge ca kārayet || 1 || - || (dānam) - śuklecopānahordānam brahmaṇyāhitadṛṣṭissantapannastu sukhāyame kṛṣividyāsetubaṃdhaṃ yoge brahmā hvaye hitam || 1 || - || (dānam) - śastaṃbrahmaṇisarpiṣaḥ vādhūlānvaya jātāya varadāya sadānṛṇām kāvyanāṭakasaṃgītamaiṃdrayoge tu sidhyati || 1 || - || (dānam) - aiṃdre ca dīpakāndadyāt kauṃḍinyagotrajobrahmasaṃsmaranmanasānvaham dadhataṃḍamaruṃ śūlaṃkhaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam uccāṭanaṃvaṃcanaśṛṃkhalādikāryaṃ hitaṃvaidhṛtināmayoge || 1 || - || (dānam) - vaidhṛtaukanakaṃhitam || 1

svataṃtraḥ paśumānmaṃtrī viṣkaṃbhe jāyate naraḥ gurudevādibhaktaśca prītiyogodbhavonaraḥ āyuṣmadyogasaṃjātaḥ kīrtimānpaṃḍitassukhī saubhāgyayogasaṃjāto dhanīsyāt paradeśagaḥ sukopīśobhaneyoge jātobuddhipriyodṛḍhaḥ pareṃgitajñomānīsyādatigaṃḍodbhavonaraḥ puṇyakarmaratoyoge sukarmākhye tu jāyate dhṛtiyogodbhavodhīro bahuvittonnataśśaṭhaḥ badhirotitarāṃkāmī dhanīmānī dṛḍhaḥ prabhuḥ kunakhīśrutagobhoktā dhanīgaṃḍodbhavaḥ pumān bahuputrakalatrāḍhyastridoṣīvṛddhiyogajaḥ kṣamīcanirdhanomānīdhruvayogodbhavonaraḥ vyāghātayogasaṃjātaḥ putradārādhikoguṇī pareṃgitajñodhanavānharṣaṇe jāyate naraḥ ajayyaḥ vittavāñchrīmānvajrayogodbhavo naraḥ śrīmāndhīmānprajāvāṃśca siddhiyogodbhavonaraḥ vyatīpāte narojātastejasvīśītalaḥ priyaḥ pittātmāvittasaṃpanno varyānyogekalatravān vācācalaśca bhīruśca śrīmānparighayogajaḥ dhanavānparivārāḍhyaḥ śivayogodbhavonaraḥ tridoṣātmādhanībhoktā siddhayoge tu paṃḍitaḥ dhānyavānromaśākārassādhyayoge tu paṃḍitaḥ śubhayogebhaviṣyajjñaḥ śleṣmalodhanadhānyavān śuklayoge tu saṃjāto vātaśleṣmātmako naraḥ brahmayogodbhavaśśreṣṭhaḥ kāṃtaśca dhanadhānyavān

vātātmākṣiprakopī ca śrīmānmāheṃdrayogajaḥ satyavāndhanavāntyāgī vaidhṛtau vikaṭekṣaṇaḥ || 1 iṃdratoyāhivahnyarka bhūmarudbhagatoyapāḥ sāvitrīkamalāgaurī nāsatyaupitaroditiḥ viṣkaṃbhādikayogānāmadhi devavarā amī daṃḍapāśadharaṃvaṃde dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ vibhum nīlavarṇaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ vaṃde sarvārthasiddhaye (caturviṃśatimṛrttisthaviṣṇuvat 2 ni0) lakṣmīsahodaraṃvaṃde kṣīrasāgaranaṃdanam śvetavarṇaḥ || (navagrahacaṃdravat 5 nio) akṣasrakkuṃḍikāpāṇi dhyāye tvāṃpāhimāṃ prabho pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (bṛhaspatipratyadhidevatāvat 5ni0) jīvamāṃpāhi satatamanayā pūjayā prabho kanakavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthaguruvat 5 ni0) ūrdhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣamatigaṃḍeśvaraṃ bhaje nīlavarṇaḥ || (dikpālanir-ṛtivat 4 ni0) śacīnāthanamastubhyaṃ pāhimāṃ svarṇanāyaka kanakavarṇaḥ || (lokapāleṃdravat 4 ni0) prāṇadāḥ sarvalokasya pāṃtumāṃ viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥ śvetavarṇāḥ || (paṃcabhūtāsthābdevatāvat 4 ni0) namaskurmassadāśāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃ tu phaṇābhṛtaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ || (rāhvadhidevatāsarpavat 4 ni0) meghavāhanamārūḍhaṃ dhyāyet sarvārthasiddhaye lohitavarṇaḥ || (paṃcabhūtasthavahnivat 4 ni0)

padmāsanasthaṃ deveśaṃ vaṃde jyotirgaṇeśvaram siṃdūravarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthārkkavat 5 ni0) bhūmidevīmahaṃvaṃde mahiṣīṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ śvetavarṇā || (paṃcabhūtasthabhūmivat 4 nio) vyāghātanāthaṃ marutaṃ mṛgārūḍhamahaṃbhaje dhūmravarṇaḥ saṃpujayiṣye saṃtuṣṭassamebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu raktavarṇaḥ || (uttarānakṣatradevatāvat 5 ni0) nakravāhanamārūḍhaṃ pāśapātramapāṃpatim kanakavarṇaḥ ekadaṃtaṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ laṃbodaramaharniśam siṃdūravarṇaḥ triṇetraṃtripurārātiṃ taṃ vaṃde pārvatīpatim raktavarṇaḥ || (ekādaśarudravat ni0 3) dhanadhānyābhivṛddhyarthaṃ devaṃ vai śravaṇaṃ vibhum vṛtrāsuraprabhṛtayoyatsutāstaṃ sadāmudā pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (viśvakarmabrahmavat 4 ni0) vaṃde devagaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ samebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu raktavarṇaḥ || (anūrādhānakṣatradevatāvat 5 ni0) pārvatīnaṃdanaṃdevaṃ devasenādhipaṃ guham pāṭalavarṇaḥ || aṃgārakapratyadhidevatāvat ni0 5) saptakoṭimahāmaṃtra śreṣṭhāṃvaṃde surārcitām śvetavarṇā || (mādhyāhnikasāvitrīvat ni0 5 ) vaṃderamāṃpadmamukhīṃ viṣṇuvakṣasthalālayām kanakavarṇā || (viṣṇupatnīlakṣmīvat ni0 2)

girirājasutāṃgaurīṃ padamābhayakarānvitām marakatavarṇā vaṃdetau devabhiṣajaupustu(sta)kauṣadhipāṇikau śvetavarṇau pitṝnpiṃḍābhayakarānputrāyuśśrīpradānnṛṇām dhūmravarṇāḥ ddibhujāṃpadmahastāṃtāmāyurārogyavṛddhaye raktavarṇā || 1 atha ca catuṣpānnāgavakiṃstughnākhyānikaraṇāni tapasvisaṃghasaṃsevyaṃ karaṇaṃpraṇamāmyaham dhātuvādavaṇigyānakarmasarvaṃbavehitam (dānam) - bavepāyasadānaṃsyāt netratrayojjvalamukhaṃ namāmi balavṛddhidam nṛpābhiṣekasaṃgrāma kramasidhyati bālave (dānam) - śayyādānaṃcabālave namāmimokṣadātāraṃ vedāṃtapratipāditam bālavoktākhilaṃkarma kaulave sidhyati dhruvam (dānam) - kaulavegorasāndadyāt sarvagīrvāṇajaṃ vande putrapautrābhi vṛddhaye taṭākakūpakhananaṃ kāryaṃtaitulasaṃjñake (dānam) - tilāṃstaitulanāmani vāmāṃganityasaṃviṣṭahimādritanayojjvalam vāstukarmapraveśaṃ ca garaje tu vidhīyate (dānam) - garābhidhānelavaṇam pramadāvrataparyaṃkaṃ śūlojjvalakarāṃbujam

uktānuktākhilaṃkarma vaṇijesidhyati dhruvam (dānam) - vaṇijedeyamaṃbaram rudrākṣamālikodbhāsikaṃ dharaḥśubhavardhanaḥ analaśatasahasraṃcodgiraṃtīsamaṃtātpatatibhuvanamadhyekāryanāśāyaviṣṭiḥ bhujaṃgamo mukhebhīmo na tu pucchedvidhocyate turaṃgamahiṣokṣādi karmaviṣṭyāṃ tu sidhyati śubhakarmāṇisarvāṇi bhadrāyāṃ samudīrayet nābhau catasraḥ kaṭyāṃ ṣaṭpucchetisraśca nāḍikāḥ || 1 || - || kaṭyāṃbuddhipradānābhau cyutiḥpucche dhruvojayā kramāgatā tu yā viṣṭiḥ saivahālāhalopamā || 2 || - || (dānam) - viṣṭaucaṣaṣṭikānnāni ārogyadaṃpraṇamatāṃ jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitam devatāpūjanaṃ caiva śakunau tu praśasyate (dānam) - śakunausarpirevaca amarastutyapādābjayugalāyanamonayaḥ tarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca catuṣpadi vidhīyate (dānam) - madhudānaṃcatuṣpadri dhyāyetsamastasiddhyarthamuttuṃgavṛṣavāhanam vedhastu vaṃcanaṃ krūraṃ nāgavecātraśasyate (dānam) - dānaṃnāgecavāsasām bhasmoddhūlita dehāya vedāṃta kṛtaśarmaṇe śobhanaṃśubhakarmāṇi kiṃstughne tu praśasyate || 1 || - || (dānam) - dānaṃpriyaṃgoḥkiṃstughne || 1 vakrāṃgo nṛpapūjyaśca bavajātodhanādhipaḥ gobhūmivittabhṛtyāḍhyo nīcakṛtyo mahodyamaḥ

mātāpitrorvidheyaśca daiṣṭikaḥ kaulavodbhavaḥ taitulekaraṇejāto mṛduvākpāṭhakaḥ sukhī garajekaraṇejāto jitaśatrurjanapriyaḥ guptakṛtyoti muṃḍaśca vaṇije karaṇe nṛpaḥ svataṃtraḥ karaṇe viṣṭyāṃ jātolubdhastu caṃcalaḥ śakunau paritoṣī ca gobhūmiparivārakaḥ nānāciṃtā kulorogī kāṃtaḥsyāccacatuṣpadi vikaṭāṃgo guṇīmānī nāge jātolpabhugbhavet kiṃstughne karaṇe jāto bhogītyāgī naraḥ sukhī || 1 mitrākhyaḥ pitarobhūmiḥ śrīrviṣṇuśca yamastathā māṇibhadrodaṃdaśūkovāyurekādaśasmṛtāḥ vajrāṃkuśābhītikaraṃ naumīṃdrāṇī manoharam kanakavarṇaḥ || (lokapāleṃdravat ni0 4 ) akṣasruksruvakuṃḍāḍhyaṃ vaṃdemāṃpātusonvaham pāṭalavarṇaḥ gadāvaradahastaṃ ca vaṃdehaṃ divaseśvaram raktavarṇaḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ pitaromahyaṃ bhaveyurvāñchitārthadāḥ nīlavarṇaḥ || (maghānakṣatradevatāvat ni0 5) namasyāmi sadāsāmāṃ rakṣatācchūbhakārikā śvetavarṇā || (paṃcabhūtasthabhūmivat ni0 4) śaṃkhacakravarābhīti pāṇiṃseṣṭaṃprayacchatu kanakavarṇā daṃḍapāśadharaṃvaṃde dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ vibhum nīlavarṇaḥ

śaṃkhacakragadāśārṅga dhāriṇaṃ naumisarvadā nīlameghavarṇaḥ yakṣeśvarasya sainyeśaṃsamebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu nīlavarṇaḥ vaṃdetānāyurārogyaputrapautrābhi vṛddhaye śubhravarṇaḥ || (aṣṭanāgasthaśeṣavat ni0 4) khaḍgacarmadharānvaṃde vāñchitārthāndiśaṃ tu me dhūmravarṇaḥ || 1 kapālapāśāṃkuśalāṃgalāḍhyahastaṃ sadālokabhayaṃkaraṃ ca bhūṣaṇairāyasaireva bhūṣitāṃbhīmarūpiṇīm saṃyuktāmaṣṭabhirhastaiḥ khaḍgaśūlagadāmiṣām dhārayaṃtīṃ mahākāyāṃ mūrtiṃ kṛttvā vibhīṣaṇām evaṃvidhasvarūpaṃ vai kṛtvā pātre nyaset tataḥ (dvitīyaghaṭikādevatāyamaḥ) || (tṛtīyaghaṭikādevatā agniḥ) || (turīyaghaṭikādevatāmṛtyuḥ) pāśakhaḍgāṃkuśagadāpāṇirmṛtyuḥsadāvatu nīlavarṇaḥ divijajanasusevyaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ mahaujastadamṛtaśubhadaivaṃ sarvadābhāvayāmi śuklavarṇam paṃcāsyaḥpṛthudaṃṣṭrobhallakaraḥkharavahogulikaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ sarvāriṣṭakaroraudro bhūyobhūyostu me hṛdi kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śubhamāṃjiṣṭhavasano nīlavarṇavibhūṣitaḥ pātraṃprathamahaste tu dvitīye loṣṭha bhedanam paṃcame śṛṃkhalāṃhaste ṣaṣṭhe kavacameva ca

navame caiva kuddālaṃ śrṛṃgikāmādimottare caturthekārmukaṃ pāṇau paṃcamekartrikāmapi aṣṭame ca dhvajaṃ haste navamakukkuṭaṃśaye nīlavarṇaḥ śastrānvitobhuvipatanvinirīkṣyamāṇaḥ kāryāṃtakānvitanutevyatipātayogaḥ raktavarṇaḥ vaiprapātamidaṃrūpaṃ sadyomaraṇakāraṇam nīlavarṇaḥ janmarkṣaṃkrūrarūpaṃ karadhṛtakalaśaṃ prasphurallolajihvaṃ dīptākṣaṃtāmravarṇaṃ jvaladurudaśanodagradaṃṣṭrākarālam yuktaṃbhaumārkabhedairasakṛdapivarābhītimālāvahaṃtaṃ pūjāmaṃtraistu dānairdvijavaravacanaiḥ prītidaṃ bhāvayāmi raktavarṇaḥ bhānumaddaivataḥ prokto dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ anuvatsarakaścaiva prājāpatyaḥ samīritaḥ yugaṃ taiḥ paṃcabhirvaṛṣaiḥ ṣaṣṭi dvādaśabhiryugaiḥ || 3 ahirbudhnyaśca pitaro viśvedevā niśākaraḥ puruhūtānalaudasraubhagaścaite kramātsmṛtāḥ saṃvatsaraparivatsaramiticedāvatsaraścaiva anuvatsaraśca tasmātparataścedvatsaroṃnteyaḥ sauraṃ ca sāyanaṃ cāṃdramārkṣaṃ mānāni vai nava || 1 tatomakarasaṃkrāṃte ravessyāduttarāyaṇam || 1 surāsurāṇāmanyonya mahorātraṃ viparyayāt || 1 triṃśatātithibhirmāsaścāṃdraḥpitryamahaḥ smṛtam || 1 manvaṃtaravyavasthācaprājāpatyamudāhṛtam prakārāṃtareṇa kārtikādīnivarṣāṇiguruyuktodayāstataḥ || 1 saurastusaṃkrāṃtivaśāddinasya

nākṣatramiṃdorbhagaṇabhramācca triṃśaddinaṃsāvanamāsaḥ ādyadinādamāṃtaṃkhalucāṃdramāhuḥ || 1 tattanmāsairdvādaśabhistattadabdo bhaveddhruvam ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāṃteḥ puṇyakālatā vratopavāsayātrādi kriyācāṃdreṇa gṛhyate sāvanānisyuretāni yajñakālavidhistutaiḥ sūtakādiparicchedo dinamāsābdapāstathā raktākṣaṃ kuṃcitapadaṃ meṣaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye raktavarṇaḥ kakudvirājamānāṃsaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hṛdibhāvaya śvetavarṇaḥ anyonyā śliṣṭahastābjaṃ mithunaṃ hṛdibhāvaye kukṣivinyastavadanaṃ dhyāyāmihṛdikarkaṭam pāṭalavarṇaḥ dīrghalāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye dhūmrapāṃḍaravarṇaḥ pūrṇacaṃdramukhīṃkāṃtāṃ kanyāṃ hṛdivibhāvaye citravarṇā tuletināmnavikhyatāṃ saṃkhyārūpāmupāsmahe kṛṣṇavarṇā ātolyamānapucchāgraṃ vṛścikaṃ hṛdibhāvaye kanakavarṇaḥ āropitograbāṇāgraṃ dhanurhṛdivibhāvaye piṃgalavarṇam

jalajaṃ tu pratibhayaṃ makaraṃ hṛdibhāvaye karburavarṇaḥ vainateyajavānītaṃ kuṃbhaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye dhūmravarṇaḥ mamābhīṣṭasyasiddhyarthaṃ mīnaṃhṛdivibhāvaye śvetavarṇaḥ || 1 dāruṇaṃsāhasorājñāṃ meṣalagne praśasyate kṣetrāraṃbhaṇamakhilaṃ bhūṣaṇaśilpādikaṃ vṛṣabhe adhikaṃ māhiṣameṣakṣitipatisevādikaṃ mithune pauṣṭikaṃkarmayatkiṃcit sarvaṃsidhyatikarkiṇi dhātvākarādimeṣoktaṃ kuryāt siṃhodaye sadā udvāhaśāṃtipauṣṭikagajaturagoṣṭrādikanyāyām prasidhyaṃti ca sarvāṇi tulābhāṃḍāśritāni ca cauryakṛtyaṃ sthirāraṃbhaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛścikodaye vastrāstrakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ kartavyaṃ kārmukodaye nārīcatuṣpādādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syān mṛgodaye sthirabhūṣaṇavāstvādyaṃ kartavyaṃ ca ghaṭodaye rathaturagoṣṭrapaśūnāṃkāryaṃ mīnodayeśreṣṭham || 1 taulīsasasya dahanāplavagā ca kanyāśeṣāssvanāmasadṛśāḥ khacarāśca sarve || 1 raudraḥparaśuṃsamudyataṃ dhatteraktavilocanaḥ pumān puruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ caraikapādena ca meṣamadhyadrekkāṇarūpaṃ yavanopadiṣṭam strī | raktavarṇā raktānivastrāṇibibharti caṃḍomeṣetṛtīyaḥ kathitastribhāgaḥ pumān | kapilavarṇaḥ || 3

ābharaṇānyabhivāṃchatigaurīrūpamidaṃ prathamaṃ vṛṣabhasya strī | gauravavarṇā skaṃdhamudvahati gopatitulyaṃkṣutparo'javadano malavāsāḥ puruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥ avimṛgalomāvyākulacitto vṛṣabhavarasya prāṃtagatoyaḥ puruṣaḥ | kanakavarṇaḥ || 3 hīnātmajā ṛtumatīmṛdudīrghabāhurādyaṃ tṛtīyabhavanasya vadaṃtitajjñāḥ strī || haridvarṇā krīḍātmajālaṃkaraṇāttacittaṃkaroti madhyemithunasyacāyam puruṣaḥ | haridvarṇaḥ nṛttavādanakalāsucavidvānkāvyakṛnmithunarāśyavasāne puruṣaḥ | haridvarṇaḥ kroḍatulyavadanohayakarṇaḥkarkaṭeprathamarūpamuśaṃti puruṣaḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥ śākhāṃpalāśasyasamāśritā ca madhyasthitā karkaṭakākhyarāśeḥ strī || pāṭalavarṇā haimaiśca yutovibhūṣaṇaiścipiṭāsyoṃtya gataśca karkaṭe puruṣaḥ | pātalavarṇaḥ || 3 rautimātṛpitṛviprayogatassiṃharūpamidamādyamucyate puruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥ durāsadassiṃha ivāttakārmukonatāgranāsomṛgarājamadhyaḥ puruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥ kūrcimanuṣyaḥ kuṭilaiścakeśairmṛgeśvarasyāṃtyagatatribhāgaḥ puruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥ || 3 vastrārthasaṃyogamabhīpsamānāguroḥ kulaṃgacchatikanyakādyā

strī | citravarṇā vipulaṃ ca bibhartikārmukaṃ romavyāptatanuśca madhyamaḥ puruṣaḥ | śyāmavarṇaḥ devālayaṃ strīprayatāpravṛttāvadaṃti kanyāṃtyagata tribhāgam kanakavarṇaḥ || 3 bhāṃḍaṃviciṃtayati tasya ca mūlyametadrūpaṃ vadaṃti yavanāḥ prathamaṃ tulāyāḥ puruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kṣudhitastuṣitaśca kalatrasutānmanasaiti tulādharamadhyagataḥ puruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ dhanurdharovānararūpabhṛnnarastulāvasāne yavanairudāhṛtah puruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ || 3 sthānacyutāsarpanibaddhapādāmanoramā vṛścikarāśipūrvā strī | svarṇavarṇā kacchapakuṃbhasamānaśarīrāvṛścikamadhyamarūpamuśaṃti strī | svarṇavarṇā avati ca malayākarapradeśaṃ mṛgapatiraṃtyagataśca vṛścikasya puruṣaḥ | svarṇavarṇaḥ kratūpayuktānitapasvinaścara rakṣapūrvodhanuṣastribhāgaḥ puruṣaḥ | piṃgalavarṇaḥ samudraratnānivighaṭṭayaṃtīmadhyastribhāgodhanuṣaḥpradiṣṭaḥ strī | kanakavarṇaḥ kauśeyakānyudvahate'jinaṃ ca tṛtīyarūpaṃ dhanuṣaśca rāśeḥ puruṣaḥ | kanakavarṇaḥ || 3 yotrakajālakabaṃdhanadhārīraudramukhomakaraprathamaśca puruṣaḥ | karburavarṇaḥ

vibhūṣaṇālaṃkṛtalohakarṇāyoṣāpradiṣṭāmakarasyamadhye strī | śyāmavarṇā kuṃbhamudvahatiratnacitritaṃskaṃdhagaṃ makararāśipaścimaḥ puruṣaḥ || karburavarṇaḥ || 3 kośakāravasano'jināvṛtogṛdhratulyavadanoghaṭādikaḥ puruṣaḥ | babhruvarṇaḥ malinenapaṭenasaṃvṛtābhāṃḍairmūrdhagataissamadhyamaḥ strī | babhruvarṇā bhāṃḍānilohavyatimiśritānisaṃcārayatyaṃtya gatoghaṭasya puruṣaḥ | śyāmavarṇaḥ || 3 bhāryāvibhūṣārthamapāṃnidhānenāvaṃplavatyādigatojhaṣasya puruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥ varṇenacaṃpakanibhā pramadātribhāgo mīnasya caiva kathito munibhirdvitīyaḥ strī | kanakavarṇā corānalavyākulitāṃtarātmāvikrośate cāṃtyagatojhaṣasya puruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥ || 3 ākaṃṭhapādāṃtakacodvibhujo dīrghagodhikaḥ bhrūmaṃḍalālakopetaḥ kṛṣṇaśubhrāṃśukānvitaḥ iṣṭāpūrtasya sidhyarthaṃ pūjanīyo manīṣibhiḥ kanakavarṇaḥ śvetavastradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam padmavaktraṃ śuklavarṇaṃ divārūpaṃ vibhāvayet (divādhidevatāsūryaḥ prasidhaḥ navagrahasthasūryavat ni0 5 ) rājābhiṣekamannādyaṃ vidyāraṃbhopanāyanam pāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇa dharāṃcaṃdranibhānanām

(taddevatācaṃdraḥ prasiddhaḥ navagrahasthacaṃdravat ni0 5) garbhāntarādhānabaligrahārcāḥ kuṃbhapratiṣṭhā hyabhicārakarma rākṣasī cārdharātre syādbrāhmīmadhyāhna ucyate || 1 āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrāṃ svādhyāyaṃ caiva nityaśaḥ nidrātojāyate'lakṣmīḥ svādhyāyādāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ śvetāruṇābhāṃ yuvatiṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitām pāṭalavarṇā kuṃkumāruṇavarṇābhāmunnasāṃcitrabhūṣaṇām siṃdūravarṇā pāśahastāliromāṇaṃ namāmiśirasāvibhum kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śūlaṃcaḍamṛgaṃpāṇau bibhrāṇaṃ hṛdibhāvaye raktavarṇaḥ gīrvāṇagaṇavaṃdyāṃghriṃ mṛtyuṃ mahiṣavāhanam nīlavarṇaḥ jvalatpāvakakeśāṃtāṃ nīlameghasamaprabhām daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ mahiṣoparisaṃsthitām kheṭakā'gnyabhayāhīṃdrāndakṣavāmakrameṇa hi kuhūṃkuhūviṣodbhūtarūpiṇīṃ praṇamāmyaham nīlavarṇā jihvayāraktayādīptaṃ lelihānānijaṃmukham narāsthimālāṃbibhrāṇāmekhalīkṛtapannagām daṃḍaṃghaṃṭāṃ tathāśurpaṃ mārjanīṃ pāśakuṃḍike adhirūḍhāṃ naraskaṃdhamaṃdhakārasamākṛtim evaṃ rūpadharāṃ kṛtyāṃ namāmi ripunāśinīm

kṛṣṇavarṇā dakṣiṇādhaḥ karekhaḍgaṃ dakṣordhve paraśuṃ tathā bibhrāṇāṃ ca mahākṛtyāmarcayecchatrunāśinīm kṛṣṇavarṇā varābhayāmṛtakalāmudrā amṛtakuṃḍikām śvetavarṇā varadābhayapāṇiṃ ca sinīvālīmahaṃbhaje kṛṣṇavarṇā lokābhīṣṭapradaṃdhyāye sarvāriṣṭanivṛttaye kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ vāmahaste tu phaṇinaṃ dakṣiṇe phaṇimudrikam śyāmavarṇaḥ śvetavastro mahātuṃgo dakṣiṇe sarpamādadhat śyāmavarṇaḥ śvetaśoṇābhavastroyaṃ śvetamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥ dadhānobhūtayepūjyo yogavṛddhyai sukhāya ca śubhravarṇaḥ dakṣiṇepaṃkajaṃnīlaṃ vāme sarpaṃ mahāphaṇam nīlameghavarṇaḥ dakṣiṇe pustakaṃ haste vāme caiva triśūlakam nīlameghavarṇaḥ śvetavastromecakābho mahāsattvasamanvitaḥ dadhadrogavināśāya pūjanīyo hyaharniśam kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ dakṣiṇe tu karedaṃḍaṃ vāme caivā bhayaṃkare

śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1 dakṣiṇe vallakīṃ pāṇau vāme śaktiṃ ca kārayet raktavarṇaḥ || 1 pītavarṇoti hrasvastu tāmravastro mahodaraḥ sa evakutupo - nāmavijñātavyomanīṣibhiḥ pītavarṇaḥ śubhravarṇoviśālākṣo nīlavaddhemakuṃḍalaḥ dadhānaśśubhasaṃpattyai vijayārogyasiddhaye śubhravarṇaḥ gauravarṇoruṇaśśveta vasanaśśveta kuṃḍalaḥ gauravarṇaḥ hemavarṇo bṛhatphālaḥ kṛṣṇaśvetāruṇāṃśukaḥ dadhatprajñāsukhāptyarthaṃ pūjanīyovipaścitām hemavarṇaḥ nīlavarṇojaṭāmauliḥ pītavastro mahābalaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ raktavastro mahorasko ratnahemasukuṃḍalaḥ raktavarṇaḥ muktāphalanibhaścaiva muktāhāravibhūṣitaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ nīlaśvetāruṇaprāṃtavasanonīlakuṃḍalaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ hṛdayasthaḥ sadābhūyādbhargobhayavināśanaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ || (ekādaśarudrasthabhargavat ni0 3) vīṇāvādanatattvajño pakṣavānaruṇaḥ smṛtah

aruṇavarṇaḥ nidhīśvaraḥ svarṇavarṇodhanadorūpavānprabhuḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ || (dikpālakuberavat ni0 4) pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādārabhya nityaśaḥ dhautavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtisthaviṣṇuvat ni0 2) hemadaṃḍadharaḥśyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ || (dikpālavāyuvat || ni0 4) chāgasthaḥ sākṣasūtraśca saptārciḥ śakti dhārakaḥ raktavarṇaḥ || (sūryādhidevatāvat ni0 5) ūrdhvakeśovirūpākṣaḥ karālaḥkālikā priyaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ || (lokapālanir-ṛtivat ni0 4) saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujaḥ syātsadāraviḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthasūryavat ni0 5) khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ varābhayakaraśśuddho brahmājñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (rohiṇīnakṣatradevatāvat ni0 5) daṃḍinauvaradaukāryo sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalū svarṇavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthaguruvat ni0 5) sahasrakarasaṃvītassamastāśāṃtarāṃtaraḥ pāṭalavarṇaḥ || (dvādaśādityasthapūṣavat ni0 5) pītavāsāmaṇimayairbhūṣaṇairuttamairvṛtaḥ meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtisthanārāyaṇavat ni0 2) hemadaṃḍadharaḥśyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ || (dikpālavāyuvat ni0 4) ūrdhvakeśovirūpākṣaḥ karālaḥkālikā priyaḥ

nīlavarṇaḥ || (lokapālanir-ṛtivat ni0 4) ugrādyāstamasā yuktāḥ svānurūpaphalapradāḥ tāsāṃnāmānirūpāṇi śṛṇupārvati tattvataḥ || 2 śāṃtiḥkṣamājayāprajñānujñāsaumyā'bhayāvarā śuddhasphaṭikavarṇāśca jñānamudrā'bhayānvitāḥ śvetavarṇāḥ piṃgalābhadrakādhanyā samṛddhirharṣaṇā dhṛtiḥ ratiḥpuṣṭiśca tuṣṭiśca yoginyo rajasā yutāḥ raktavarṇāḥ ugrājyeṣṭhā tato raudrī śeṣaraudrī tataḥ param balapūrvāvikarṇī ca balapramathinī tathā īrṣyādaṃbhāhaṃ kṛtiśca bhrāmarī saṃkaṭā tathā etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śruṇupārvati tattvataḥ || 4 || 20 kapālābhayahastogrā vāmāvāmaphalapradā raktavarṇā pāṭalavarṇā raktavarṇā raktavarṇā dehe || mukhekṛṣṇavarṇā kapālakartrikāhastā jñeyābhayanāśinī meghaśyāmavarṇā dehe || mukheraktavarṇā nīlavarṇā śvetavarṇā bibhrāṇāśāṃtidā bhūtyai balapūrvāvikarṇikā citravarṇā kapālapāśinī seyaṃ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarī

raktavarṇā dehe || mukheśvetavarṇā kapālavajriṇīproktā sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarī raktavarṇā kapālakhaḍginībhutyai śatrūṇāṃbhayavardhinī dehe nīlavarṇā || mukheraktavarṇā kṛpāṇapālikāyukta karālokabhayaṃkarī śyāmavarṇā kṛśodarīkare pātraṃ khaḍgaṃ dhatte vibhīṣaṇā raktavarṇā khaḍgaṃkheṭaṃdadhānā ca dīrghāṃgā kuṃcitānanā dehe nīlavarṇā || mukheraktavarṇā tuṃdilātuṃganāsā ca kapālamusalāṃcitā dehe nīlavarṇā || mukheśvetavarṇā kṛpāṇaṃkuṃḍikāṃdhatte baddhapadmāsane sthitā citravarṇā pāṭalābhonnatanasā-ṛjukāyā mahodarī pāṭalavarṇā ghaṃṭādaṃḍakarākrūrā karālāsyā jaṭāvilā nīlavarṇā kṛṣṇaśvetacchaviśśyāmā khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī kṛṣṇaśvetavarṇā ulmukaṃ ca karedaṃḍaṃ dadhānā lokabhīṣaṇā raktavarṇā || kaṃṭhenīlavarṇā vyomavaṃdyaikarudrākṣakacalaṃbitamālikā pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa jñānavijñāna hetave

śvetavarṇā aṣṭādaśabhujopetā jñānamudrā samanvitā nīlavarṇā akṣasūtraṃ kare dakṣe jñānamudrāṃ tathottare kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ jaṭātrimaulikopetaścaṃdanāliptavigrahaḥ śubhravarṇaḥ anyatrāṣṭasthalānyāhurbhārateṣṭauśataṃtathā (pradyumnaṃ) ca pramodākhye saṃmode (cāniruddhakam) kṣīrābdhau (śeṣaśayanaṃ) śvetadvīpe tu (tārakam) eteṣvaṣṭasthaleṣvevaṃ rūpaṃmāṃ viddhisusthitam (pāṃḍye 18)'ṣṭādaśa (kerale 13) bhagavataḥṣaṭsaptakaṃ (cottare 12 ) deśādvādaśapūrvasūribhiralaṃvyāsādibhiḥsannutāḥ || 1 (nārāyaṇaṃ) badaryā'khye naimiśe (hari) mavyayam madhurāyāṃ (bālakṛṣṇaṃ) māyāyāṃ (madhusūdanam) aṣṭādaśasthitānkāṃcyāṃvakṣyevāraṇaparvate (yathoktakāriṇaṃ) grāme (paramaṃ) parameśake grāmagrahābhidhe sākṣādunnattyā'ḍhyaṃ (trivikramam) (gajeṃdravarada)ñcāṣṭabhujañcāṣṭabhujasthale sthalemeghaniketākhye (meghākārasamāhvayam) vrajasthāne ca (varadaṃ) kāmakoṭyāṃ (svayaṃharim) (pravālavarṇadevaṃ) tu pravālavanasaṃjñite śarvasthāne (mahāviṣṇu)metānaṣṭādaśaśraye bṛṃdāvane (naṃdasūnuṃ) (goviṃdaṃ) (kāliyahrade) gomaṃtaparvate (śauriṃ) haridvāre (jagatpatim) gaṃgāsāgarike (viṣṇuṃ) citrakūṭe tu (rāghavam)

śrīkūrme (kūrmarūpaṃ) canīlādrau (puruṣottamam) kṛtakośe (pāpaharaṃ) śvetādrau (siṃharūpiṇam) ahobale (hiraṇyaghnaṃ) pāṃḍuraṃge tu (viṭhṭhalam) (nārāyaṇaṃ) yādavādrauvyaṅkaṭādrau (ramāsakham) śrīmadgṛdhrasarastīrebhāṃtaṃ (vijayarāghavam) gajasthale (garjātighnaṃ) bhaktasāre (jagatpatim) (mahābalaṃ) balipuregopapuryāṃ tu (gopatim) (mahāvarāhaṃ) śrīmuṣṭe śrīrāme (jānakīpriyam) śrīraṃge (raṃganāthaṃ) tamākāśanagare (harim) śrīnivāsasthale (pūrṇaṃ) maṇikūṭe (mahāprabhum) utpalāvarttake (śaurīṃ) maṇipūryāṃ (surapriyam) śvetahrde (śāṃtamūrti) cakratīrthe (sudarśanam) kuṃbhako (gho)ṇe (śārṅgapāṇiṃ) bhūtisthāne tu (śārṅgiṇam) khaṃḍane (haraśāpaghna) (muttamā) khyamanuttame naṃdapuryāṃ (mahānaṃdaṃ) kṛṣṇakoṭyāṃ (madhudviṣam) sārakṣetre (sāranāthaṃ) śaraṇye (śaraṇābhidham) (jagadīśaṃ) dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ madhurāyāṃ tu (suṃdaram) goṣṭhī pure (goṣṭhapatiṃ) (balāḍhyaṃ) bhramarasthale sthale tu darbhaśayane vasaṃtaṃ (darbhaśāyinam) anaṃtaśayane devaṃ (padmanābhaṃ) manoharam yassmaret satataṃbhaktayācetasānanyagāminā aṣṭottaraśataṃviṣṇossthānāni paṭhatāsvayam avagāḍhānitirthānijñātaḥ sabhagavānhariḥ saṃpāditā tathāmuktiḥ paramānaṃda dāyinī || 108 śrīmuṣṭeveṃkaṭādrau ca sāligrāme ca naimiśe (ṣe) aṣṭaumemūrtayassaṃti svayaṃvyaktā mahītale

śrīhastiśailaśikharojjvalapārijātaṃ śrīśaṃ namāmi śirasāyaduśailadīpam śayyābhujaṃgātmatayāpratītaṃ (śrīsaumyajāmātṛmuniṃ) prapadye bhaktāṃghrireṇumunivāhacatuṣkavīṃdrānmādhuryakāvyatulasī- prabhavānyatīṃdrān śrīpāṃcajanyojani (divyayogī) sarobhidhānaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye (bhūtābhidhanaṃ) munimutpalāṃtācchrīmadgadāṃśaṃśaraṇaṃprapadye bhaktyāmahāṃśaṃ (mahadāhvayaṃ)taṃ śrīnaṃdakāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye sudarśanāṃśaṃyamudārakīrtiṃtaṃ (bhaktisāraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye saudarśanīṃmūrtimupāgataṃcataṃ (bhaktisāraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye senāpateḥpadajakārigṛhevatīrṇaṃ śrīśāspadaṃ (śaṭharipuṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye śrīkaustubhāṃśaṃ (kulaśekharākhyaṃ) sārakṣitīśaṃśaraṇaṃ prapadye garutmadaṃśaṃśvaśuraṃmurāreḥ (śrīviṣṇucittaṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye raṃgeśakelisukhamūrdhvaśikhaṃdvijeṃdraṃ (bhaktāṃghrireṇu) managhātmaguṇaṃ prapadye śrīvatsāṃśakaphaṇiśāyibhaktibhājaṃpāṇākhyaṃ (varamunivāhanaṃ) prapadye raṃgeśakaiṃkairyataraṃgitāṃśaṃ (catuṣkavīṃdraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye gaṇāṃśabhājaṃ (madhuraṃkavīṃdraṃ) śaṭhāriśiṣyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye udetāmudāraguṇaraṃganāyakaprivavallabhāṃ (vasumatī) mupāsmahe śrīśodaṃcaddarśanasthāpanārthaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ (bhāṣyakāraṃ) prapadye guptaṃratnaṃ lokarakṣā nimittaṃyodātprītyāta(nmahāpūrṇe)mīḍe prajñāviśeṣanilayaṃprativāditūlajhaṃjhānilaṃ hṛdayaciṃtaya(yāmunārya)m taṃ (rāmamiśraṃ) kumudākṣaśaktiṃ padmākṣaśiṣyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye hṛṣṭaṃjayatsena vipaścidaṃśaṃ (śrīpuṃḍarīkākṣa)mahaṃprapadye dīptodayaṃ divyagajānanāṃśaṃ bhaktāgragaṃ (nāthamuniṃ) prapadye padmāmaśeṣajagatāṃ jananīṃ praṇamya śrīkāṃta(mādipuruṣaṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadye teṣāṃ harernityavibhutisaudhasukhāvahārohaṇamūrjitaṃ syāt jñātvāvimucyetanarassamastaissaṃsārapāśairiti caiva viṣṇum

svareṇamaṃtreṇa sadāhṛdisthaṃ parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāṃtam avaśyaṃdhārayennityamurdhvapuṃḍraṃ suśobhanam siṃdhutīre ca valmīke tulasīmūlasaṃśrite mṛda etāstu saṃgrāhyāḥ varjāhyanyatramṛttikāḥ vakṣasthalemādhavaṃ tu goviṃdaṃ kaṃṭhakūbare trivikramaṃ skaṃdhadeśe vāmanaṃvāmapārśvake pṛṣṭhe ca padmanābhaṃ tu trikedāmodaraṃ nyaset tatprakṣālanatoyena vāsudevaṃ ca mūrdhani dhārayedūrdhvapuṃdrāṇi caturaṃgulamāyatam bāhvorvakṣasthale puṃḍraṃ dvādaśāṃgulamucyate || 2 tattatpuṃḍreṣutanmūrtiṃ dhyātvāmaṃtreṇa dhārayet ekapuṃḍra tu nārīṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhīyate || 2 lalāṭe hṛdaye dve tu phāletvekaṃ vidhīyate lalāṭādi krameṇaiva dhāraṇaṃ tu vidhīyate dve ca goviṃdakṛṣṇākhye tvekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dharet eṣapuṃḍravidhiḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ girije mayā padmakuṭmalasaṃkāśaṃ mohanaṃ tritayaṃ smṛtam daṃḍākāraṃ tu vaide vidhārayedūrdhvapuṃḍrakam || 2 pārśvaudvyaṃgulamātrausyādūrdhvapuṃḍrasthalakṣaṇam bahiṣ.kṛtāhyabhikruddhā pāpātpracyā vayaṃtite akṛtairvāpi sukṛtaiḥ taistaiḥ prīṇāti karmabhiḥ toṣayannūrdhvapuṃdreṇa sāyaṃsvātmagataṃharim abhiṣiktaṃ tu yaccūrṇaṃ viṣṇubiṃbe sadānaraḥ savaiṣṇavo lalāṭe tu śriyaṃ māṃ ca vyapohati ramāvṛṣākapi(?)dhanyāvṛddhirijyātatheṃdirā

tṛtīyaṃ kamalāproktaṃ caturthaṃśāṃtiśobhinī saptamaṃ tu varārohā cāṣṭamaṃ harivallabhā ekādaśaṃ tu lakṣmīśca dvādaśaṃsurasuṃdarī tṛtīyākamalāproktā caturthī lokasuṃdarī saptamī tu varārohā hyaṣṭamī harivallabhā navamīśārṅgiṇīproktādaśamīdevadevatā śrīcūrṇasyābhi māninyo dvādaśaitāḥ parāśśubhāḥ || 4 avaiṣṇavassavijñeyo taṃ kupyati hari priyā nānāratnāṃśubhinnābharaṇaśatayutaṃśrīdharāśliṣṭapārśvaṃvaṃdedossakta-cakrāṃburuhavilasitaṃ viśvavaṃdyaṃmukuṃdam nārāyaṇaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ catuśśaṃkhaṃ namāmyaham caṃdravarṇaṃ catuśśārṅgaṃ goviṃdamabhisaṃśraye caturmusalamabjābhaṃ saṃśraye madhusūdanam vāmanaṃ bālasūryābhaṃ caturvajraṃ samāśraye caturmudgaramabhyemi hṛṣīkeśaṃ taṭitprabham dāmodaraṃ catuḥpāśamiṃdragopanibhaṃbhaje ūrdhvapuṃḍreṣviti śrīśaṃnityaṃ dhyāyītanāmabhiḥ māhātmyaṃ śrītulasyāstu kathayasva sureśvara tadarcanavidhiḥkīdṛgudyāpana vidhiḥ katham śṛṇvaṃtumunayassarve tulasīvratamuttamam daṃpatyoḥprītijanakaṃ putrapautrābhivṛddhidam sadāvijayadaṃrājñāṃ vignaughadhvāṃtanāśanam utpannaiṣātadā devī tulasīkāmarūpiṇī pūrṇacaṃdrānanāśyāmā kṛśamadhyāsukeśinī śaṃkhārī ca gadāpadme dadhānāgaruḍā sthitā evaṃrūpā ca sā devī bhaktepsitavarapradā

ārādhitā mayā viṣṇu śaṃbhuśakrādibhissuraiḥ evaṃ prabhāvāsā devīyayedaṃ dhāryate jagat iyaṃ hi guptarūpā tu dṛśyate bhuvisarvadā tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya cchedakona hi vidyate tasya bhāryā hi cārvaṃgī surūpācāru yauvanā śyāmāsumadhyātanvaṃgī nāmnā vṛṃdeti viśrutā sukeśīpadmavadanā pīnonnata payodharā jalaṃdharā sureṃdrasya sarvaśīlaguṇānvitā anurakto bhavattasyāṃ bhāvamāyā vimohitaḥ jalaṃdharanareṃdrasya rājyalakṣmīrvinirgatā taccitābhasmani tadātatparobhūtsuduḥkhitaḥ taccittaugulmarūpeṇa rūpaṃdadhaturuttamam tatobṛṃdāvanecāru tulasīvanamāśrītā tataḥ prabhṛtilokesminnāmnāvṛṃdā vanaṃ smṛtam prāsaṃgikī mahāpuṇyā prasaṃgātpāpanāśanī śubhāyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ siktāyāṃ tīrthavāriṇā tulasīropaṇaṃ kuryāt svastivācanapūrvakam paṃcamyārdrāsamete suraguru divase karkaṭākhye vilagne śrīmānrāmānujāryassamajaninigamāṃtārthasaṃrakṣaṇārtham ekāṃtibhirdvādaśabhissahasraiḥ śrīraṃga āsteyatisārvabhaumaḥ gītābhāṣyamathaprapatti viṣaye gadyatrayaṃ cākarottasmai lakṣmaṇakṣaṇāyamunaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ kūrmahe gatvātāṃ yāmunākhyāṃ saritamathayatīṃdrākhyapadmākareṃdraṃ saṃpūryaprāṇisasyepravahati bahudhādeśikeṃdra bhramaughaiḥ balabhadrastṛtīyastu kalaukaścidbhaviṣyati ahīnāmīśvaraḥ sākṣādabhūdrāmānujo muniḥ kāṃtimatyātmajaśśrīmāllīṁlāmānuṣavigrahaḥ nārāyaṇakṛpāpātraṃ śrībhūtapuranāyakaḥ

kāṃcīpūrṇapriyasakhaḥ praṇatārti vināśanaḥ yādavāpāditāpārtha vṛkṣacchedakuṭhāraka niraṃtarajanājñānanirmocanavicakṣaṇaḥ parābhiprāyatattvajño yāmunāṃguli mocakaḥ pūrṇāryalabdhasanmaṃtraḥ śauripādābja ṣaṭpadaḥ raṃgeśakaiṃkaryaratovibhūti dvayanāyakaḥ vararaṃgānukaṃpāttadrāviḍāmnāyasāgaraḥ catussaptati śiṣyāḍhyaḥ paṃcācārya padāśrayaḥ praṇatārtiharācāryaḥ dattabhikṣaikabhojanaḥ kūreśaṃdāśarathyādi caramārthaprakāśakaḥ devarājārcanaratomūkamukti pradāyakaḥ varadācāryasadbhakto yajñeśārtivināśanaḥ śrīśailapūrṇakaruṇālabdharāmāyaṇārthakaḥ vyāsasūtrārthatattvajño bodhāyanamatānugaḥ advaitamatavicchettā viśiṣṭā dvaitapālakaḥ vināśitākhilamatāśeṣī kṛtaramāpatiḥ bhāṣādattahayagrīvo bhāṣyakāro mahāyaśāḥ śrīveṃkaṭācalādhīśaśśaṃkhacakrapradarśakaḥ kṛpāmātraprasannāryo gopikāmokṣadāyakaḥ kṛmikaṃṭhanṛpadhvaṃsī sarvamaṃtramahodadhiḥ śrībhaktagrāmapūrṇāḍhyo viṣṇuvardhanarakṣakaḥ nagarīkṛtavedādriḥ ḍillīśvarasamarcitaḥ saṃpatkumārajanakaḥ sādhulokaśikhāmaṇiḥ godāgrajodigvijetāgodābhīṣṭaprapūrakaḥ avyāhatamahadvartmāyatirājojagadguruḥ

yaḥ paṭhechṛṇuyādvāpi sarvānkāmānsamaśnute tajjivabhūtaṃbhuvi vaiṣṇavānāṃ babhūvarāmānujamānasānām || 29 pravaktācchaṃdasāṃvaktāpāṃcarātrasya yaḥ svayam anugrahamayīṃvaṃde nityamajñānanigrahām yadvetraśikharaspaṃdeviśvametadvyavasthitam śrutīnāṃviśramāyālaṃśaṭhāriṃtamupāsmahe yasyanaigamikaṃ tattvaṃhastāmalakatāṃ gatam śuddhasattvamayaṃśaureravatāramivāparam aspṛṣṭamadarāgaṃtaṃ rāmaṃturyamupāsmahe nirastajihmagasparśe yatrakṛṣṇaḥ kṛtādaraḥ yena viśvasṛjoviṣṇorapūryatamanorathaḥ prasādayatiyatsūktiḥ svādhīnapadikāṃ śrutim śaraṇāgatasārthavāhamīḍe śikhayāśekhariṇaṃ patiṃ yatīnām apṛthakpratipannayanmayatvairvṛdhepaṃcabhirāyudhairmurāreḥ aparopitavāñchruterapārthānnanurāmāvarajaḥ sa eṣabhūyaḥ vinivartayituṃ yatīśvaroktirvidadhethāsthiranītipaṃjarasthā mahatīgurupaṅktihārayaṣṭirvibudhānāṃ hṛdayaṃ gamāvibhāti yadudbhavāḥ śuddhasuvṛttaśītalāḥbhavaṃtimuktāvalibhuṣaṇaṃ bhuvaḥ akalaṃkayogamajaḍāśayodayaṃyatirājacaṃdramuparāgadūragam haribhaktidāsyarasikāḥ parasparaṃ krayavikrayārha daśayāsamiṃdhate svadatemamādyasubhagāsarasvatī yatirājakīrtikatakairviśodhitā calacittavṛttivinivartanauṣadhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yatīṃdracaraṇau vṛṇīmahe pratipādayaṃti gatimāpavargakīṃyati sārvabhaumapadasātkṛtāśayāḥ raṃgeśabhaktajanamānasarājahaṃsorāmānujaḥ śaraṇamastumuniḥ svayaṃ naḥ viṣvaktanaṃ viṣayalobhaviṣaṃ nijābhirgāḍhānu bhāvagaruḍadhvajabhāvanābhiḥ
