sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | paścācchikhaḥ | saroyogī sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | paścācchikhaḥ | bhūtayogī sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | paścācchikhaḥ | mahadāhvayaḥ ardhanimīlitākṣaḥ | prārthanāmudrāṃjaliḥ | puraścūḍaḥ | tiṣṭhati | bhaktisāraḥ tiṣṭhati | sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | mastakekirīṭam | bhaṭṭanāthaḥ tiṣṭhati | puraścūḍaḥ | karayostālau | viṣṇucittaḥ tiṣṭhati | sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | puraścūḍaḥ | vāmakaremaṇibaṃdhoparivaiṇavapuṣpabhājanaḥ | bhaktāṃghrireṇavaḥ tiṣṭhati | vīṇāvādanalagnakaraḥ | jaṭākuṃjobrahmaraṃdhre | munivāhanaḥ śrīdevī tiṣthati | dakṣakarekamalam | ṛjuvāmahastaḥ | mastakekirīṭam padmāsanaḥ | sāṃjalimudraḥ | dakṣabhāgetridaṃḍadhārī śaraṇāgatasārthavāhamīḍeśikhayāśekhariṇaṃpatiṃyatīnām poṣyaḥśiṣyoguruḥputroyasyataṃgurumāśraye pāṭalavarṇaḥ māyāvādibhujaṃgabhaṃgagaruḍaistraividyacūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīraṃgeśajayadhvajovijayaterāmānujoyaṃ muniḥ śrīviṣṇulokamaṇimaṃḍapamārgadāyīrāmānujovijayate yatirājarājaḥ trayyaṃtālaṃbadaṃḍaṃtribhuvanavijayacchatrasauvarṇadaṃḍaṃ dhatterāmānujāryaḥkavikathakaśirovajradaṃḍaṃtridaṃḍam prajñāsūtraṃbudhānāṃpraśamadhanamaṇiḥpadminīnālasūtraṃ rakṣāsūtraṃmunīnāṃjayatu yatipatervakṣasibrahmasūtram vedārthasārasukhadarśanadīpadaṃḍārāmānujasyavilasaṃtimunestridaṃḍāḥ sitāṃtarīyasottarīyayajñasūtraśobhitomamāvirastumānase guruḥsarvekaṭeśvaraḥ dīvyacchubhrordhvapuṃḍronalinamaṇisarīsacchikhaḥsopavitodorañcacchaṃkhacakraḥ-kavikatakahariḥśrīśaghaṃṭāvatāraḥ daṃḍī | sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | upaviṣṭaḥ | prapannakirīṭī | śiroveṣṭanam padmāsanāsīnaḥ karetālau | mastakaśikhaḥ | tiṣṭhati sāṃjalibaṃdhaḥ | kakṣevyajanam | tiṣṭhati upaviṣṭaḥ | dakṣiṇakare cinmudrā | vāmepustakam | kirīṭam

dakṣiṇakare cinmudrā | vāmepustakam | kakṣetridaṃḍaḥ | padmāsanam (prakārāṃtareṇa) - sāṃjalibaṃdhopi || 1 tīrthārcāberamityete paṃcaberāḥ prakīrtitāḥ snapanaṃsnapanārthaṃsyādutsavaṃtūtsavārthakam balyarthaṃ baliberaṃ ca paṃcaberānsamarcayet tvatprasādānmayāsarvaṃ jñātaṃjñeyaṃ vidhedhunā tasyotpattiṃ nidānaṃ ca varṇaṃkṣetraṃ phalāphalam tathārcanāyāṃ yogyatvaṃ tvadvākyena caturmukha mayocyate vidhānena sāligrāmasya lakṣaṇam mūrtibhedaṃ ca pūjāyāṃ yogyatvaṃ munipuṃgava sāligrāma itikṣetre haricakraśilāmaye tatraivagaṃḍakyā khyātā nadīpāpapraṇāśinī tasmin parvatamūle tu cakratīrthaṃ mahatsaraḥ tasmin parvatatīrthesti sākṣāccakradharohariḥ tacchilāsu ca sarvāsu harikṣetra gatāsu ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sāligrāmaśilā bhavet utpattistacchilānāṃ tu puṇyakāleṣu vidyate vajrakīṭa itikhyāto jaṃturbhutvāharissvayam sāligrāmaśilāgarbhamāsādyakalanissvanaḥ nānāvidhāni cakrāṇi nānārupāṇi līlayā sānnidhyaṃ kurute tatra sākṣāllakṣmīpatissadā utpattirnāradoktaivaṃ vijñeyā munipuṃgava kapilā ca tathādhūmrā kalaṃkā bahuvarṇinī evaṃ vidhaistathā varṇairūpairnānāvidhāśilā pītāhairaṇyagarbhāsyādraktāpradyumnarūpiṇī

śrīmannārāyaṇakṣetraṃ haritāṃgaṃ vidurbudhāḥ kalaṃkākṣayakārīsyādanaṃtobahuvarṇabhāk saṃdigdhavarṇāhaṃtrīsyāditikṣetraphalaṃ mune puṣṭidā vṛddhidā śyāmā raktārājyakarītathā bahuvarṇā śrīkarīsyādvivarṇā niṣpalā tathā tadaṣṭāṃśa pramāṇaṃ syāduttamaṃ yasya gahvaram bhāgatrayaṃ jaghanyasyāt sāligrāmasya lakṣaṇam samavaktraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ syāt pārśvāsyaṃ bhāgya hṛdbhavet mūrtibhedaṃsamāśodhya paścāllakṣaṇamādiśet matsyaḥkūrmovarāhaśca nārasiṃhotha vāmanaḥ rāmorāmaśca rāmaśca budhaḥkalkarimedaśa śrīvatsabiṃdumālāḍhyāṃ matsyamūrtiṃ śubhāṃviduḥ pālāśohemabiṃdu śrīrmahākūrmastu durlabhaḥ dvāradeśelasaccakraṃ vārāhaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ śirodṛṣṭordhvacakraṃ ca pārśvayorvāpi dṛśyate nārasiṃha itikhyāto yogyomaskari pūjane lakṣmīnṛsiṃha ākhyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ hrasvaṃ suvartulaṃ caiva vāmanaṃ paricakṣate nābhideśalasaccakro rāmassyājjamadagnijaḥ nābhicaktraṃ bahucchidraṃ śyāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ viduḥ madhubiṃdudharaḥ śrīmānrāmassaṃkarṣaṇaśśubhaḥ śvetavarṇamatiślakṣaṇaṃ sarvajñaṃ śrīghanaṃ viduḥ śvetavarṇo dīrghamukhaḥ kalkirityabhidhīyate abjacihnaṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ kṛṣṇamenaṃ pracakṣate nīraṃdhraṃ vartulaṃ vāpi dīrghaṃ vāmālikā yutam

evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dīrghākāraṃ mahodaram śrīgopālamimaṃprāhussarekhāvaṃśagahvaram vāmanaṃnīlaraktāṃgaṃ vadaṃti dadhi vāmanam mūrtidadhātigotrīsyād dadhi gopālavāmanaḥ sasmātsaṃtānagopālo putrapautrābhi vṛddhidaḥ aṃkuśākāravadano dharmacakrasamanvitaḥ || 2 dhanurbāṇāṃbujadharaṃ pradyumnaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ viduḥ suvarṇarūpyarekhāḍhyamaniruddhaṃ vidurbudhāḥ pakvajaṃbūphalākāraṃ hayagrīvaṃ vadaṃtyamum kiṃcidviṣamacakrāḍhyaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīkaraṃ viduḥ dvāradvaye catuścakraṃ vāme vā dakṣiṇepi vā śrīvatsaśaṃkhacakrāḍhyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ padmanābha itikhyātastaṃ bidurnākadaṃ budhāḥ daśaraṃdhrasamāyukto viṃśaccakrasamanvitaḥ goviṃda itivikhyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ viśvarūpa itikhyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ samaṃsūkṣmaṃ lasaccakraṃ paṃkajadvayaśobhitam lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prāhurdurlabhaṃ śīghrasiddhidam nārāyaṇamimaṃprāhurnāradeṣṭaphalapradam vanamālālasaccakraṃ prāhurdāmodaraṃ mune anaṃtamūrtirvijñeyo harirlakṣmīpradāyakaḥ vanamālādharaśśrīmāntrivikrama udāhṛtaḥ nanārdana itikhyāto himāṃśupariśītalaḥ nābhicakradharaśśāṃto vāsudeva itīritaḥ paṃcāyudhadharaśśrīmān viṣṇurityucyate budhaiḥ

sūkṣmacakrassamaśślakṣṇo hyacyutassamudīritaḥ upeṃdramūrtirvikhayātā harissaukhyaśubhapradā śivanābhassavijñeyo durlabhassarvakāmadaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ khyātosau hemagarbhaḥ śubhapradaḥ dīrghassuṣiravānvāme gopālomadanā hvayaḥ janārdanaṃ vijānaṃti vanamālābhiveṣṭitam vanamālāyutaṃ ślakṣṇamāhustaṃ ca janārdanam dve dve cakre tvadhaścordhvaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇa smṛtaḥ vṛttākāraṃ tu dīrghaṃ vā dvāradṛṣṭaika cakrakam raktamūrdhvamitiprāhurmahograṃ yati pūjane kapilaṃ vakravadanaṃ tatpārsve vanamālinam mahājvālā nṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ yatipūjyaṃ mahāmune śrīkaraṃśivanābhākhyaṃ sarvasaubhāgyavardhanam buddhākāraṃ vijānīyāccakraṃ vā malināvaham lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃkapilaṃ varṇataḥ kṣetrabhāvanā vanamālāyutaṃ ramyaṃ śvetaṃ vārāhamucyate aṃkuśākāravadanaṃ bhūvarāhaṃ śubhapradam karburaṃ vāthakapilaṃ śyāmaṃ kūrmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ śyāmalaṃ komalākāraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pracakṣate vanamālānvitaṃ śyāmaṃ keśavākhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ mūrtaṃtamacyutaṃ jñeyaṃ sūkṣmaraṃdhraṃ suśītalam vanamālānvitaṃ śyāmaṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ komalaṃ viduḥ viṣṭaraśravasaṃprāhusthūlaṃ dīrghaṃ ca cakriṇam hiraṇyagarbhamāhustaṃ dvāradṛṣṭasudarśanam mālātrayeṇasaṃyuktaṃ mūrtitrayamidaṃ viduḥ

viṣṇulakṣaṇamāsyaṃ cāpyāsya cakraṃ samīpagam kūrmamūrtirvarāhaśca durlabhaṃ sarvakāmadam daṃṣṭre vā śaktiliṃgaṃ ca vaktre tu viṣamasthite varāhamūrtirvijñeyā sarvakāmaphalapradā vanamālā suniṣpannaṃ pṛthucakraṃ sudarśanam brahmacaryeṇasaṃpūjyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī kṣataṃ kuṃḍalasaṃyuktaṃ vaktre vā biṃdupūrvakam hrasvaṃ ca vartulaṃ caiva vāmanaṃ parikīrtayet śyāmalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ cāpyāsya cakraṃsamīpagam kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahāsnigdhaṃ biṃdunoparibhūṣitam dadhivāmanamityāhurbhuktimuktiphalapradam lakṣmīnṛsiṃho vijñeyo bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ dhanurbāṇākhyarekhāḍhyaṃ padmarekhāsamanvitam rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca durlabhaṃ sarvakāmadam savyāpasavyatūṇīraṃ pṛṣṭe cāpavirājitam rāmaṃdāśarathiṃviddhi durlabhaṃ bhuvanatraye dvāradeśe same cakre kalpavṛkṣa su cihnakam sītārāmaṃ tu taṃ viddhi bhuktimukti phalapradam pṛḍṭhe suṣiramāramya vaktremakarakuṃḍalam gopālakṣetramutpattyā sa rāmaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam aputreputraphaladaṃ sarvamaṃgalakārakam suvartulaṃ tathāpītaṃ pṛṣṭhatassuṣiraṃdhruvam brahmamūrtistu vijñeyā bhogamokṣaphalapradā dvāradeśe samecakre dṛśyete nāṃtarīyake apamṛyuharaṃścaiva sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 2

kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ suvikhyātaṃ sarvamṛtyuharaṃ śubham dīrgharekhāsamākrāntaṃ suvarṇavanamālikam ayaṃ nārāyaṇo jñeya apamṛtyu haraśśubhaḥ dīrgharekhāsamākrāntaṃ catuścakrasamanvitam lakṣmīnārāyaṇākhyaṃ ca mukhenābhau ca nārada sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ || 3 kadaṃbakusumākāraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham saṃkarṣaṇaṃvijānīyādraktābhañcātiśobhanam suṣirairbahulaiścaiva dīrghākārastu tadbhavet kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tathāviṣṇuṃ sthūlacakraṃ suśobhanam kṛṣṇamūrtissuvijñeyā bhogamokṣaphalapradā sakṛṣṇavarṇabiṃdussyānnirmalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ kūrmastvevaṃ sa vijñeyassarvakarmaśubhapradaḥ dhvajākārā tadārekhā lakṣyate madhyadeśataḥ cakratrayodaśaṃ puṇyaṃ caturdaśamahāphalam cakraśaṃkhagadāpadma vanamālāvibhūṣitam anaṃtaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt sarvasaubhāgyadāyinam dve cakre caikabhāge tu pūrvabhāge tu puṣkalaḥ trivikramassavijñeyo hyapamṛtyuharaḥ śubhaḥ || 2 veṇulāṃgalacihnaṃ ca kuṃḍalābhyāṃ suśobhitam putralābhaṃ tathāmokṣaṃ bhuktiṃmuktiṃ dadāti ca || 2 sthūlacakro bhaveddevo harirlohitavarṇakaḥ śyāmavarṇo mahāsnigdhaśchatrākārastathaiva ca śirṣe tu puṣkalaṃ bibhranmahāsnigdhaṃ ca komalam putralābhaṃ tathāmokṣaṃ gavāṃ vṛddhiṃ dadāti sā

chatrākāraṃmahāsnigdhaṃ dvāraṃ nāsti sa biṃdukam pṛṣṭhabhāge tathāhema biṃdunāparibhūṣitaḥ vārāhakṣetramuptattyā (catuścakraṃjanārdanaḥ) - catuścakraṃjanārdanaḥ tricakraṃ cācyute jñeyaṃ catuścakraṃ janārdane saptacakraṃ tu vārāhe cāṣṭakaṃ ca puruṣottame ekādaśa tu pradyumne tvanaṃte dvādaśa smṛtām anyeṣubahūcakreṣu paramātmāpratiṣṭhitaḥ śivanābhasahasraṃ ca sāligrāmasahasrakam tāvatyomūrtayassaṃti sāligrāmeṣunārada na śakyate mayāvaktuṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi acakraṃ tu tathāghṛṣṭaṃ vakrāsyaṃ bhinnamevavā dīrghaśobhitamacchāṃgamasaumyākṛtimeva vā bahubāṇasamāyuktaṃ sphuritālakṣyacakrakam baṃdhanaṃ baddhacakraṃ ca krūracakraṃ tathā tyajet dardduraṃ sphuṭitaṃ dagdhaṃ trikoṇaṃ parivarjayet bahurekhaṃ paricchidraṃ tiryakcakraṃ tathā tyajet baṃdhakaṃbaddhacakraṃ ca trikoṇaṃ baṃdhunāśanam arthadhnīvimalā ca syāt karkaśaṃ kṣetrameva ca ghanatvaṃ vṛddhamālokya gṛhṇīyādbuddhimānnaraḥ tasmādasyapradānena prītobhavatu mādhavaḥ tāvubhaupuṇyakarmāṇau narakīkrayavikrayī sāligrāmavapuryatra tatra doṣo na vidyate khaṇḍitā sphuṭitā vāpi sāligrāmaśilā śubhā keśavaṃ vā śivaṃ vāpi spṛṣṭvā naraka maśnute

yaśśūdreṇārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā praṇamennaraḥ sa sarvayātanābhogī yāvadā candratārakam paṃkābhaṃ barbaraṃ caiva mṛgendrasadṛśākṛtim saumyaścedgṛhibhiḥ pūjyahyonyathā pūjanaṃ na hi dve cakredvārakāyāstu nārcyaṃ sūryadvayaṃ tathā bhagnāṃ ca pratimāṃ caiva matsyādi daśakaṃ tathā etāsāṃ pūjanānnityamudvegaṃ prāpnuyādgṛhī viṣamānaiva pūjyāstu viṣameṣveka evahi sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyāt dhāryaṃ ca muninābhaktyā lakṣmīpatimude sadā dharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ bhaktimānyassame priyaḥ śrāddhalāle viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam prāṇaṃsītpadayugapaṃkaje vidhātustatpūjāmakurutanāradopi bhaktyā kathito bhavatābrahman kṣetravarṇaṃ śubhāśubham śyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca nīlaṃ ca tathā vai pītavarṇakam dhūmravarṇaṃ tathādagdhamitinānāvidhāśśilāḥ puṣṭivṛddhipradāśyāmā śuklāmokṣapradāyinī atiriktā mṛtyukarī kṛṣṇā kīrtipradāyinī vāsudevassitojñeyo raktassaṃkarṣaṇassmṛtaḥ śyāmo nārāyaṇo devaḥ kṛṣṇo vaiṣṇava ucyate pāṃḍuro vāsudevaśca śuklaśukla adhokṣajaḥ mayākṣetrasya kathito vistāro munipuṃgava iti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe viṣṇukṣetravaiṣṇavasā(śā)ligrāmādilakṣaṇādinirūpaṇaṃnāma ṣaṣṭhonidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ (kailāsādrau) paraśivaḥ (sūryabiṃbe) sadāśivaḥ (sūryajyotiṣi) siddheśaḥ paṃcāmutravasaṃti hi || 2

(kaivalyaśaile) śrīkaṃṭhaḥ kedāro (himavatya) pi (prayāge) nīlakaṃṭheśo (gayāyāṃ) rudranāmakaḥ (drākṣārāme) tu bhīmeśo (māyūre) cāṃbikeśvaraḥ vṛṣadhvajābhidhaśśrīmāñ (chvetahastipure)śvaraḥ (śrīrūpā)khyetyāgarājo (vede)vedapurīśvaraḥ (madhurāyāṃ) cokkanātho (mānase) mādhaveśvaraḥ (gajāraṇye) tu vaidyeśaḥ (tīrthādrau) tīrthakeśvaraḥ (kaṇvapūryāṃ) tu kaṇveśo (madhye) madhyārjuneśvaraḥ (viriṃcipuri) māgeśaḥ (paṃcanadyāṃ) giriśvaraḥ (trimakūṭe) tvagastyeśaḥ (subrahmaṇye)'hipeśvaraḥ raviṇāpūjito (dakṣiṇāvarte)'rkeśvarassvayam mūrtitrayātmakaḥ (somapuryāṃ) someśvarābhidhaḥ (mahānaṃdipure) sāk.ānmahānaṃdipureśvaraḥ mahāpuṇye tatra (kakudgirau) gaṃgādhareśvaraḥ naṃdīśvaro (naṃdigirau) caṃḍeśo (badhirācale) (ghanānaṃdācale) somo (nallūre) vimaleśvaraḥ (ekāṃte) rāmaliṃgeśaḥ (śrīnāge) kuṃḍalīśvaraḥ (matsyatīrthe) tūtīrtheśaḥ (trikūṭe) tāṃḍaveśvaraḥ (gaṃḍakyāṃ) śivanābhastu (śrīpatau) śrīpatīśvaraḥ (vāṇigrāme) viriṃceśo (nepāle) nakuleśvaraḥ (dharmasthale) maṃjunāthovyāseśastu (trirūpake) (puṃḍarīke) jaiminīśo('yodhyayāṃ) madhureśvaraḥ (maṇikuṃḍalatīrthe) tu maṇimuktānadīśvaraḥ (stanitā)'khye tu malleśaḥ (iṃdrakīle)'rjuneśvaraḥ bhuvaneśaḥ (citrakūṭe) (tūjjinyāṃ) kālikeśvaraḥ

bṛhatīśaḥ (taṃjāpūryāṃ) rāmeśo (vahnipuṣkare) (viṃdhyācale) varāheśonṛsiṃhassyād (ahobale) tathāparaśurāmeśaḥ (setau) rāmeśvarābhidhaḥ (tattvakṣetre) cakalkīśaḥkṛṣṇeśassyān (mahendrake) || 29 jalaliṃgaṃ (jaṃbunāthe) tiruvānanadīpatiḥ (kālahastigirau) vāyuliṃgaṃnāgābhipūjitam (chāyāvane) mahāpuṇye tatra cchāyā vaneśvaraḥ kṣetre (hyāmrātakā) bhikhye sūkṣmeśvara iti sthitaḥ muktiḥkarasthā bhavati nātrakāryā vicāraṇā prātaḥkāle tu pūjāṃte smartavyāni manīṣibhiḥ teṣāṃ phalapravacane śaktaḥ śeṣopi na kvacit || 7 || 8 somāskaṃdeśvaraṃ gaurīṃ caṃḍeśaṃ ca kirātakam mahānṛṃttapravṛttaṃ ca navaberāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tattatphalāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇudevi śubhāni ca navanītaṃ ca rudrākṣaṃ bhasmacaṃdanakūrcajam kṣaṇike maṃḍale toye tvātmārthaṃ yajanaṃ smṛtam sarvarogavināśāya gomayaṃ tu prakīrtitam āsuraṃ lavaṇotthaṃ ca sarvalokavaśaṃkaram taṃḍulodbhavapiṣṭena liṃgaṃ vidyā pradaṃ smṛtam dūrvāguḍūcisaṃbhūtamapamṛtyunivāraṇam ikṣusāramayaṃliṃgaṃ bahudraviṇakāmakṛt pitṝṇāṃ muktaye pūjyaṃ liṃgaṃrajatasaṃbhavam pūjyet tāmrajaṃ liṃgaṃ puṣṭikāmastu saṃtatam kīrtikāmorcayell.imgaṃ sadākāṃsya samudbhavam śoṇacaṃdanajaṃliṃgamāyuṣkāmorcayetpumān

kastūrīsaṃbhavaṃliṃgaṃ graṃthakāmaḥ samarcayet kāṃtikāmastu satataṃ liṃgaṃkauṃkumakesaram sarveṣāṃ kāmadaṃ liṃgaṃ kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhavam godhūmapiṣṭajaṃliṃgaṃ gokāmo nityamarcayet māṣapiṣṭamayaṃliṃgaṃ nityaṃ puṣṭivivardhanam liṃgaṃbrīhimayaṃpūjyaṃyaśaskāmenanityaśaḥ kāmavatsupriyonityaṃbhavetstrīṇāṃhimānavaḥ pūjayitvānaroścattayāprāpnotimahtīṃkṛṣim ihacāmuṣmikelokesukhībhavatimānavaḥ pūjayāparamāṃsiddhiṃ bhaktyāprāpnoti mānavaḥ bhaktyāsamarcyamatimāñchivena saha modate svarvapāpaṃ vidhūyāśu modate brahmaṇā saha sarvānkāmānavāpyātha prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim kṛtvāliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya gāṇāpatyamavānuyāt (tathāvakṣyamāṇarītyāpadmarāgakāśmīra puṣyarāgendranīlagomedakagārutmatavidrumamauktikahīrakapāradabāṇaliṃgānyapi-pūjyāni) sa mahāpātakī tasya durvṛttasya durātmanaḥ tīrthāni vividhā yajñāḥ śivārcā caikataḥ samāḥ tathānāstītināstītiśāstrāṇāmeṣaniścayaḥ pūjayitvā narobhaktyā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt padmarāgācca kāśmīraṃ kāśmīrātpuṣyarāgajam tatogārutmataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidrumaṃ ca tataḥ param suvarṇādadhikaṃśreṣṭhaṃ hīrakaṃ pāradaṃ param pārthivena tu liṃgena bahavaḥ siddhimāgatāḥ devāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhagaṃdharvayakṣakāḥ dvāpare pāradaṃśreṣṭhaṃ pārthivaṃ tu kalau yuge || 1

mṛdbāṇarasaliṃgākhyaṃ teṣāmādyamanuttamam aṣṭamūrtiṣusarvāsu mūrtirmepārthivī varā yathāsarveṣu deveṣu jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho maheśvaraḥ yathāsarveṣu vedeṣu praṇavo hi mahāntsmṛtaḥ pārthivārādhanaṃ dharmyamāyurvardhanamuttamam ṣaḍakṣareṇakartavyaṃ puruṣaistu prayatnataḥ sthāvareṣvapi divyeṣu samantraṃ parvaṇi spṛśet caṃḍa dravyaṃ bahiḥkṣiptaṃ nirmālyaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ smṛtam || 1 pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na doṣomālyadhāraṇe nirmalatvācca (nirmālyaṃ) nṛṇāṃnairmalyakāraṇāt pādodakaprasādānnaṃ saṃgṛhṇanmokṣamāpnuyāt siddhapratiṣṭhite tāmraraupyakāñcanalohaje caṇḍādhikāronoyatrabhoktavyaṃ tatra bhaktitaḥ daṇḍavadbhuvi devārthaṃ tadaṣṭāṅganatirbhavet || 1 yathākathaṃcidrūpeṇaramaṇīyaṃ prakalpayet dvikhaṃḍaṃ hi prakurvāṇo naiva pūjāphalaṃ labhet pārthivaṃ piṣṭajaṃ pauṣpamakhaṃḍaṃ tu prakārayet ye kurvati narāmūḍhā na pūjāphalabhāginaḥ vedoktavidhināsamyak saṃpūrṇaphalasiddhaye brahmayajñaṃ vidhāyādau tatastarpaṇamācaret pūjayetparayābhaktayā pārthivaṃ liṃgamuttamam śivālaye śucaudeśe pārthivārcā vidhīyate śvetāḥśoṇāḥ pītakṛṣṇāḥ mṛdovarṇacatuṣṭayāḥ ānīyamṛtikāṃ śuddha deśāt snigdhāṃ prayatnataḥ paścālliṃgaṃ vidhāyāśu krameṇānena bhaktimān

śivaḥpaśupatiścaiva mahādeva itikramāt snapanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kṣamāpaṇavisarjanam namonādātmane tubhyaṃ namobiṃdukalātmane tvaṃ mātā sarvalokānāṃ tvamevajagatāṃpitā pārthivasyāsya liṃgasya yanmayāpūjanaṃ kṛtam śivodātāśivobhoktā śivassarvamidaṃ jagat pūjāphalaṃ mamasamastamupaitvavighnaṃ pūrṇaṃ vidhehi parameśvara pāhimāṃ tvam praviśatvaṃ mahādeva sarvairāvaraṇaissaha pūjāvidhiṃ na jānāmī kṣamasva parameśvara iṣṭakāmyārthasiddhyarthaṃ punarāgamanāya ca nayāti nyūnatāṃ tattu bāṇaliṅgamitīritam || 1 kurvītāṅguṣṭhato hrasvaṃ na kadācit samācaret ṣaṭpañcakacaturmānaṃ madhyamaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam evaṃ navavidhaṃproktaṃ caraliṅgaṃ yathākramāt || 2 paridhistattriguṇitastadvatpīṭhaṃ vyavasthitam triṣvādyaṃbāṇamutkṛṣṭaṃ rasaliṅgaṃ tatodhikam rudrāṣṭakamitikhyātaṃ tatpatnīputrasaṃyutam yathāhapūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ vadāmitavanārada bhīma ugromahādeva eterudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ teṣāṃbhāryāśca putrāśca nāmāni kathayāmite svāhā viśā ca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ca yathākramāt rudrapatnya imāścāṣṭau putrāṃśca śṛṇunārada vasaṃtassvargasaṃtānau budhaścaiva yathākramāt puṇyakāle tu saṃprāpte śanau vā bhūtimicchatā caturaśrāṃ samāṃbhūmiṃ liptvāgomayavāruṇā

hastamātraṃ dvihastaṃ vā navakoṣṭhasamanvitam brahmāṇaṃ madhyame koṣṭhe sauvarṇaṃ viniveśayet sauvarṇānaṣṭarudrāṃśca brahmārddhena vinirmitān tasyāpyardhena sauvarṇān pratyekaṃ rudrapārśvataḥ svasvamaṃtreṇa pūjāsyānnamaskāra yutena ca pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇamya ca yathākramam pūjayitvopadeṣṭāraṃ dadyān maṃtreṇa madhyamam evaṃ rudrāṣṭakopetaṃ dānaṃ dadyādyathā vidhi āyurārogyasaṃyuktaḥ putrabāndhavavānsukhī bhuktvābhogānyathecchaṃ ca svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca viṃdati akṣamālāṃsruvaṃbibhratpustakaṃ ca kamaṃḍalum pāṭalavarṇaḥ bhajāmibhajatāṃkalpa pādapaṃparayāmudā pītāṃbaramudārāṃgaṃ bhajatāṃkāmadaṃ sadā vibhrāṇaṃprāṇirakṣārthaṃ sarvakālamatandritam mailāraṃrūpamāsthāya śaṅkaraśśaṃkarobhavat duṣṭāñchatrūnvinighnaṃ tuṃturageṇa cacāraha dvāradeśe sthitaiḥ śaśvatsevyamānamataṃdritaiḥ sarvadāsarvarakṣārthamudyataṃ taṃ bhajāmyaham yasya toṣaṃ saṃjanayetpāyasena guḍena vā akleśe naiva sidhyaṃti godhanaṃ vājināṃ ca yaḥ saṃsāraduḥkhasaṃtāpa nāśanāya sukhāya ca haridrayā kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ bhaṃḍāraṃ bhajatāṃ nṛṇām yasya cihnaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ bhaṃḍāraṃ bhajatāṃ sadā māyālakṣmīrmahālakṣmīrmāyāvatyabhi māninī

dvādaśaitāni nāmāni rahasyāni tavāṃbike nāmāni yāni te devi pratyahaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ na tasya bhītiḥ śatrubhyaḥ na vyādhibhyaḥ kadācana tasya ciṃtitakāryāṇi sidhyaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ rudraliṃgārcanaṃ caiva mukhyamāhurdvijāstikāḥ tripuṃḍreṇavinādānaṃ rākṣasaṃ tatprakīrttitam tripuṃḍreṇavināvipro nādhikārī śivārcane dhiganīśārcanaṃ janmadhigvidyāmaśivāśrayām yāvaṃti śrautakarmāṇi kriyaṃte pratyahaṃ dvijaiḥ bhasmadhāraṇahīnāṃgo yadi vipro bhaviṣyati tasmātsarvaprayatnena tripuṃḍraṃ dhāryamanvaham sa eva brāhmaṇo rājan satyaṃsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ sapatatyeva narake yāvadā caṃdratārakam lokevaśīkaraṃproktaṃ bhasmatrailokyapāvanam nāsye śivamayīvāṇī taṃ tyajedaṃtyajaṃ yathā śrutismṛtipurāṇādau saṃghuṣṭaṃ niścitaṃ hitam ye pūjayantyaharahaśśruti tattvabhūtaṃ tānevaghoranarakādahamuddhariṣye kadācidapi na tyājyaṃ yathāśakti samācaret naivapramaditavyaṃ vai bhramādapi kadācana bahiṣṭhassarvadharmebhyastatastannityamācaret caturarṇavaparyaṃtā tena dattā vasuṃdharā spṛṣṭvā tu salilaṃ bhasmaprakṣeptavyaṃ viśuddhaye bhasmatripuṃḍrakaraṇādbhavaṃprāpto bhaviṣyati bhavati śrīmahādevaṃ pūjayetyabravīcchrutiḥ na gṛṇhāti jalaṃśaṃbhurgāṃgaṃ vā kimutetarat

bhūtiyuktāni deyāni mūlamaṃtreṇa śaṃbhave dhāraṇaṃ bhasmano hyuktaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ dvijanmanām yadi syād bhasmarahitaṃ pīyūṣamapi tatparam pākāgārepi deyaṃ syād bhasmakiṃcijjalānvitam tenakīṭādi saṃbaṃdha doṣopi suvinaśyati kiṃ tayāsudhayāputrāḥ kiṃcidbhasmānvitaṃ yadi kartavyāmūlamaṃntreṇa tayā tuṣṭo bhavecchivaḥ tatsarvaṃ bhasmadahati yathāgnistejasāvanam vedokte naivamārgeṇa tripuṃḍre jāyate ratiḥ nityaṃprayatnataḥ kuryān mumukṣurmucyate'cirāt tatrabhuṃkte sa patnīko vṛṣadhvaja iti smṛtaḥ sarvapātaka yukto hi sa sadyaḥ pūyate naraḥ sarvapātakayuktopi pūyate mānavo hi saḥ sarvapātakayuktopi sa sadyaḥ pūyate naraḥ kulaikaviṃśamuttārya sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim paṃcagāvaḥ samutpannāḥ tābhyobhasmotthitaṃ nṛṇām bhavaṃti paṃcanāmāni hetubhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ kramāt (bhasitaṃ) sarvapāpānāṃ bhartsanāt (kṣāra) māpadām dagdhagomayamutkṛṣṭaṃ tadapyagnimukheparam paṃcagāvovibhorjātāḥ sadyojātādi vaktrataḥ naṃdādīnāṃgavāṃ varṇāḥ krameṇaparikīrtitāḥ aghorādbhasmasaṃjātaṃ kṣāraṃtatpuruṣāttathā rakṣāceśānavaktrācca naṃdādi dvārato bhavat yatīnāṃyathoṃcitam || trivarṇāśramiṇāṃcitāgnijam || sarveṣāṃ devālayasthitam || śivāgnihotrajāvibhūtiḥ śivālayamaṃtrasaṃskāradagdhāvā ācamyoktāsanesthitvāprāṅkhovāpyudaṅkhaḥ

tato mūlenabhasitamaṣṭakṛtvobhimaṃtrya ca urodeśamaghoreṇa nābhiṃvāmena gopate evaṃ snānakramaḥproktastasmādevaṃ samācaret sadyaḥ prabhṛtibhirmantraiḥ bhasmānyuddhūayecchanaiḥ ādareṇasamādāyaśuddhepātre nidhāya tat gṛhītvābhasmatatpaṃca brahmamaṃtraiḥ śaniḥkare tairevasaptabhirmaṃtraistrivāramabhimaṃtrayet śivābhidhānaṃ yatproktaṃ bhāsanādbhasitaṃ matam vartaṃte ye mahābhāgā mukhyāste bhasmadhāriṇaḥ gṛhītvābhasmatatpaṃca brahmamaṃtraiḥ śanaiḥ kare tairevasaptabhirmaṃtraistrivāramabhimaṃtryatat saṃyojyabhasmanātoyamagnirityādibhiḥ punaḥ īśānena tu maṃtreṇa svamūrddhani viniḥkṣipet guhye vāmadvaye naiva sadyojātena pādayoḥ uddhūlanasya snānāṃ te prakṣālyakaramācamet athabhasmādāyābhimaṃtrayet (5) - īśānassarvavidhānam śivom tatpuruṣāya pracodayāt aghorebhyaḥ rudrarūpebhyaḥ vāmadevāyanamaḥ manonmanāyanamaḥ sadyojātaṃ bhavodbhavāyanamaḥ hastapādādivacchiṣyā itiśiṣṭābruvaṃti hi dhāryaṃtripuṃḍraṃ strīṇāṃ ca yatīnāṃ jalavarjitam madhyāhnātprāgjalairyuktaṃ paratojalavarjitam ṣaḍagulāyatamapi cādhikaṃ mānatastathā akāronāmikāprokto hyukāromadhyamāṃguliḥ

madhyamānāṃmikāṃguṣṭhairanulomavilomataḥ mūrddhā caiva lalāṭaṃ ca karṇaukaṃṭhastathaiva ca paṃcāṃgulairnyasemūddhri praṇavena tu maṃtrataḥ sadyenadakṣiṇe karṇe vāmadevena vāmataḥ hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye naiva tribhiraṃgulibhisspṛśet vāmabāhau nyaseddhīmān kavacena triyaṃgulaiḥ naimittikeṣu bhasitaṃ rakṣākāryeṣu sarvadā kṣāraṃ ca mokṣakāryeṣu prayoktavyaṃ sadābudhaiḥ || 2 kalpañcaivānukalpañcāpyupakalpamakalpakam yathāśāstrokta vidhinā gṛhītvā gomayaṃ navam śoṣayetpuruṣeṇaiva dahedghorācchivāgninā vaneṣugomayaṃyacca śuṣkaṃcūrṇī kṛtaṃ tathā vastreṇottaritaṃ bhasma gomūtrādbaddhapiṃḍitam deśakālocitaṃbhasma gṛhītvā'śucivarjitam sādhāraṇamidaṃ(bhasma)tvakalpamadhūnā śṛṇu śrautasmārtāgnidāvāgni virajāgniśivāgnijam vaidikairevatadgrāhyaṃ bhasmapaṃcavidhaṃ ca tat || 4 || 1 caṃdanenobhayaṃkuryādititanmanurabravīt ardhacaṃdraṃ tu śūdrāṇāmanyeṣāmūrdhvapuṃḍrakam netrayugmapramāṇaṃ tu tripuṃḍraṃ dhārayed dvijaḥ tattripuṃḍraṃbhavecchastaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam śucirevabhavennityaṃ tripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇāt betālarākṣasāḥpretāḥ ye cānye kṣudrajaṃtavaḥ satāṃpaṅtipunātyeva sakalāṃ caturānana sthāneṣu paṃcadaśasu śarīre sādhakottamaḥ

galebhujadvaye caiva hṛdinābhau ca pṛṣṭhake tripuṃḍraṃ bhasmanādhāryaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa sādhakaiḥ || 3 amaṃtrapūrvamanyeṣāṃ śudrāṇāṃ dharmavedinām yathā hi yajñakarmādau patnīsādhye hi karmaṇi sarvamaṃtrādhikarosti tathābhasmādi dhāraṇe vibhūtirauṣadhaṃpuṃsāṃ muktistrī vaśyakarmaṇi || 1 tasmādvāruṇamutsṛjya snānamāgneyamācaret evammuktvā ṛṣīndevāntsnāto devaḥ śivaḥ svayam sarvakarmasuyatnena bhasmasnānaṃ prakurvate anenaivaśarīreṇa sa rudronātrasaṃśayaḥ ādraṃ tu prakṛtiṃvidyāt prakṛtiṃ baṃdhanaṃ viduḥ dhiganīśārcakajanāndhigvidyāmīvāśrayām brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ trayyagnīnāṃ ca dhāraṇam sāmaveda adhastācca vedatrayadharobhavet vibhūtidhāraṇetvanyonāsti pratinidhirdhruvam tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rauravaṃnarakaṃ vrajet udapaśyatpurāyogamunmīlitavilocanaḥ tebhyojātā yatastasmād rudrākṣā itikīrtitāḥ netrātsūryātmanaśśaṃbhoḥ kapilā dvādaśoditāḥ kṛṣṇādaśavidhājatāḥ vahnirūpādvilocanāt evamutpattito bhedādrudrākṣā bahudhā smṛtāḥ rudrākṣarahito vipro narake patati dhruvam rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ vakṣye rudrarūpasya siddhaye dvitridvādaśavaktrāṇi śirasitrīṇidhārayet daśasaptapaṃcavaktrān ṣaṭṣaṭkarṇadvaye tathā

paṃcāśaddhārayedvidvāṃścaturvaktrāṃstu vakṣasi pratyekaṃ dvādaśatathānavāsyānmaṇibaṃdhayoḥ dvātriṃśatkaṃṭhadeśe tu catvāriṃśacca mastake ekamevopavīte tu dhārayedbhāvayañchivam sametāndhārayedyastu rudrākṣānsa śivo bhavet rudrākṣāvidhijāḥ proktāssarvapāpavināśakāḥ ekatraveṇikāyāśca darśanena phalaṃ tu yat samatāmevatatprāptaṃ tasmāddhāryaṃ trayaṃ budhaiḥ ekaṃmukhaṃ tu yasya syāt pratipūraṃ vrajediha trimukhī ca yadā syād vaiśastraghātādikaṃ na hi jale tu mucyamānāsānatarenmajjati kṣaṇāt jalemajjati sā jñātvā dhāryādharmavivṛddhaye || 4 avadhyatvaṃ pratisroto vahnistaṃbhaṃ karoti ca trivaktro hyagnijanmātha pāparāśiṃpraṇāśayet paṃcavaktrastu kālāgniragamyāgamapāpanut saptavaktrastvanaṃtassyāt svarṇasteyādi pāpahṛt bhairavonavavaktrastu śivasāyujyakārakaḥ ekādaśamukhorudro nānāyajñaphalapradaḥ trayodaśamukhaḥ kāmaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ caturdaśāsyaśśrīkaṃṭho vaṃśoddhārakarassmṛtaḥ yatraliṃgāni śaivāni tatrasannihitaḥ śivaḥ viśveśvaro vā viṣṇurvā brahmā vā na bhaviṣyati namaste astubhagavannityādi śrutibhissadā somaḥpavate ityādi śrutyāsomaḥ sadāśivaḥ īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmityādi śrutibhirmuhuḥ

umayāsahito devassoma ityabhidhīyate rudrākṣadhārakassoma itiśāstravidoviduḥ bāhvoriṃdoḥ kalābhiḥ nayanayugakṛtepyekamekaṃśikhāyāṃ vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayatiśatakaṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṃṭhaḥ abhasmarudrākṣadharoyadi syād dvijonatasyāsti phalopapattiḥ śrutismṛtibhyāmiha codyamānā vibhūtirudrākṣa dhṛtissamānā rudrākṣaṃdhārayetprājñaśśivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ duṣṭacittādurācārāduṣprajā apimānavāḥ trissaptakulamuddhṛtyarudralokaṃ sa gacchati mlecchovāpyatha caṃḍālo yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ khādanmāṃsaṃpibanmadyaṃ saṃgacchaṃnnaṃ tyajāmapi sarvayajñatapodānairvedābhyāsaiśca yatphalam śirasādhāraṇe koṭiḥ karṇayordaśakoṭayaḥ ayutaṃcopavīte tu lakṣakoṭirbhuje dhṛte rudrākṣadhāraṇācchreṣṭhaṃ na kiṃcidiha vidyate yaḥ punarmaṃtrasaṃyuktaṃ dhārayedbhaktito naraḥ śatakoṭiguṇaṃpuṇyaṃ dhāraṇāllabhate naraḥ japāccalabhate puṇyaṃ nātrakāryā vicāraṇā tasya puṇyaphalasyāṃtaṃ na cāhaṃ vaktumutsahe kimuyedhārayaṃtismanarārudrākṣamālikāḥ mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudrākṣasya ca dhāraṇāt sarvapāpavinirmuktassayāti paramāṃ gatim abhijño vā na bhijño vā rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇāt rudrākṣaṃdhārayetprājñaśśivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ avṛttaṃ yamalaṃ vakramaṣṭāvetānvivarjayet navyaṃparaṃparāprāptaṃ dhāryaṃ rudrākṣamuttamam

dṛṣṭvonnatāsane sthitvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet japastu śaṃkhamaṇināśatamaṣṭottara bhavet padmākṣeṇa sahasraṃ syāt sphaṭikenā yutatrayam atassarvaprayatnena rudrākṣaissarvadā japet puruṣo vai rudra itiśrutireṣāyatomatā sarvavyāpī ca bhagavān tasmāt sarvagataḥ śivaḥ sunirmalamidaṃśāṃtamīśānajyotiravyayam manasākarmaṇāvācā śivaṃ yo bhajate sadā muktimuktāvarṣakopaṃ śivamaṃtraḥ śrutiśrutaḥ mokṣārthī tu śivādanyaṃ yaḥ pūjayitumicchati sa unmatta itijñeyo vedamārgādbahiṣkṛtaḥ yasmin kule samutpannaḥ śivapūjāparo bhavet dadau vaikuṃṭhamamalamatodevottamaḥ śivaḥ tadanyaṃ nastuvaṃtyeva matodevottamaḥ śivaḥ satyaṃsatyaṃpunassatyamuddhṛtyabhujamucyate puṇyasaṃghaikanilayaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayam yatraśaivāḥ śivaparāstatrasannihitaḥ śivaḥ durlabhāśāṃbhavī vidyā śivebhaktiśca durlabhā kālamṛtyurna cāyāti kimutānye ca mṛtyavaḥ pūjayasva mahādevaṃ tasmānmā pramado'bhavam śaṃkarārcana yogyāni bhavaṃtīti hinaḥ śrutam arpitānyapi bilvāni prakṣālya ca punaḥ punaḥ śuṣkaṃ khaṃḍitamārdraṃ vā bilvapatraṃ śivapriyam saṃpādyapūjayaṃtīśaṃ navālābhe vicakṣaṇāḥ vinikṣipyamahāpāpairmucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ

tathānānyenasuprīto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ bilvapatraṃ vināpūjā na sāṃgāpārvatī pateḥ vastrādidānatopyetadbhavatyeva hi puṇyadam bilvapatrārthamanyattu na bhavatyeva sarvathā tatopikoṭiguṇitaṃ bilvapatrārcane prabhoḥ sadyonaśyaṃti bilvena pūjite tu maheśvare bhoktavyamanyathāviprairanvahaṃ yāṃtiyātanāḥ yatneṣu pūjanīyeṣu bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyate ārdraṃ vā yadi vā śuṣkaṃ śīrṇaṃkhaṃḍitameva vā gaurīgaurāṃgakodbhūtasvedabiṃdusamudbhavaḥ sā yujyādiphalāvāpti sādhanaṃ tarurāḍyataḥ svodyānodbhavavṛkṣasya svahastopārjitairnaraḥ adhomukhairbilvapatrairatramesaṃśayo mahān madhyapatre sthitassākṣāt sāṃbassarvārthasādhakaḥ pṛṣṭabhāgesthitāyakṣā abhaktānāṃ niṣedhakāḥ tato vai pūrvabhāgena pūjayedgirijāpatim adhomukhaṃ bilvapatraṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā pūjayetpārvatīnāthaṃ siktaṃ caṃdanavāriṇā mahākailāsabhavane śivena sahamodate pratyahaṃniyame neti prāhurjābālavādinaḥ ahorātrakṛtaṃpāpaṃ naśyatyeva hi nārada yaḥkuryādbhrūṇahāpāpānmucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ haranāmajapaṁllakṣaṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyayohati pūjayedgirijānāthaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ tenirguṇā apiguṇāṃbudhayobhavaṃti viṃdaṃtimuktimupabhuktasamastabhogāḥ

tiṣṭhanti brahmanikaṭe tasmādupaniṣatsmṛtā mokṣaikahetubhūtāni nṛṇāṃ śravaṇamātrataḥ vidhimantrārthavādāśca vedeṣu gaditāstrayaḥ mīmāṃsā śāstramaparaṃturyaṃ vedāṃtanāmakam ṣaḍetāni hi śāstrāṇi jagadetairniyamyate || 2 tarkaśāstrānnītiśāstraṃ nānāthaparibṛṃhitam mīmāṃsāśāstrato dharma śāstraṃ karma kriyāhvayam yogaśāstrāttatvaśāstramātmajñānapradarśanam saṃgṛhītānimunibhirupaśāstrāṇi yāni ca || 4 śabdaśāstraṃ mahābhāṣyaṃ sūtravyākaraṇānvitam || 1 sūtraṃ bhāṣyaṃ vārtikaṃ ca trayaṃśāstreṣu varṇyate ākṣeposyasamādhānaṃ vyākhyānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ matam || 1 nāradīyāhvayaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mārkaḍeyaṃ tu saptamam laiṃgyaṃ vārāhakaṃskāṃdaṃ vāmanaṃ kaurmameva ca aṣṭādaśaprabhedāni vyāsenoktānibhāmini || 3 cāturlakṣa 400000 pramāṇena cakrepārāśaromuniḥ skāṃdaṃ ca śivadharmākhyaṃ daurvākhyaṃ nāradīyakam vāruṇaṃ kālikākhyaṃ ca māheśvarasamīritam etānyupapurāṇāni vedavyāsoditānihi || 4 śaivavaiṣṇavasārākhyairaticitrakathānvitaiḥ purāṇābhinnānyanyānikānicitsaṃtibhāmini itihāsottamaṃ tadvaditihāsasamuccayam śeṣadhārmahvayaścānyaḥ kathitolokapāvanaḥ || 2 teṣvādimohariścandramāhātmyakathanakramaḥ caturthastunalodaṃtassaudāsodaṃta eva ca

tatorukmāṃgadodaṃtodauṣyaṃtodaṃta eva ca śivadharmāhvayaṃ śāstraṃ viṣṇudharmāhvayaṃ tathā purāṇabhinnānyetānikīrtitānimanīṣibhiḥ || 5 vaidyādharastu prathamonānācitrakathāśrayaḥ yāyātastucaturthassyātpaṃcamomohanāhvayaḥ ete sarvārthadātaṇāṃ śravaṇātpāpahāriṇaḥ || 3 tṛtīyaṣṣoḍaśīkalpaḥ kalpaḥ pañcākṣarābhidhaḥ rāmatārakakalpaśca śūlinī kalpa eva ca tatodhūmāvatīkalpaśśītalākalpa eva ca lakṣmīnṛsiṃhakalpaśca kuhūkalpastataḥ param aśvatthakalpaḥ tulajābhavānīkalpa eva ca tathaivabagalākalpaḥ kalpovaṭukabhairavaḥ rājamātaṅgikākalpaḥ kalpobrahmāstranāmakaḥ dattātreyābhidhaḥ kalpaḥ kārtavīryābhidhaḥ param etekalpāvedamūrti saṃkhyākāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 9 śātatapovasiṣṭhaśca yamāpastaṃbagautamāḥ śaunakoyājñavalkyaścetyaṣṭādaśamunīśvarāḥ etaiḥ pravartitāloke smṛtayoṣṭādaśottamāḥ jābālirnāciketaśca skaṃdalokākṣikaśyapāḥ vyāghraḥ kātyāyanobabhruḥ jātūkarṇaḥ kapirnalaḥ sumaṃturetemunayastathopasmṛtikāriṇaḥ || 3 prāyaścitta kramaḥśrāddhaṃ paṃcasmṛtiṣuyojitāḥ || 1 vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇeṣu prakīrtyate || 1 udyānasalilakrīḍāmadhupānaratotsavāḥ maṃtraṃdyūtapramāṇāni nāyakābhyudayastathā

kāvyetvaṣṭādaśavidhāvaṇyartakāvyavedibhiḥ ādauvaidikataṃtrāṇāmanukramaṇikocyate āruṇeśvarataṃtraṃ ca viśuddheśvaranāmakam kālāsāraṃ kālavādataṃtraṃ yogīśvarī śatam paścimāmnāyakābhikhyamuttarāmnāyanāmakam kuṃḍīśvaramataṃ vīṇātaṃtraṃ guhyāhvayaṃ ca tat hṛdbhedaṃ mātṛbhedaṃ ca vātulaṃ vātulottaram bahurūpāṣṭakaṃ caiva yāmalāṣṭakameva ca anusṛtyatuvedoktakarmāṇyanucaraṃtihi || 8 mahāmāyāśaṃbaraṃ ca yoginījālaśaṃbaram mahāsaṃmohanaṃ caiva rūpikāmatameva ca pariśiṣṭānaṃdataṃtramamareśvarameva ca paṃcāmṛtaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ bhūtākhyaṃ vaibhavāṣṭakam mahākālīmataṃ caiva mahāvīrāvatīmatam mahākuleśvarīcūḍāmaṇitaṃtramanuttamam trayastriṃśatprabhedāni hyavaidikavatāṃ nṛṇām || 33 || - || mahāmāyāśambaraṃ ca yoginījālaśambaram bahurūpāṣṭhakaṃ caiva pātalāṣṭakameva ca vāmajaṣṭaṃ mahādevaṃ vātūlaṃ vātulottaram kalāvādaṃ kalāsāraṃ tathānyatkuṇḍikā matam pañcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtoḍḍāmarameva ca sarvajñānottamaṃ caiva mahākālīmataṃ tathā pūrvapaścimadakṣaṃ cāpyattaraṃ ca niruttaram vimalaṃ vimalorjaṃ ca devīmatamataḥ param kaṃkālabhairavaṃ taṃtraṃ kālāgnyākhyaṃ ca bhairavam

mahābhairavataṃtraṃ ca tathā bhairavanāthakam || 2 indrāṇī caiva cāmuṇḍā śivadūtī kumārikā etannāmānitantrāṇi bahurūpāṣṭakānihi maṃtrārṇavaṃ maṃtrasāraṃ mahākālaṃ tu śāṃbhavam uḍḍāmareśvaraṃ rājataṃtraṃ lākulīkeśvaram saubhāgyavallarītaṃtraṃ tālaṃ caṃḍeśvaraṃ tathā paṃcavakrasya vakrebhyaḥ paṃcabhyaḥ parijajñire || 4 teṣāmādyaḥ kāmikākhyo dvitīyaḥ kāraṇāgamaḥ yogajaścaiva vedasya sadyojātamukhāccayutāḥ svāyaṃbhuvanalānāmatvaghoramukhasaṃbhavāḥ biṃbākhyovimalākhyaśca mukhāttatpuruṣāccyutāḥ sarvottaraśca saṃtāna kiraṇau pārameśvaraḥ pāñcarātrāgamaḥ proktaḥ kāraṇāgama eva ca ṛtusaṃkhyāstu vijñeyā āgamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 2 vijñānalalitaṃ ceti catvāro vaiṣṇavāgamāḥ || 1 ṣaṇnavatyuttaraśatasaṃkhyākāḥ parijajñire || 1 hayagrīvaśca garbhaśca śaunako manureva ca vyāsobṛhaspatiścaiva yamogautama eva ca śātātapovāmadevo vṛddhaśātātapastathā jābālirjailanityaśca jānaṃntirjahnureva ca śālihotraḥ suhotraśca vasuhotrastadanaṃtaraḥ nityahotraḥ prāṇahotraḥ sahastotrastathaiva ca pṛgādhacūlībhṛgavaḥ suyajñaśca tataḥ param vṛṃdāvanaścolūkaśca vātsyāyanamṛkaṃḍukau kapilonaidhruvaḥ kāśyapa evaṃ ṛṣyaśṛṃgakaḥ

medhātithiścalaugākṣiḥ śuddhakālapradīpakau bṛhadukthyaḥ kapiścaivahārītaḥ kutsa eva ca bāṣkalaśca phaṇīpūtimāṣonakula eva ca yoganārāyaṇīyāṃśuratnamālyābhidhāstathā sanatsujātoyavanovālakhilya iti kramāt vedopavedavedāṃgā gamataṃtrakramādikam tattatkartṛprabhedaśca kīrtitaścaivamatrahi śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśastripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakaḥ baddhapadmāsanodvyaṣṭabhujaiḥ khaṭvāṃgaśūlake cinmudrikāṃcākṣamālāṃ pustakaṃ ca kamaṃḍalum śvetavarṇaḥ baddhapadmāsanaḥ proktaḥ śvetavarṇaścaturmukhaḥ cinmudrāṃpustukaṃkuṃḍīmakṣaṃdakṣāditaḥ kramāt jaṭībaddhakirīṭī ca sadādadyācchubhāninaḥ śetavarṇaḥ brahmacārīgṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ ṭīku - taṃtrasāroktavāda upadeśapaṭaladalli brahmavettarugaliṃda helalpaṭṭiruvadenaṃdarebrahmacāriyu gṛhasthanu vānaprasthanu yatiyu aśreṣṭhānāṃ hareśre'ṣṭhā guravaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 2 ṭīku - varṇāśramātītanāda avadhūtayogiyu yī aidujanaru yogyarāgiddare vabbarigiṃtavabbaru śreṣṭharādaguruvenisuvaru | yalai viṣṇuve tamage yogyatekaḍameyāgiddare tamagiṃta śreṣṭharu kramavāgi gurugalenisikkolluvaru | adu hyāgeṃdare vidyotkarṣabalenaiva gururbhavatinānyathā ṭīku - gṛhasthāśramavaṃtanige brahmacāriyu yatige vānaprasthanu vidyotkarṣabaladiṃda mātrave guruvenisuvanu | mattoṃduprakāradiṃdalu āgubadillā vidyotkarṣabalenaiva gururbhavatinānyathā ṭīku - hāge hṛhasthanu vānprasthanige guruvāguvanu | vanasthanu yatigū guruvāguvanu | yalai kamalākṣane āśramadallikaḍameyādāgyu vidyotkarṣadiṃda śreṣṭhanāgiruvanendu anisikkolluvanu yī arthadallisaṃśayavilla vidyotkarṣabalenaivagururbhavatinānyathā ṭīku - hāge vānaprasthanu saṃnyāsigu guruvāguvanu | yalai puruṣottamane varṇāśramagalannu atikramiśiruva avadhūtayogiyādāgyu vidyābalavilladiddare guruvāguvadilla

nakasyāpibhavecchiṣyo yathāhaṃ puruṣottama ṭīku - kalai viṣṇuve varṇāśramagalannatikramiśida yogiyu sarvarigiṃtalu śreṣṭhanāguvanu | ātanu tannaṃte yārigū śiṣyanāguvadilla athavā brahmavitprājño yogyābhāvetayorvaraḥ ṭīku - matteneṃdare stīyarigu śūdrarigu upadeṃśavannu māḍuva gurutvādhikāravu illave ila | ādaru strīyarige patiyemukhyaguruvu | ātanigiṃtalu taṃdeyu guruvenisuvanu | avaribbarigu maṃtropadeśamāḍaluyogyateyu sāladiddalli brahmajñāniye uttama guruvenisuvanu purāṇapaṭhanemaṃtre jñānamārgapradarśane ṭīku - śūdrarige purāṇapāṭhavannu maṃtropadeśavannu jñānopadeśavannu māḍuvadakku tamagiṃtalu vaiśya kṣatriya brāhmaṇa yī kramadiṃda vabbarigiṃtavabbaru uttamottamaguruvenisuvaru vratamaṃtropavāsesyādanyathāniṣphalaṃ bhavet ṭīku - strīyarunalige maṃtropavāsamodalāda taṃtramārgādhikāramātrave patiyājñeyiṃda uṃṭāguvadu | patiya ājñeyillade prabartisalusakalavu niṣphalavāguvadu abhāvejanakasyājñānaṃ svātaṃtryaṃ bhavet striyaḥ ṭīku - strīyarige patiye mukhyaguruvāddariṃda avanige maṃtropadeśadayogyateyilladiddare avana ājñeyiṃdale mattobbaguruvannu āsrayisabeku | avanataruvāya taṃdeya ājñeyanāśrayisabeku | strīyarige svātaṃtryavilla jātāśauce mṛtāśauce rajodoṣaprasūtiṣu suvāsinyāśśirasnānaṃ natvabhyaṃgaṃ vinā kvacit ṭīku - śaivaratnākaradalli sūtasaṃhiteyalliruvadenaṃdare - suvāsinīyaru puṇyakṣetra puṇyatīrthagalalliyu grahaṇādipuṇyakāladalliyujātāśaucādigalalliyu rajasvale pādāgaluprasavavādāgalu putrīputravivāhadalliyu patiyu ācarisuva yāgādidīkṣegalalliyu śiraḥ snānavannu māḍabahudu | yī prakṛtagalallade abhyaṃgahoratāgi śiraḥsnānasarvathā yogyavalla madarcanaṃ hi kalyāṇyāni yogobhartturasti cet sānārīnirayaṃ yātinātrakāryā vicāraṇāṃ purāṇapaṭhanaṃ śreyā na vedādhyāyanādikam namontaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃśāktaṃ śaivaṃvācānyadaivatam mahāpātakadāvāgnissoyaṃ maṃtraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ṭīku - nityavu gaurīpaṃcākṣarīmaṃtradiṃdale gaurīpūjeyaṃmāḍabeku | strīyarige praṇavavarjitavāgiyemaṃtropadeśavaṃmāḍatakkaddu | āddariṃdavaiṣṇavaśaktiśaivamaṃtragalu namoṃtavāgiye upadeśamāḍatakkaddu | yīmaṃtravu namoṃtavādakāraṇaklībamaṃtraveniśikolluvadu | āddariṃdayidekramaddiṃdale strīyarige upadeśavaṃ māḍabeku | brahmottarakhaṃḍadalli heliruvadeneṃdare praṇavayuktavāda yī maṃtrave mahāpātakagalige dāvāgnisvarūpavāda ṣaḍakṣarīyanisuduyidemaṃtraveṃ praṇavarahitavādare paṃcākṣarīyanisikkolluvadu nālaṃkriyānahomaśca na saṃskāro na tarpaṇam prāṇāyāma manenaiva tenaivācamanaṃ varam pratimāsvarcayed viṣṇuṃ devīṃ vāgarikanyakām devatāyāḥ kalāhvānaṃ na pratiṣṭhāvidhistriyāḥ ṭīku - strīyarugalu śivapūjeyannu gaurrīpūjeyannu yidemaṃtradiṃdale māḍatakkaddu | yāva ākṛti yannu yiriśipūjisebeṃkadare viṣṇuvannu gauriyanniriśikoṃḍepūjisatakkaddu | īśvaranaṃpūjisabekādare śivaliṃgavanniriśikkoṃḍepūjisatakkaddu | migilādadevategalannumaṃḍaladalliyepūjisatakkaddu | yiṣṭehoratu strīyarugalige devatā kāla āvāhaneyu prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānavukaḍadu | āddariṃdapuruṣariṃda prāṇapratiṣṭhitavāda liṃgavigrahagalannu pūrvoktarītiyiṃdalepūjisabeku || (maṇḍalavaṃdare raṃgavalyādicitra) paṃcame tu dvayaṃ proktamabdānāṃ varṇakaṃ budhaiḥ

ṛtūnāṃ tu trayaṃmutau netrasaṃkhyā trayaṃ tathā yugasaṃkhyā dvayaṃproktaṃ māsānāṃ varṇato mayā dvisaṃkhyāyāṃ trayaṃproktaṃ tithīnāṃ varṇitā budhaiḥ ekaṃ vai yugasaṃkhyāyāṃ vārāṇāṃ kathito janaiḥ aṣṭakaṃ ca dvisaṃkhyāyāṃ traye caikādaśa smṛtāḥ dvisaṃkhyāyāṃ paṃcadaśatraye caiva daśa smṛtāḥ aṣṭake tu trivarṇāḥ syurakṣisaṃkhyā dvayaṃ tathā dvisaṃkhyāyāṃ rasāḥ proktāstrisaṃkhyāpaṃcakaṃ tathā vedasaṃkhyā dvayaṃproktaṃ dvisaṃkhyā ṛṣayastathā śakeśālīvāhanasya catuṣpañcamunīnduke śrīmaccaṇḍī kṛpādṛṣṭyā kathitākṛṣṇabhūbhujā abdādigrahaparyaṃtā varṇasaṃkhyā satāṃ mude iti śrīmatsamastabhūmaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānānikhiladeśāvataṃsakarnāṭakajana-padādhiṣṭhānabhūta- śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthānamadhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata-rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilanijarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūta-divyaratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaśrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpāprati-mavīranarapatibirudeṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukūlapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍa-bheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyanekabirudāṃkitaśrīmanmahī-śūrapuravarādhīśaśrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe āgamādinirūpaṇaṃnāma aṣṭamonidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ iti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe - aṣṭama āgamanidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ senānīrvīrabhadraśca rāmakṛṣṇaumahāphaṇī manmathomohinī caiva kramāt ṣoḍaśadevatāḥ rājārājñīrathovājī padātirdhvaja eva ca ataḥ paraṃ tu vijñeyāścakravartipadaṃgatāḥ rājarājeśvarī cādau kālīlakṣmīḥ sarasvatī vārāhī ca tatheṃdrāṇī daṃḍinī maṃtriṇī tathā iṃdrākṣī cānnapūrṇā ca tathāṣaṭcakradevatāḥ ādau cāmuṃḍikārpyāṇihaṃsapatrāṇi sapta vai tattadaṃkānusāreṇakhelanīyyāvicakṣaṇaiḥ dakṣavakraṃ hanūmāṃśca vaṭacchadaśayastathā makarassyātpañcabāṇā hastasthaśśuka eva ca

sauvarṇaiścātiraktaiśca pāṭalaiḥśśvaitavarṇakaiḥ saindūrasthālathalyenayutoharita eva ca vartirūpastathāgauroraktotyasitavarṇayuk ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca jātīnāṃ rājarājeśvarī kramāt śukacchadānāṃvarṇastu raktojñeyovicakṣaṇaiḥ sarveṣāmekarūpeṇa raktovarṇastu nānyathā cāmuṇḍāyāḥ krīḍanakepradhānācaṇḍikā smṛtā ekaikapatrarītyā tu caturṇāṃ patrikā tadā pṛthakcaturbhirgrāhyāḥ syurviṃśatiḥ kuśalaiḥ smṛtāḥ rājādimīnaparyantaṃ dūrbalaṃ hyuttarottaram svīyapatreṣu yacchreṣṭhaṃ tatpradāyamanīṣiṇā dvitīye haṃsaparyāye caṇḍikābhāgapūrikā cāmuṇḍāyai samarpyāṇi haṃsapatrāṇi nānyathā krīḍātvādausvapatreṣu prabalaṃ tulyajātikam yenapradīyate tatra prabalaṃ hyādadītasaḥ yenānte krīḍane dattaṃ jayinaṃtaṃ vinirdiśet parityajyaviśeṣoktīragrimakrīḍaneṣuvai śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpālabdhalakṣmīvāṇīsamṛddhinā āṣāḍhe citrabhānostu śuklaikādaśake ravau chūṭa cakravartigala yalegalu 25 kke (1) - mahākālī (1) - mahālakṣmī (1) - mahāsarasvatī (1) - brāhmī (1) - māheśvarī (1) - kaumārī (1) - vaiṣṇavī (1) - vārāhī (1) - iṃdrāṇī (1) - maṃtriṇīśyāmalā (1) - daṃḍinīvārāhī (1) - yoganidrā (1) - bālā (1) - bhuvaneśvarī (1) - iṃdrākṣī (1) - annapūrṇā (1) -śarīrasthaṣaṭcakradevategalu (1) - śākinī (1) - kākinī (1) - lākinī (1) - rākinī (1) ḍākinī (1) - hākinī (1) - vāgīśvarī (1) - ratidevī || vaṭṭu ī 25 yalegaligu igalīkadabaṇṇa || - || cāmuṇḍeśvarī mīrā baṃdavara āṭave modalāguvaddariṃda cāmuṃḍeśvarī hukumige koḍatakka iṃgalīkada baṇṇavulla haṃseyalegalu tāṃḍavaścaivakaṃkālomatsyādyādaśamūrtayaḥ ekasyādevatāyāstu smṛtisaṅkhyāmitacchadāḥ ekādirāśisaṃkhyāntaṃ tattaccihnaṃ pravakṣyate matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca mṛgarājaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ haṃsomataṅgajaścaiva jñātavyāḥ kramaśo budhaiḥ

devyāśchatrādidhāriṇyassaptapatreṣu ceṭikāḥ tattadaṃkānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ trayāṇāṃkrīḍane caivaṃ viśeṣojñāyatāmiyān cakravarticchadāstena smṛtā ekoviṃśatiḥ ahardivaṃsyāccāmuṇḍārājñītasmādvicakṣaṇaiḥ mohinījātibhāgeṣvanti maṃmīnāṃkitaṃ chadama varṇāstveṣāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kalpyāssyuratiyuktitaḥ śrīcamuṇḍākṛpātrakṛṣṇarājamahībhujā ekaikasya tu devasya pṛthagaṣṭā daśacchadāḥ meṣādimīnaparyaṃtaṃ pūrvasmāddurbalaṃ param etaccihnānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ rājatoraktavarṇaśca haritpītaśca rājataḥ jātayaśca dvādaśaikajāteraṣṭādaśacchadāḥ jñeyaḥ krīḍākramaścaiva yathāpūrvamudīritaḥ ketujātaumīnapatramante yena pradīyate śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇakṛṣṇarājamahībhujā nakulassahadevaśca kauravo bhīṣma eva ca ekaikasya tu nāthasya parvasaṃkhyāyutacchadāḥ patākācaikamārabhya sūryasaṃkhyā vadhikramāt churikāmuṣṭibāṇau ca pāśasarpakaśāḥ kramāt divākṛṣṇaṃ puraskṛtya rātrau tu parameśvaram atiraktaḥ pāṭalaśca śvetoraktastathaiva ca nīlaścitraṃ cetivarṇāśchadānāṃ saṃprakīrtitāḥ viṣṇujātyantimaṃ patraṃ mohinyai yena dīyate śiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ krīḍanādi caṇḍikāvatsmṛtaṃ budhaiḥ

racitāvardhatāṃ nityaṃ mahābhārata peṭikā mahālakṣmīstṛtīyā ca kamalāsanasaṃsthitā brāhmīmāheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā ekasyā devatā yāstu purāṇagaṇitacchadāḥ pattidhvajaucakraśaṃkhau mṛgedraśca mataṃgajaḥ bakamatsyāvitiproktāḥ durbalāḥ parataḥ kramāt siṃdūraśvetavarṇau ca caṃpakaḥ pāṭalastathā tattadvarṇānusāreṇakhelanīyāvicakṣaṇaiḥ etaddevacchadāṃtaṃtu vakṣyantelakṣaṇāni vai mayūrogaruḍaścaiva mahiṣogaja eva ca krīḍakāśca bhavantyatra trayaścatvāra eva vā krīḍārambhastena kāryastvindrāṇyāścāntimacchadaḥ śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ krīḍāvaditi tadvidaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanṛpacandreṇaśaktikautukapeṭikā pavanodhanadaśceśo mohinitidaśa kramāt rājārājñī rathovājī padātirdhvaja eva ca etāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu tattacihnaṃ pravakṣyate sāraṃgāśvauvṛṣaśukaukramājjñeyābudhaiḥ sadā uktacihnānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ atiraktaḥ pāṭalaśca pītovaivartikā tathā jāticihnānivakṣyante siṃhaśca kamalāsanaḥ pārśvayoreka śiraso maṇḍaleravicandrayoḥ rātrindivaṃ caṇḍikaivarājñīsyāttasya khelanam evaṃ vai mohinījāterantimaṃ śukapatrakam cāmuṇḍikākrīḍanavacchiṣṭaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ

caturāṇāṃ vinodāyacakredikpālapeṭikām hayagrīvaśca senānī mahendraśca rati priyaḥ pṛthagekasyadevasya kalāsaṃkhyāmitacchadāḥ ekādidaśasaṃkhyāṃtaḥ pūrvasmāddurbalaḥ paraḥ siṃhovṛṣovānaraśca khagendrohaṃsaghoṭakau rājarājeśvarīcādau śrīkaṃṭhaśśarabhastathā vighneśastāṃḍavaścaiva divākaraniśākarau ādaucāmuṇḍikārpyāṇi padmapatrāṇisapta vai uktakramānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ śvetayukto haridvarṇaḥ śvetogairikavarṇakaḥ cakravarticchadānāṃ ca padmānāṃ svarṇavarṇakaḥ svīyottamacchadaṃ dattvā caturbhiḥkhelanaṃ bhavet mārajāterantyapatraṃ śuka mohinikābhidham cāmuṇḍikā krīḍanavacchiṣṭaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ kalpitā ca vinodāya śrīmanohara peṭikā puraṃdarodinakaroniśākararatipriyau pṛthagekasyadevasya purāṇa gaṇitacchadāḥ meṣādimīnaparyaṃtaṃ tattadevāṃkaśobhitāḥ śrīkaṇṭhovighnarājaśca ṣaṇmukhovaṭapatragaḥ kalāsaṃkhyāsamāyuktāḥ svatantrāścakravartinaḥ siṃhastriśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca haṃsovajrāyudhaṃ tathā svarṇavarṇotiraktaśca pītaḥśveto harittathā cakravarticchadānāṃ vai svarṇavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ mīnākhyokrīḍyate yena sajayyanye parājitāḥ śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇa kṛṣṇarājakṣamābhujā

dvādaśaivaṃ ṣoḍaśetisumasaṅkhyā dvayostathā ṣoḍaśānāṃ khelane syācchāra ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ śālīvāhaśakasyābde gha ṅachendumite śubhe śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇa kṛṣṇarājamahībhujā tisrovidhyastu ṛjavovīdhyāṃ koṣṭhāṣṭakaṃ caret syussaṃhatyadaleṣveṣu dvinavatyuttaraṃ śatam vartulaṃ parikalpyātra catuśśārīṃ vinikṣipet krīḍāṃraktāstathāpītāḥ kṛṣṇāharitavarṇakāḥ ūrdhvādhoharitāścordhvamadhaścaivāsitāstathā akṣau dvau pūrvavatkalpyau viśeṣastatra kathyate etadbhāgasyacottānekrīḍānātrapravartate krīḍā tu suprasiddhākṣakrīḍāvaditi niścayaḥ kharaphālgunaśuklasya hyekādaśyāṃbudhetviyam racitācāṣṭavaktrākṣakrīḍeyaṃ sumanoharā dalamūle tu catvāri koṣṭhāniparikalpayet saṃsthāpyārambhaṇaṃ kuryāt krīḍāyā iti nirṇayaḥ ṣaṭṣaṭśārā ekavarṇājñeyāḥ krīḍanakovidaiḥ ṣaṭkoṇākṣau tu vijñeyau daśāntaṃ sumakalpanam khelanaṃ syāt prasiddhākṣa krīḍāvaditi niścayaḥ phālgunasya siteśukre paurṇamāsyāmidaṃ kṛtam caturāṇāṃ hitārthāya ṣaṇmukhākṣasukhelanam pṛthagdale likhet tatra vīdhyastisrobhavanti hi caturdalānāṃ koṣṭhāni dvādaśottarakaṃśatam caturbhiḥ krīḍakaiḥ pañca sthāpyāśśārāssvakāstviha burajākhyaṃ dalaṃ hyevaṃ catuṣkaṃ syād dalāntare

saṃhṛtyasarvakoṣṭhāni dvātriṃśadadhikaṃ śatam ramyāñchukānvṛttakoṣṭhe caturovilikhet kramāt anyatrayugmaṃ na bhaved burajorityadīritam trikoṣṭhīmantarekṛtvā koṣṭhe kuryāt sumaṃśubham kramājjñeyamathākṣau dvauṣaḍaśrau parikalpayet dvecatvāriṣaḍaṣṭau ca tato daśa tato'sumam viṃśatiśca caturviṃśatiśca niṣkusumaṃ bhavet tasya vakṣyephalaṃtvagrenāmānyevaṃ vicintayet ṣaṭsumonissumenasyādrasa ityabhidhiyate daśasaṅkhyonissumenadikchabdenābhidhīyate ṣoḍaśāṅkonissmumenakalāśabdenagīyate viṃśatyaṅkonissumena hyuttānaḥkṛtirucyate nissumonissumenottānaścetyūjya itīryate sasaṅkhyākṣauyadottānau bhavetāṃnissumaṃvinā śiṣṭākrīḍāprasiddhākṣakrīḍevakathitā budhaiḥ nandanāṣāḍhaśuklasya tvekādaśyāṃ raverdine burajvakṣakrīḍanasya prakāraṃ vyavṛṇotsvayam likhetpratidalaṃramyaṃ koṣṭhadvādaśakaṃ kramāt dvādaśāṃśaṃ rāśicakramidamityanumanyatām koṣṭhānitānijānīyānnavāṃśaistriṃśadaṃśakaiḥ navagrahāssvākṛtayaśśārāssyussumanoharāḥ śvetaraktaśca haritaḥpītaḥśveto'sitastathā ravyādīnāṃ ca saptānāṃ gatissavyena vai smṛtā aticāragatirvakrāstambhaścaivamṛjurmatā akṣaudvaucaturaśrau syātāṃ vā pārśvacatuṣṭaye

ekasminnevamanyasmindve ca trīṇi ca pañca ca yadaikasaṅkhyaścottānastadāsiṃhādimāṃśake vidhuṃtrisaṅkhyaścottānaḥkujaṃmeṣādimenyaset tathottānaḥpañcasaṅkhyoguruṃminādimenyaset saptasaṅkhyoyadottānomakarādauśaniṃnyaset navasaṅkhyoyadottānaḥ syāt keturvṛścikādime ekādidvādaśāntāsyādṛjvīvakrāparā smṛtā sthāpanaṃhananaṃ caiva lokasiddhākṣavat smṛtam śārāṇāṃnobhavetkintu stambhaḥsyāditi tadvidaḥ nandanenabhasaḥ kṛṣṇe tvaṣṭamyāṃ ravivāsare navagrahākṣakrīḍāyāḥ prakāroyaṃ prakāśitaḥ tatrādimassyātprākāraścatuṣṣaṣṭi gṛhānvitaḥ catvāriṃśatkoṣṭhakaistu tṛtīyassaṃyutobhavet dvātriṃśatkoṣṭhasaṃyuktaḥ prakārassyāt tu pañcamaḥ tadantare syāt prākāraścaturviṃśatikoṣṭhakaḥ aṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyānāṃ madhye tasyāstyanuttamam prākārātprathamādvāhye prākpratyagdakṣiṇottare yataḥkrīḍāpravarteta catvāraḥkrīḍakāssmṛtāḥ haritassyāttathākṣāśca catvāraścaturaśrakāḥ tathānyecaturakṣāssyuścaturaśrāḥprakīrtitāḥ svasthānācchārakānramyānakṣapuṣpakrameṇa vai phalatomuktimāpannā itikrīḍāsukovidāḥ śakeśālīvāhanasya ṣaṣṭyuttaramunīnduke śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūṇa cāmarājatanubhavā tatropariṣṭādvīdhyastunavakalpyāmanoharāḥ

kamalaṃ śrīcakramiti paṇḍitairatrakīrtitam bṛndāvanantu kalaśā kṛtyāyatnena saṃlikhet ūrdhvaṃ daśamavīdhyāṃsyānmahatkoṣṭha tu madhyame tadadhovilikhetṣaṭ ca vīdhyaḥ koṣṭhaiḥ susaṃyutāḥ tadadhastanavīdhyoḥ koṣṭhānipañcadaśa kramāt koṣṭhānisaptadaśavaivilikhetkhelane paṭuḥ ekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāni likhitvāpārśvayoḥ pṛthak śārādvādaśasaṃsthāpyāḥ ṣaṭṣaṭvarṇa krameṇa tu caturviṃśatiśārāṃstāndalayoḥ pārśvayoḥ kṣipet saṃhṛtyaṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatadvayakoṣṭhakam kāryakāraṇabhedenabhinnacihnaṃ manoharam koṣṭhānyekottaraśataṃ śārasthāpana hetave ekonapaṃcāśaccasyuḥ sāyujyāyaikamuttamam sarvakoṣṭheṣu saṃcāryabṛndāvanasamākṛtau sāyujyaṃ prāpaye danta itikrīḍāvidoviduḥ sumānisyuḥpārśvabhāge pṛthakpṛthaganukramāt catvāaridveṣaḍaṣṭau syuritipakṣāntarasmṛtam sukhaṃ śayītatatreti krīḍākrīḍanakovidāḥ cihnitānyanulomenavilomenāpicālanam śiṣṭaṃprasiddhākṣatulyamitidvidbhirīritam vilambyāśvinaśuklasya paurṇamāsyāṃ budhe śubhe śrīcakradaśapatrākṣakrīḍeyaṃ nirmitā śubhā vyādhāssyuraṣṭā catvāriṃśaccatvārobhavantihi vyādhaissandhāvevasadāvyāghragrahavadīritam cāmuṇḍikāṃcāmarājabāhuvikramapoṣiṇīm

bhūnāthasaṃtatinutāṃ somakhaṃḍāvataṃsinīm samūḍhasumamaṃ ca sthāṃ vāhābhūṣāphaṇāmaṇim śāṭīluṭhattārahārāṃsiṃhaveṣarathasthitām bālāveṣadharāṃ devīṃ vaṃdehaṃ viṃdhyavāsinīm kīrtiṃbhāgyaṃsusaṃtānaṃ vijñānaṃ labhate varaḥ vikramāśvinaśuklasya prathamāyāṃravauśubhe uddiṣṭākṣaravacchlokāracitābudhatuṣṭaye || 8|| - || ekādikamacāṃsthānedaśakaṃdīrghabodhane saṃkhyāyāḥkādinavakaṃ pādabhedasyaṭādikam niṣkāditulaneśādi biṃdornoviśramasyañaḥ yaṃprastuvaṃti vidvāṃso bṛhaspati samā api śakeśālīvāhanasya tricatussaptabhūmite saṅkhyālipīnālipibhissaṃkhyānāṃ bodhako mahān carmabhasmamṛdasthīni rajataṃ nakhagomaye annaṃkāryāsakaṃ puṣpaṃ carma caiva pravālakaḥ dhānyaṃ ca gomayaṃ caiva lohobhasmādayassmṛtāḥ || 3 || - || keśomaṇiśca rajataṃ kārpāsomṛccapatrakam lavaṇaṃ ceti vai proktāḥ padārthāṣṣoḍaśātrahi || 5 || - || lohastāmraṃ bhasmacāsthi sañjīvaḥ keśa eva ca rajataṃ caiva karpūraṃ pravālo ratnameva ca asthyaśmākeśalavaṇaupuṣpabhūtī iti smṛtāḥ || 8 || - || sajīvomūlaśuṣke ca rasa ityādayo gatāḥ śuṣkaṃ mṛdeṣuvijñeyamiti vai tadvidoviduḥ śilārasaśca lavaṇamityādīṃstadvidoviduḥ mūlaṃrasassajīvaścetyevaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ

vikramāśvinaśuklasya trayodaśyāṃ bhṛgordine muṣṭipraśnottaravidhirevaṃ rūpeṇa varṇitaḥ kaṃdaṃjīvaśca śuṣkaṃ ca tṛṇaṃ gomayameva ca śilādhānyaṃ pravālaśca maṇimatsyau tathaiva ca bhasmaromāsthikarpūra tvagbhedādgaṇita kramaḥ tṛtīyaṃsyā tu kārpāsaṃ caturthe karmakathyate saptamaṃparṇamatrasyādaṣṭamaṃ gomayaṃ tathā ekādaśaṃ śaṣkamatradvādaśaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhavet rasaḥ paṃcadaśojñeyaḥ śrūyatāmaṃbike śive (ṭīku) - padyadalli baṃda lekkhavannu noḍikkoṃḍu iṃthā padārthaveṃdu gaṇitavannu suṇisikkoṃḍu heluva ślokagala yaraḍuprakāragalannu īgaṇitakke yaraḍu prakāra sūtragalannu saha baradu ive || ivannu buddhivantaru noḍi tilidu kkolatakkadducinnavu nīru verpabala śippe śilā guḍa carma bhasmagalu | maṇṇele velaliyu nakhavu gomaya nīrasa tāmravādiyol || 1 || annavu hatti togalu gurpavalaṃpū tṛṇa kappura cannele | belli berdavasa gomaya lohavu bhasmavādiyol || 2 || kappura veru nīraḍike kāyi kurul maṇi belli hatti | maṇsophele śippe tāmra togaluppugalīpa dinārujātiyol || 3 || tuppavu bella hullaḍike kappura lohavu tāmra bhasmavu meluppu sajīva keśa yallu śippeyu gomaya śupkacarmagalu || 4 || belliyu kappura pavala ratnavu hattiyu śippe tuppamu | bellavu kālu maṇṇeluvu kalkuruluppu puṣpabhūtigalu || 5 || yallapadārthabhedagala kelidabellava | pelveniṃdirāvallabhasodarī karuṇadiṃdalikautukamāda rītiyim (ṭīku) - yale hatti dhānya loha yalegal jīvanu beru śuṣka rasa modalāgi || 1 || phala hatti śileya rasadol yaleyaṃ śuṣka maṇṇugalivarol || 2 || phala carma dhānya jīvaru yale śile rasa uppu modalādavagal || 3 || yalu śuṣka sagaṇi uppugalaśile beruṃ rasa jīvarīparitorum vedāste bahavastatopi bahavaśśāstrādayo bhārataṃ kāvyaṃ cādyamapīkṣītuṃsapadinonaivāsti buddhiḥ kalau itthaṃbodhita eṣa kṛṣṇadharaṇī pālojaganmātṛkā devīsarvasurādhike tyupaviśatyuddāmavāgvaibhavaḥ saṃkrīḍanaṃsaṃracitaṃ suramyaṃ jīyādbhacandrāvadhibhūtalesmin || 3 || - || eteṣāṃ kāraṇībhūta sadanāni tathaiva hi etanmilitvāṣaṭtriṃśaduttaradviśataṃpadam śūlanārakamārabhyasakāraṇagṛhāṇi vai anṛtaṃ yastu vadati (narakakrimi) revasaḥ svāmidro hī bhavati yo (mahāraurava) maśnute mitradrohī bhavati yaḥ (tapanaṃ) narakaṃ vrajet atyapekṣī bhavati yassa (piśāco) bhavennaraḥ rājahelanamātanvan (kumbhīpākaṃ) vrajet pumān (asīpatrā) khyanarake jāyate rājadūṣakaḥ rājadārānkāmayāno ('ndhatemā) narakaṃ vrajet dayāvihinobhūteṣu (gaṇḍaśailo) bhaveddhruvam

jñānaṃprāpyavṛthābhūyādyadigoraktapobhavet jyotiṣepvanṛtaṃvakṣyan (pallikā) sobhijāyate dhānyacoryeṇajīvedyassa (ākhu) rbhavitānaraḥ anyāyataḥ kimapyutkvānatyajedyadi (godhikā) patyurgarapradānena (saraṭa)ssonyajanamani arjayitvādhanaṃ satsunadadyān (madhumakṣikā) samīcīnodayāśūnyassa (śilā) jāyate naraḥ viṣayuktāśayoyastusa (sarpa) ssarvathā bhavet yaḥkṣudravārtayājīvetsa (matsyo) jāyate naraḥ atyantavaṃcanāyukto (jambuka) ssabhavennaraḥ dṛṣṭvāyojñāninovṛdhā na dṛṣṭveva vrajet (taruḥ) annacauryeṇayojīvet savṛko nātrasaṃśayaḥ bādhate yojanānnīre (nakra) janmasamaśnute satkarmācaraṇemando bhaved (ajagaro) hi saḥ sadākāmī bhavatiyaḥ (kalaviṃka)ssajāte dāṃbhikadhyānamātanvan (bako) 'nyasminbhavebhavet kālajñāne nṛtaṃ vakṣyan (kukkuṭa)ssobhijāyate striyaṃbalādyoramate (gogāṃgūlo) 'nyajanmani hīnācāraratonityaṃ (vānara) ssonyajanmani abhijātonāṭyajīvīyadi (barhi) bhaviṣyati bādhate durbalānyastu (śyeno) 'nyasminbhavebhavet bhaṅtvāparagṛhaṃsvasya gṛhaṃbadhnāti (kīcakaḥ) śṛṃgāraceṣṭāsusadāyo vartetasa (kokilaḥ) garveṇavṛddhānyoniṃden (mahiṣa) ssonyajanmani śaivamaṃtropāsanāyāṃ bhraṣṭaścet (śarabho) bhavet viṣṇumantropāsanāyāṃbhraṣṭo (bheruṇḍa) evasaḥ

yo nityaṃ mṛgayā yuktassa (sālvo) 'nyabhave bhavet calacittassatkriyāsubhavenyasmin (mṛgo) hisaḥ parabudhdhyāyastu jīvedbuddhihīnaḥ (śuko) bhavet patiṃsaṃbhartsayānāstrī (poṭā) 'nyasminbhavebhavet ekāśītitamegehe patiṃhitvā paraṃ naram aśītitamasaṃkhyāke sadane vakṣyatedhunā pañcāśītitamenārīparaputrānasūyatī ekonenavatitamelajjāṃhitvā caret pathi gṛhenavati saṃkhyāke mātṛsvasrādi bandhutām saptayaṅnavatitametryaṃśaṃdroṇaṃ karoti yaḥ aṣṭādhikanavatyākhyasaṃkhyākesadanedhruvam ekonaśatasaṃkhyākesvānuṣṭhitasukarmaṇām navayukchatasaṃkhyāke sadane yo naro bhavet saptadaśottaraśatakegehe yo yaṃ hi kāmanāyuktaḥ sapādaśatasaṃkhyākeyastu śāstrānusārataḥ aṣṭāviṃśottaraśatagehekūpahṛdādikam ekaviṃśacchatatameyo bhajennīcadevatāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatasaṃkhyedāsyatiyonaraḥ sārdheśatesāṃgavedānuccarannādarātsadā pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyākaveśmani saptapaṃcāśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyākaveśmani ekonaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāyukchatasaṃkhye karoti yaḥ ekaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatedharmasūkṣmaṃvicāyan || 56 ||| saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśateyuddhānnāpasaranmṛtaḥ ekonāśītisahitaśatasaṃkhyākamaṃdire

paṃcāśītyuttaraśatasaṃkhyāke śivamaṃdiram aṣṭāśītyuttaraśatasaṃkhyāke veśmani dhruvam ekayuṅnavatiśatasaṃkhyākesadanenaraḥ triyugdviśatasaṃkhyāke hyanekakapilāgavām navayugdviśatemartyaḥ satkarmāṇi karoti yaḥ daśayugdviśataṃgehamārabhyāsaptamaṃ śṛṇu (nigamabrahmavidyā) ca (yogārūḍha) stataḥ param (mantrayogo) (jñānayoga) evaṃsaptagṛhāṇi vai varjitadhanasutadāraḥ (satyeloke) mahīyate manujaḥ yo vīraśaiva iti saṃprathito dharitryāṃ (kailāsa) metivibudhādibhirapyagamyam śrīśaṃkhacakraparikarmitabāhumūlo (vaikuṇṭhaloka) mupayātisurairalabhyam (nāmasmaraṇa) (nādānusandhānā) ('rcana) (dāsatā) (sākṣātkāraḥ) tataḥ paścāt (saṃsārasya vimocanam) ekatriṃśottaraśatadvaye ('ṅkita) vilekhanam gṛhāṇipañcakramaśaḥ (pādasevāprapattikā) ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatadvayasaṃkhyagṛhentime atraivapāśakasthānāṃ biṃdūnāmapi lakṣaṇam puṣpasaṃkhyāpatedatra hyekamārabhyāviṃśatiḥ sadmānisarpagatyaivadraṣṭavyānimanīṣibhiḥ rājāṃkitaṃ saṃlikhitaṃ paṭhedyaḥ gṛhairathopaṃcabhirādareṇa adhovīdhyāṃ paṃcadaśakoṣṭhāvissyuranukramāt ekāśordhvaṃkoṣṭhāni tvekavīdhyāṃ bhavanti ca yajjanmāpekṣyate sarvaiḥ prārabhyaṃ krīḍanaṃ bhavet prasiddhākṣakrīḍanavadanyajjñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ pārśveṣu syussumānyatratriṣvekadvitriṃsaṃkhyayā

ekaikapārśvesarveṣāṃ nissumaṃ saṃprakīrtitam vibhinnalakṣaṇāḥ kalpyāḥ krīḍākuśalibhissmṛtam kāraṇanūrāriruvavunūrārukāryagalalladippannātkutoruvasadgurumodalāgāri-salinnūramuvattāre manegal varagurudrohigebaruvudāgaleśūlanarakavanṛtavanāḍenaraka krimuyu vidyadiṃgarvisaluviprarākṣasanadhikavāgyapekṣayagaiyalavapiśāca rājadūṣaṇenaiyyalasipatravātanigerājadrohigesahāyavādaravagesaṃghātavai uttamadajātiyalihuṭṭimadyavaṃkuḍiyemattavagevaitaraṇiyanuvanaraka hadināraneyamaneyumodalāgimuvvattumaneyakāraṇakāryavanupelvenu nidreyanugeḍasidaḍetigaṇeyahatu mānavadevatāsmaraṇe irade devālayadadīpageḍiyāgepataṅgayāvavanu hiḍidapaṭṭaṃnyāyādiṃvinnude-iralavaneyuḍuvāgibahukālanaḍeyutihanu patigeviṣavanniṭṭasatigevotiyajanmasatatavītanavuṃḍusāguvabage jenuhuluvāguvanujīvigaligannaketānukaṇṭakanāgalavanunoṇavu mūvattavaṃdariṃmodalāginālvattaraidaneyamanegalenuyaidirppakāryakāraṇagalanu-kāṇvantepeluvenu dānakaṇṭakatoṭadabeliyāguvanuviṣahṛdayasarpanāgiruvanoḍu yahanumaduvekaṇṭakavekkucadurevañcaneyiṃdavadukenariyāguvanumatiyanīgibadukebahudinagūbe parara-annavanuṇḍubāleyāyasavaṃnacauryadalibāletolanavanalidu nīrinallijanarugalaniṃtuhiṃseyagaiyemosaleyāguvatannamosadiṃda ajagaranuvaṃśagalanavanapekṣiselateyudvijavaranenoḍidanuviśadavāgi kāṇvaṃtepeluvenusarvadākeluvudusakalajanarumudadinaliyutavega avivekadaliśāstragalanoderāsabhanu ḍāṃbhikadhyānavanumāḍebakanu uttamadakuladallipuṭṭimāṃsavatinnalitalavatāmyāke strīyarigegaṅgavaṃtirugipagalumāḍalavanukapota bahaluttamadajātiyalipuṭṭināṭyādiṃyāvanaranubadukuvanonavilavanumatujatanhoṭṭe-yanutānehoredaresūkaradajanmavu hiriyaranutoḍiśaṭhaṇe iṃdanaḍayevanṭeyāguvakaṇḍavaramaneyamuridutanamanekaṭṭegījaganumarulutanadim

aruvattavandariṃdamundāgiyappattaraidaneyamanegalanuyaidirppakāryakāraṇagalanu || kamalamukhipe luvenumudadiṃdanīkelumodalāgi sujanaralidoṣavagaiyuvanetāneśivaṃgi jīvakoṭidaṇḍaneyalliniratanādarekaṭukanijaveyavanu viṣṇumantrabhraṣṭabheruṇḍanuparārthavāgitīrthayātreyamāḍalaṃcevyāṭe tirugidaremadaheccigajavusālaidāyitugaṇenamāḍe-ārasāle īsālaleppattarelaneyamaneyalliyācārahīnanādavaneśūdra illiyambhatmūraralideviyamantrabhraṣṭanādaresiṃhabhāvavahudu veśyājanmavillitoṃbhattaralivāve-illaderamisalavanapuṃsakanu illitoṃbhatteṃṭarallisādhuveyāgijñānavillade-iralutānugovu yanṭanesālamanenūravaṃbhattarallisātvikanahaṃkāriyāgevimanava illivanitenūrippattayaṇṭaralikerekolavanelasiracisevaruṇalokavumunde nārikele - illinūraivattarallisāṃgādhyayanavanumāḍesadvipravaranukelu nūraivattelaralipatibhaktiyaṇisimāḍesatigepatisālokyasalubanūraivattaroṃbhattanedaralivappuvadidu hanneraḍanesālupaḍadu-iruvanūra-aravattelatorutihamnaneyallikadanadallihiṃmeṭṭadavanumaḍiyalavagevīrasvargabahudu nūratombhattavandarallitoṣadiṃda-atithipūjeyamāḍalagnilokabuvahudu hadinaidaneyamanaidanesālinallinūrahadinedaneyalliṣaṇatrayavanillivarjisalavagesatya-lokavebahudusatyāvagi innūrahattumattinnuvoṃbhattaralivīravaiṣṇavanāgevipulavaikuṇṭhalokavāmanujanige deviyasāyujyaviruvamaneparyaṃtaviruvidippatnālkuvivaravāgi illinigamabrahmavidyeyogārūḍhamatteyogabhraṣṭamantrayoga pādasevāprapattisālokyasāmīpyasārūpyasāyujyamuktiyaṃba lokabhedagalannunoḍijātiyanarakagalabhedagalasaṃkhyegalannupelve ūrdhvalokadamanegaloṭṭumāḍe hadinelugoviniṃmodalāgikuritunoḍalśileyapariyaṃtaravutiriyakjantugalamanegalihavara-vattuyaṇisinoḍal noṭakarekeli-īyāṭakkeḍālagalunālkupaṭṭinamūranaṃṭinīvu satatasantoṣadiṃdāḍinīvusukhadalāḍidajanakeśubhavuvahudu

vīdhidvayesaptadaśatataḥ pañcadaśopari ekādaśasyuḥ koṣṭhānividhyāmuparitatpare pṛthak tadūrdhvaṃvīdhyoḥ syurdvayorekādaśa kramāt tadūrdhvaṃsyussaptadaśavīdhyāṃ koṣṭhāni saṃlikhet koṣṭhānikalpyānyatreti krīḍāsu kuśalaissmṛtam akṣāścātra trayojñeyānissumā ekapārśvataḥ ekokṣonyastathājñeyo daśasaptacatussumaḥ sumānyatrasuvijñeyā nīticākṣavicakṣaṇāḥ āṣāḍhesitapakṣakebhṛgudine caikādaśī saṃyute śrīliṃgākṛtimātanodimamihaśrīkṛṣṇabhūvallabhaḥ śivaliṃgadākṛtiyacitrapaṭadalidevisāyujyamuktiyaṃbāṭadolage kailāsamodalāgikeltattvamārgāṃta-ūrdhvalokadamanegaloṭṭumāḍe bhedagalasadanagaluberadihavuhādinelugoviniṃmodalāgikuritunoḍal śūlanarakavumodalugoṃḍuvaitaraṇiyanukaḍeyoleṇisaluhanneraḍumanegal sadgurukaṭākṣādisarasasadanaṃ galigekāraṇagaleyillakaleyayidanu manegalavenūrāruyaṇisalaṃkitagūḍhayinnūramūvattumeleyāru vijayasaṃvatsaradavimalavādāṣāḍhaśuddhayekādaśiśukravāra māḍiruvadevisāyujyadāṭavācandratārakavidāḍisukhadim akṣatripārśvabhāgeṣusumānitriṣuvinyaset āṣāḍhesitapakṣakebudhapiturvāretharākādinesarpākāratayemamevaracayāmāsa-kṣaṇādbhūpatiḥ śālivāhanaśakavusāviradayelnūra-aivatta-āraneyaidutiruva kalpiśirutirppasarpadākṛtiyādacitrapaṭavanunoḍiśiṣṭarella adhovīdhyāṃsaptakoṣṭhamekādaśatathopari ūrdhvaṃsaptadaśaivaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vīdhīṣupañcasu tadūrdhvaṃsyussaptadaśatadūrdhvāṃsyuḥ pṛthakpṛthak ekādaśatadūrdhvaṃsyuḥ koṣthānyekādaśāntataḥ

devīsāyujyavatsarvamakṣāstraya udīritāḥ ekaṃdvetrīṇicatvāridvādaśāṣṭasumānihi caturaśrākṣakeṣvevaṃ vyavasthāsaṃprakīrtitā vijayaśrāvaṇekṛṣṇenavamyāṃśukravāsare devīsāyujyamuktyartha viśvarūpākṛtiḥkṛtā caturaśrākṛtiyāda devīsāyujyamuktiyāṭada paṭhabannu viśvarūpākṛtiyāgi raci śiruvadakke padyaślokada paṭhavannu racisiruvakrama ḍālagala lekkhasaha (sīsa) 'srīmahābalaśailaśṛṃgavāsiniyādalokamāteyaviśvarūpadolage || ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatamaṃdiragalolcetanācetanasṛṣṭibaradu rucisidaśrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājanakhilarusanmārgavariyuvante kaviyavāsaradolsakalakavigaloppedhareyaliruvaṃteyācandratāravāgi ādautrivīdhīṣu koṣṭhānisyurekonaviṃśatiḥ tataścaturvīdhikāsu koṣṭhānisyustrayodaśa vīdhyostataḥ pṛthakkoṣṭhāni bhavantīti tadvidaḥ tadūrdhvamekādaśasyuḥ tatassaptadaśordhvataḥ adhovāmāditaḥ proktaṃ sarpākārekṣa cālanam nissumaścaikapārśvassyāt trayāṇāmitareṣu tu evaṃpaṃcadaśātho vai caturdaśasumānyaho vijayekārtikasitedvādaśyāṃ bhānuvāsare devīsāyujyamuktyakṣa krīḍāviracitāpṛthak naśyeccapāpanicayaṃsūlabhopidharmodevīkaṭākṣalavataḥ sulabhābhavecchrīḥ ūrjasyaivavalakṣapakṣaka ihaśrīdvādaśīsaṃyutebhānorahnimahīpatissamakarovṛṃ?dāvanākāratām śālivāhanaśakavusāviradayelnūra aivatta āraneyaidutiruva kalpisibṛndāvanākṛtiyacitravanumāḍaluvīkṣisinīvumodadiṃda pṛthakpṛṭhak tataḥ koṣṭhānikuryātkrīḍanepaṭuḥ caturaṅgairbalairvyūhamabhedyaṃ gāruḍaṃ bhavet padātayo dvādaśasyurekapakṣe tathānyataḥ uṣṭrapārśverathastasya pārśvesthāpyāpatākikā

rājñaḥsthitissyātsvasthānemantrīṣaṣṭhe hi rājataḥ caturthe syāt paṃcame tu patākāsyānmanoharā hastīsamorathabalasya kramāt ṣaṭbalāni ca padātiḥ kariṇaḥ dve tu samestastu yadātadā abhedyogāruḍavyūho bhavediti budhaissmṛtam abhedyagāruḍavyūhoracitaścaturaṃgake tanagedurāginālkanemaneyolvaṃṭerathanālkarali-aidaralipatāke ārumoharusāligārukelagaḍepyāde karimukhadoloṃduyaraḍusamadi kamalasaṃbhavahokkarukaṭṭalahude caturaguṇasāṃdrakṛṣṇarājakṣitīṃdra rāgālāpakarārāvagītakāmarasolbaṇaḥ geharatnapadollāsīnānārāmakathonmanāḥ kṛṣṇarājaturaṃgasya cāturaṃgasyariṃgaṇe vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇī sadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametadūditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ catuścatvāriṃśadvasudalakalāśratrivalayatrirekhābhiḥ sārdhaṃ tava caraṇakoṇāḥ pariṇatāḥ bhūgṛhaṃ svarapatrābjaṃ vasvaraṃ bhuvanāśrakam trailokyamohanaṃ cakraṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param sarvānandamayaṃ madhyaṃ navamaṃ cakranāyakam prakaṭāśca tathāguptāstathāguptatarāḥ parāḥ parāpararahasyāstā atipūrvarahasyakāḥ tripurātripureśī ca sundarīpuravāsinī atyāpaddharamevedaṃ vijñāsaṃketasaṃjñitam atrātipūrvarahasyakā-itivacanātparāpararahasyākhyāyoginītvatipūrvaketi dakṣiṇāmūrtivacanātparāparātirahasyayoginītinavacakrayoginīnāmānīti śivam iti śrīmatsamastabhamaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānānikhiladeśāvataṃ sakarnāṭakajanapadādhiṣṭhānabhūta śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthānamadhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata-rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilanijarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūta-divyaratnasiṃhāsanārūḍha śrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpāpratimavīranarapatibirudeṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukulapayaḥpārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāra-makaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīra-vādyanekabirudāṃkitaśrīmanmahīśūrapuravarādhīśa śrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthepatrikākṣakrīḍādimahākautukanirūpaṇaṃnāmanavamo-nidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ iti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe - navamaḥ kautukanidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ
